Камеры сердца показаны как полости (объё: The heart chambers are shown as cavities (the volume filled with blood) and the heart outline is semi-transparent; the database has no separate model of the ventricular muscle wall. The bones of the chest are semi-transparent. The inferior vena cava is shown in the card “Vena cavae and azygos vein”.
Сердце состоит из четырёх камер и работа: The heart consists of four chambers and works as two pumps, right and left.
Правое предсердие получает венозную кров: The right atrium receives venous blood from the whole body except the lungs through the superior and inferior venae cavae. Venous blood from the heart muscle itself enters it through the coronary sinus.
Из правого предсердия кровь переходит че: From the right atrium blood passes through the tricuspid valve into the right ventricle, and from there it is directed to the pulmonary artery.
Четыре лёгочные вены (по две от каждого: Four pulmonary veins (two from each lung) carry oxygen-rich blood to the left atrium. All four open into the left atrium.
Из левого предсердия кровь через митраль: From the left atrium blood passes through the mitral valve into the left ventricle, which ejects it through the aortic valve into the systemic circulation.
Сердце развивается из двух эндокардиальн: The heart develops from two endocardial tubes that fuse, loop and become divided by septa.
После рождения два внутриутробных сообще: After birth two prenatal connections close: pressure in the left atrium closes the oval window (foramen ovale) and the ductus arteriosus is reduced.
У низких людей с ожирением сердце распол: In short people with obesity the heart lies more horizontally in the chest.
Сердце спортсмена может быть физически к: An athlete’s heart may be physically larger.
Если кровоток прекращается, необратимое: If blood flow stops, irreversible brain damage occurs within 4–5 minutes.
Нарушить работу сердца могут ишемическая: Heart function may be disrupted by coronary artery disease, valve disease, cardiomyopathies and ineffective rhythms.
С возрастом или при болезни клапаны могу: With age or disease valves can become fibrotic and calcified, causing stenosis that sometimes requires surgical or transcatheter replacement. Valves that do not close completely cause regurgitation, which is treated by valve repair or replacement.
Тромб или атеросклеротическая бляшка в к: A thrombus or atherosclerotic plaque in the coronary arteries reduces the blood supply to the heart muscle: angina or myocardial infarction may occur, and revascularization is often needed.
Врождённые пороки сердца встречаются у 6: Congenital heart defects occur in 6 per 1000 live births. Among the most common are defects of the interventricular and interatrial septa and tetralogy of Fallot.
Тетрада Фалло включает дефект межжелудоч: Tetralogy of Fallot includes a (membranous) ventricular septal defect, pulmonary orifice stenosis, an aortic orifice overriding the defect, and right ventricular hypertrophy; it usually requires surgical correction at an early age.
Показаны створки трёхстворчатого и митра: Shown are the leaflets of the tricuspid and mitral valves, the cusps of the aortic and pulmonary valves and the papillary muscles (the cusps of the aortic and pulmonary valves are merged into one colour each). The chordae tendineae are not in the database. The heart outline and bones are semi-transparent.
Между предсердиями и желудочками находят: Between the atria and the ventricles lie the tricuspid valve (right) and the mitral valve (left).
На выходе из желудочков расположены клап: At the outflow of the ventricles lie the pulmonary valve (right) and the aortic valve (left).
Фиброзное кольцо работает как сфинктер:: The fibrous ring works as a sphincter: it contracts in systole. At the attachment of the posterior leaflet it is thinner than other parts of the ring and therefore more prone to dilatation.
Створок две — передняя и задняя. Передня: There are two leaflets, anterior and posterior. The anterior leaflet lies at the posterior part of the aortic root and is also attached to it; it makes up approximately one third of the annular circumference and two thirds of the valve orifice area, and is larger and thicker than the posterior one.
Задняя створка (желудочковая, или присте: The posterior (ventricular, or mural) leaflet occupies the remaining two thirds of the annular circumference.
Створки состоят из трёх слоёв: фиброзног: The leaflets consist of three layers: fibrous, atrial and spongy.
Основной непатологический вариант — зубц: The main non-pathological variant is scallops on the leaflets: 29.5 %, more often in the posterior area of the leaflet.
Створки соединены сухожильными хордами с: The leaflets are connected by chordae tendineae to both papillary muscles of the left ventricle.
Сухожильные хорды — тонкие фиброзные тяж: The chordae tendineae are thin fibrous cords between the papillary muscles and the leaflets of the mitral and tricuspid valves.
Первичные (краевые) хорды тоньше и прикр: Primary (marginal) chordae are thinner and attach to the free edge of the leaflets. Secondary (intermediate) chordae are thicker than the primary ones.
В левом желудочке две сосочковые мышцы:: The left ventricle has two papillary muscles: anterolateral (from the sternocostal wall) and posteromedial (from the diaphragmatic wall). Each muscle gives rise to 2 to 20 chordae.
В правом желудочке три сосочковые мышцы:: The right ventricle has three papillary muscles: anterior (larger, from the anterior wall), posterior (from the inferior wall) and septal (the smallest, from the interventricular septum).
Сосочковые мышцы сокращаются одновременн: The papillary muscles contract simultaneously and tense the chordae; this prevents the leaflets from prolapsing into the atrium and inverting.
Переднебоковая сосочковая мышца получает: The anterolateral papillary muscle receives blood from branches of the left coronary artery. The posteromedial one most commonly receives it from the right coronary artery, and in some cases from branches of the circumflex artery.
Полулунный клапан диаметром около 20 мм,: A semilunar valve about 20 mm in diameter, usually with three cusps. Each cusp has three layers: ventricularis, spongiosa and fibrosa.
Створки прикрепляются к корню аорты чере: The cusps attach to the aortic root through the fibrous ring and are suspended by fibrous structures, the commissures.
Синусы аорты (синусы Вальсальвы) не дают: The aortic sinuses (sinuses of Valsalva) prevent the cusps from blocking the openings of the coronary arteries in systole. The cusps are traditionally named after the coronary arteries (left coronary, right coronary, non-coronary).

Слюнные железы — экзокринные железы, кот: Salivary glands are exocrine glands that produce, modify and release saliva into the mouth. Major glands: parotid, submandibular and sublingual; minor glands line the upper aerodigestive tract and most of the mouth. They produce 0.5 to 1.5 L of saliva daily.
Слюна помогает жевать, глотать и говорит: Saliva aids chewing, swallowing and speech, lubricates the oral mucosa and provides a watery medium for taste; it contains lipases and amylases that digest triglycerides and starches. Protective components: the secretory piece (a glycoprotein that binds IgA), lysozymes (cause bacterial agglutination), autolysin (breaks down bacterial cell walls) and lactoferrin (binds iron needed for bacterial growth). Bicarbonate and other ions buffer bacterial acids and shield the oral cavity and esophagus from gastric juice.
Самая крупная из больших слюнных желёз;: The largest major salivary gland; it lies between the sternocleidomastoid and masseter, from the mastoid tip to just below the mandibular angle. A small tail at the inferior edge is separated from the submandibular space only by the stylomandibular ligament.
Снаружи внутрь: лицевой нерв (важен хиру: From superficial to deep: the facial nerve (surgically important), the retromandibular vein and the external carotid artery. Stensen’s duct crosses the masseter, pierces the buccinator and opens at the buccal mucosa opposite the second maxillary molar.
Поднижнечелюстная железа — вторая по вел: The submandibular gland is the second-largest (about half the parotid’s weight); it lies below the mandible between the anterior and posterior digastric bellies. It has a smaller anterior lobe and a larger posterior lobe, connected at the posterior free edge of the mylohyoid. Wharton’s duct arises from the smaller deep lobe and opens at the sublingual caruncle beside the frenulum linguae; the hypoglossal nerve runs parallel to and below it.
Подъязычная железа лежит под слизистой д: The sublingual gland lies beneath the floor-of-mouth mucosa, above the mylohyoid, between the mandible and genioglossus. It has no single main duct: multiple short ducts (ducts of Rivinus) open directly into the floor of the mouth; Bartholin’s duct, a common duct, joins the submandibular duct at the sublingual caruncle.
От 600 до 1000 желёз, вырабатывающих ост: About 600 to 1000 glands produce the remaining 5 to 8% of saliva (major glands produce 92 to 95%). They are found nearly everywhere except the gingiva and anterior hard palate, most commonly in the lips, buccal mucosa, palate and tongue; secretion is mainly mucous. Von Ebner glands surround the circumvallate papillae and secrete serous fluid that aids lipid hydrolysis and taste.
У всех желёз общий план: ветвящиеся прот: All glands share the same basic design: branched ducts opening into the oral cavity and secretory end pieces (acini). The three main cell types are acinar, ductal and myoepithelial; myoepithelial cells wrap around acini and contract rhythmically to push saliva into the ducts.
Околоушная железа — только серозные ацин: Parotid: serous acini only, producing watery serous saliva. Submandibular: mixed, mostly serous, with about 10% mucinous acini capped by crescent-shaped serous demilunes. Sublingual: mixed acini and demilunes, predominantly mucinous.
Слюна становится гипотоничной по отношен: Saliva becomes hypotonic to plasma because sodium and chloride reabsorption exceeds potassium and bicarbonate secretion.
Околоушная железа: наружная сонная артер: Parotid: the external carotid artery and its branches — the superficial temporal, maxillary and transverse facial arteries. The retromandibular vein forms from the maxillary and superficial temporal veins, runs through the gland anterior to the facial nerve and joins the external jugular vein. A dense lymph node network in two layers drains to the superficial and deep cervical systems.
Поднижнечелюстная железа: в основном лиц: Submandibular: mainly the facial artery; the lymph nodes lie between the gland and its fascia and drain into the deep cervical and jugular chains. Sublingual: the submental and sublingual arteries (branches of the lingual and facial arteries); drainage mainly through submandibular lymph nodes.
Парасимпатическая иннервация стимулирует: Parasympathetic input promotes serous secretion and ion secretion; sympathetic input increases protein secretion and regulates gland blood flow.
Околоушная железа: языкоглоточный нерв (: Parotid: the glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX); parasympathetic cell bodies are in the otic ganglion and postganglionic fibers travel with the auriculotemporal nerve. Submandibular and sublingual: preganglionic fibers from the superior salivatory nucleus (pons) join the facial nerve (CN VII), pass through the chorda tympani, exit via the petrotympanic fissure, join the lingual nerve and synapse in the submandibular ganglion. Sympathetic cell bodies lie in the superior cervical ganglion.
Закладка начинается на 6–8-й неделе внут: Development begins around 6 to 8 weeks of gestation through branching morphogenesis. Terminal buds become acini by 14 weeks. The parotid gland forms first but is the last to be enclosed in connective tissue; it is the only gland with an enclosed lymphatic system. Glands are fully functional at birth.
Примерно у 20% людей есть добавочная тка: About 20% of people have accessory parotid tissue extending to the anterior masseter; it can mimic a mass on PET imaging. Other variants: unilateral or bilateral aplasia, parotid duct duplication and duct fistulas.
При операциях на околоушной и поднижнече: Identifying the facial nerve is essential during parotid and submandibular gland surgery. Reliable landmarks are bony, especially the tympanomastoid fissure; less reliable are the posterior digastric muscle and tragal pointer. Lingual nerve injury is a common complication when removing stones because the nerve lies close to Wharton’s duct.
Ксеростомия (сухость во рту) и сиалорея: Xerostomia (dry mouth) and sialorrhea (excess saliva) may result from problems with the medullary salivary center, autonomic innervation, the glands themselves or fluid and electrolyte imbalance. Many medications cause xerostomia. Sjögren syndrome is an autoimmune disorder causing xerostomia. Head and neck radiation often causes persistent xerostomia by damaging acini.
Сиаладенит — воспаление железы (инфекция: Sialadenitis is gland inflammation (infection, irradiation, allergy or trauma); mumps is a viral cause, mainly in children, with pain in front of the ear, parotid swelling, chills, headache and fever. Sialolithiasis is salivary stones, most commonly in Wharton’s duct: pain, swelling and inflammation, worsened when salivary flow increases. Mucoceles appear as bluish swellings, typically on the lower lip; ranulas are sublingual gland mucoceles on the floor of the mouth.

Пищевод — трубчатый удлинённый орган пищ: The esophagus is a tubular, elongated digestive organ linking the pharynx to the stomach. It runs behind the trachea and heart, in front of the spinal column, and passes through the diaphragm.
Длина у взрослого человека — около 23–25: Length in fully grown adults is about 23–25 cm. Sphincters are present at both ends: the upper esophageal sphincter allows one-way passage of food into the esophagus, the lower one into the stomach.
Основная функция — перемещение пищи из г: Its main role is moving food from the pharynx to the stomach.
Шейный отдел: от перстнеглоточной мышцы: Cervical: from the cricopharyngeus to the suprasternal notch; it lies behind the trachea, attached by loose connective tissue. Posteriorly the prevertebral fascia links it to the bodies of C6–C8; the thoracic duct runs along its left side near C6–C7; laterally lie the carotid sheath and the lower poles of the lateral thyroid gland.
Грудной отдел: от яремной вырезки до диа: Thoracic: from the suprasternal notch to the diaphragm, between the vertebral column and trachea in the superior mediastinum; it passes behind the aortic arch at the T4–T5 intervertebral disc level and enters the posterior mediastinum.
Брюшной отдел: от диафрагмы до кардии же: Abdominal: from the diaphragm to the gastric cardia; it passes through the esophageal hiatus formed by the right crus at about T10 and ends at the cardia, typically at T11.
Верхний пищеводный сфинктер (глоточно-пи: The upper esophageal sphincter (pharyngoesophageal sphincter) is a ring of muscle where the pharynx meets the proximal esophagus, just below the posterior tongue and oropharynx. It stays closed at rest and relaxes during swallowing to admit the bolus.
Peristalsis moves the bolus down. Pharyngeal muscle contraction starts a wave that pushes the bolus through the upper sphincter and continues as primary peristalsis. If it fails, distension triggers secondary peristalsis, which continues until the bolus reaches the stomach.
Нижний пищеводный сфинктер находится при: The lower esophageal sphincter lies about 3 cm above the stomach junction (also called the cardiac or cardioesophageal sphincter). It stays contracted at rest to block backflow of gastric contents and opens involuntarily during peristalsis.
В проксимальной трети преобладает скелет: The proximal third is mainly skeletal muscle; the distal two-thirds are smooth muscle. Fibers form two layers: an outer longitudinal and an inner circular layer; the inner circular layer is thicker and drives peristaltic contractions.
На дистальном конце утолщение и перекрес: At the distal end, thickening and overlap of the inner fibers forms the lower esophageal sphincter. The upper sphincter is formed proximally by the cricopharyngeus, thyropharyngeus and craniocervical muscles, whose fibers run in opposing directions.
Артерии: шейный отдел и верхний сфинктер: Arteries: the cervical esophagus and upper sphincter — branches of the inferior thyroid artery; thoracic — mainly esophageal branches of the thoracic aorta plus bronchial and intercostal contributions; the abdominal segment and lower sphincter — the left gastric artery and a branch of the left phrenic artery. These form a dense network within the submucosa.
Вены: шейный отдел — нижние щитовидные в: Veins: cervical — inferior thyroid veins, draining into the brachiocephalic veins; thoracic — azygos and hemiazygos veins; distal — tributaries of the left gastric vein, entering the portal venous system.
Лимфа: проксимальная треть — через грудн: Lymph: proximal third — via the thoracic duct from the deep cervical nodes; middle third — superior and posterior mediastinal nodes; distal third — gastric and celiac nodes.
Блуждающий нерв даёт парасимпатическую д: The vagus nerve provides parasympathetic motor control of esophageal muscle and glands. Sympathetic input comes from the thoracic and cervical sympathetic trunks derived from spinal nerves T1–T10; it causes vasoconstriction, helps maintain upper and lower sphincter tone, and generally inhibits peristalsis and glandular secretion.
Обе системы несут чувствительные волокна: Both systems carry sensation: the vagus detects pressure, which may be felt as pain, while the sympathetic trunk carries nociceptive signals more directly.
Пищевод развивается из передней кишки (о: The esophagus develops from the foregut (the digestive tube divides into foregut, midgut and hindgut).
Вариации встречаются редко, чаще всего э: Natural variation is uncommon; the most frequent differences are size and length. Rare congenital abnormalities include tracheoesophageal fistula and atresia, esophageal stenosis, duplication and duplication cysts, rings and webs.
Изжога и гастроэзофагеальная рефлюксная: Heartburn and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) are among the most common esophageal disorders; understanding the lower sphincter’s function is critical. They can progress to esophagitis, ulcers, strictures, Barrett esophagus and esophageal adenocarcinoma.
Операции могут потребоваться при раке пи: Surgery may be needed for esophageal cancer, achalasia, tears and esophageal varices; laparoscopic surgery is preferred when feasible.

Желудок — наиболее расширенная часть пищ: The stomach is the most dilated part of the digestive system, located between the esophagus (above) and the small intestine (below). It is a large, muscular, hollow organ that holds about 2 to 3 liters of food and acts as a blender and food reservoir.
Расположен слева от срединной линии, в ц: It lies left of the midline and centrally in the upper abdomen.
Кардия — часть, соединённая с пищеводом,: Cardia: connected to the esophagus; where food first enters.
Дно (свод) — выпуклая куполообразная час: Fundus: bulbous, dome-shaped region just inferior to the cardia.
Привратник (пилорическая часть) — направ: Pylorus: funnels food into the duodenum, the first segment of the small intestine.
Желудок — внутрибрюшинный орган. Два лис: The stomach is an intraperitoneal organ. Two layers of the lesser omentum run from the inferior surface of the liver to the lesser curvature and continue as the greater omentum at the greater curvature.
Спереди: диафрагма, левая доля печени, п: Anterior: the diaphragm, left hepatic lobe and anterior abdominal wall. Posterior (behind the lesser sac): the pancreas, left diaphragm dome, spleen, left kidney and suprarenal gland, splenic artery and transverse mesocolon.
Слизистая оболочка покрыта эпителием и с: The mucosa is covered by epithelium and contains gastric glands. The fundus secretes gastric juices; the cardia secretes protective mucus through mucus (foveolar) cells. Chief cells (pepsin) and parietal cells (HCl) produce the digestive secretions that the mucus protects against.
Подслизистая основа — плотная соединител: The submucosa is dense connective tissue containing blood vessels, lymphatics and nerves; it supports the mucosa and forms the accordion-like folds called rugae that allow distension.
Мышечная оболочка — см. ниже. Серозная о: The muscularis externa is described below. The serosa is the outermost layer of connective tissue strata that network with the peritoneum.
Толстая гладкая мускулатура в три слоя:: Thick smooth muscle in three layers (longitudinal, oblique, circular). The inner oblique layer is unique to the stomach and is primarily responsible for churning and mechanical digestion.
Средний круговой слой идёт концентрично: The middle circular layer is concentric with the long axis of the stomach; it thickens in the pylorus to form the pyloric sphincter, which regulates output into the duodenum. The outer longitudinal layer’s contractions move food toward the pylorus.
Между наружным продольным и средним круг: Auerbach’s plexus lies between the outer longitudinal and middle circular layers.
Желудок временно хранит пищу и проводит: The stomach provides temporary storage and partial chemical and mechanical digestion. The upper regions (cardia, fundus, body) relax to hold the increasing volume; the lower portion contracts rhythmically. Food mixes with gastric juices, forming partially digested chyme.
Волны перемешивания возникают примерно р: Mixing waves occur about every 20 seconds and intensify toward the lower gastric region; with each wave the pyloric sphincter releases small amounts of sufficiently liquefied chyme into the small intestine, where it is further digested in the duodenum.
Желудочный сок содержит соляную кислоту: Gastric juice contains HCl (produced by parietal cells) and pepsin, formed from pepsinogen (secreted by chief cells) after mixing with HCl. Parietal cells also produce intrinsic factor, which is needed to absorb vitamin B12 in the terminal ileum.
Пища переходит в двенадцатиперстную кишк: Food reaches the duodenum within 2 to 4 hours, depending on food type; carbohydrates and proteins are broken down faster than lipids (triglycerides).
Питательные вещества желудок в основном: The stomach does not primarily absorb nutrients; it can absorb water (during dehydration), certain medications (aspirin), ethanol, caffeine, amino acids and water-soluble vitamins. Neuroendocrine cells, including gastrin-producing G cells, synthesize hormones that regulate acid production and motility. Gastric acid can kill many bacteria and other microorganisms that enter through ingestion.
Чревный ствол отходит от аорты спереди н: The celiac trunk arises anteriorly from the aorta at T12 and supplies the common hepatic, splenic and left gastric arteries.
Левая желудочная артерия: нисходящая вет: Left gastric artery: its descending branch supplies the lesser curvature proximally; its ascending branch supplies part of the distal esophagus.
Общая печёночная артерия идёт вправо от: The common hepatic artery runs to the right of the celiac trunk, superior to the pancreas, gives off the gastroduodenal artery and continues as the proper hepatic artery. The proper hepatic artery gives off the right gastric artery, which runs right to left along the inferior lesser curvature and joins branches of the left gastric artery; the two supply the lesser curvature.
Желудочно-двенадцатиперстная артерия идё: The gastroduodenal artery runs posterior to the first part of the duodenum and gives off the right gastroomental (gastroepiploic) artery along the greater curvature, right to left. The left gastroomental artery branches from the splenic artery, supplies the greater curvature and anastomoses with the right. About 3 to 5 short gastric arteries branch from the splenic artery to supply the fundus.
Вены повторяют ход артерий. Левая и прав: The veins mirror the arteries. The left and right gastric veins drain into the portal vein; the short gastric and left gastroomental veins drain into the splenic vein; the right gastroomental veins drain into the superior mesenteric vein. The splenic vein joins the superior mesenteric vein to form the portal vein.
Лимфатические сосуды идут вдоль артерий: Lymphatic vessels run alongside the arteries of the lesser and greater curvatures to the gastric and gastroomental nodes; efferents from most nodes reach the celiac nodes. Four drainage zones: zone 1 — gastric nodes (cardia and upper right two-thirds); zone 2 — suprapyloric nodes (lower right two-thirds); zone 3 — pancreaticosplenic nodes (body and fundus, upper left one-third); zone 4 — subpyloric nodes (lower left one-third).
Парасимпатическая иннервация — блуждающи: Parasympathetic: the vagus nerve, whose anterior and posterior fibers travel to the lesser curvature and form anterior and posterior gastric branches. Sympathetic: spinal segments T5–T9 via the greater splanchnic nerve to the celiac plexus, distributed along the arterial supply.
Ауэрбахово (межмышечное) сплетение регул: Auerbach’s (myenteric) plexus regulates motility; Meissner’s (submucosal) plexus regulates local blood flow and gastric secretion. Both belong to the enteric nervous system, the “brain of the gut.”
Желудок появляется на 4-й неделе как наи: The stomach appears in the 4th week as the most dilated part of the foregut; by week 12 it descends from C2 to T11. By week 5 the dorsal wall grows faster than the ventral wall, forming the greater and lesser curvatures. In week 7 the stomach rotates 90° clockwise: the right vagus shifts to the posterior wall and the left vagus to the anterior wall. In week 8 the pylorus moves up and to the right and the cardia down and to the left.
Естественных вариантов мало: различаются: Few natural variations exist; they mainly reflect differences in position, size and shape, which may be related to diet. Rugae may stay distended in people who frequently overeat. Congenital anomalies: gastric outlet obstruction, duplication, transposition, diverticula, and bilocular (hourglass) contraction.
Хирургические состояния: рак, язвы, перф: Surgical conditions include cancers, ulcers and perforations. Bariatric procedures include gastric bypass and banding. Radiographic techniques and endoscopy are used to evaluate the stomach.
ГЭРБ — постоянный заброс желудочной кисл: GERD is continuous reflux of stomach acid into the esophagus (heartburn, regurgitation, dysphagia, chronic cough, hoarseness), associated with a risk of esophageal adenocarcinoma. Other conditions: dyspepsia, gastric ulcers, tumors and bleeding.
Лечение: препараты, снижающие кислотност: Treatment options: acid-reducing medications (histamine blockers, proton pump inhibitors, antacids), motility agents, and antibiotics for infections such as Helicobacter pylori.

Двенадцатиперстная кишка — первый, С-обр: The duodenum is the first, C-shaped part of the small intestine, running from the pylorus to the jejunum. The duodenum article gives its length as about 25 to 30 cm; the small-intestine article gives 20 to 25 cm.
Это самый короткий и самый широкий отдел: It is the shortest and widest segment of the small intestine. Its name comes from Latin, referring to an approximate length of “12 fingers.”
Кроме первого отдела, кишка расположена: Apart from the first segment, it is retroperitoneal and fixed to the posterior abdominal wall.
Луковица (верхняя часть) — проксимальный: The bulb is the proximal segment and attaches to the undersurface of the liver via the hepatoduodenal ligament, which contains the portal vein, hepatic artery and common bile duct. According to the small-intestine article, the first 2 cm of the superior part are mobile and intraperitoneal; the rest is retroperitoneal.

Горизонтальная (3-я) часть идёт справа н: The 3rd segment crosses from right to left, anterior to the aorta and IVC, with the superior mesenteric vessels in front.

Четыре слоя от просвета наружу: слизиста: Four layers from the lumen outward: mucosa (simple columnar epithelium with microvilli and many mucous glands), submucosa (connective tissue with blood vessels and nerves), muscularis (smooth muscle that mixes and propels chyme) and serosa.
Бруннеровы железы в подслизистой основе: Brunner glands in the submucosa are unique to the duodenum; they secrete bicarbonate to neutralize acid (small-intestine article).
Мышечная оболочка состоит из циркулярног: The muscularis has circular and longitudinal smooth-muscle layers; coordinated contractions produce peristaltic waves that move chyme onward.
Кишка продолжает пищеварение, начатое в: The duodenum continues digestion begun in the stomach; chyme enters through the pylorus. Enzymes from the mucosa, bile from the gallbladder, bile acids from the liver and pancreatic enzymes enter the lumen through the major and minor papillae in the 2nd segment.
Над большим сосочком есть полулунная скл: The major papilla has a semicircular mucosal fold above it and is controlled by the sphincter of Oddi, which prevents reflux into the bile and pancreatic ducts. The distal common bile duct joins the pancreatic duct to form the biliopancreatic ampulla, which opens at the dome of the major papilla; this landmark helps endoscopists during ERCP.
Секретин выделяется при падении pH в про: Secretin is released when luminal pH drops and triggers water and bicarbonate secretion, keeping pancreatic amylase and lipase within their working pH range. Cholecystokinin is released in response to fatty acids and amino acids; it slows gastric emptying, contracts the gallbladder and relaxes the sphincter of Oddi.
Кровоснабжение общее с головкой поджелуд: Blood supply is shared with the pancreatic head. The proximal segment is supplied by the gastroduodenal artery and its branches, including the superior pancreaticoduodenal artery; the distal segment by branches of the superior mesenteric artery, mainly the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery.
Вены идут за артериями в систему воротно: Venous drainage follows the arteries into the portal venous system. Lymph drains along the pancreaticoduodenal vessels to the pancreaticoduodenal nodes, then to the superior mesenteric nodes.
Парасимпатические волокна идут от передн: Parasympathetic fibers come from the anterior and posterior vagal trunks, pass through the celiac plexuses and synapse in enteric plexuses within the wall. Sympathetic fibers arise from T5–T9, travel via the sympathetic chain and greater splanchnic nerve, synapse in the celiac ganglia and follow celiac trunk branches to the duodenum.
Кишка развивается из самой каудальной ча: The duodenum arises from the caudal-most part of the foregut. It does not undergo true rotation: its C-shape results from leftward stomach growth and fixation by the enlarging liver and pancreas, so its inferior portion lies posterior to the superior mesenteric artery. By the end of development the loop lies along the right posterior abdominal wall and its peritoneal layers merge with the parietal peritoneum, making it secondarily retroperitoneal.
Дуоденоеюнальный изгиб — резкий поворот;: The duodenojejunal flexure is a sharp bend, usually identified intraoperatively by the inferior mesenteric vein on its left. The ligament of Treitz anchors this flexure to the posterior abdominal wall.
Гипертрофический пилоростеноз (0,5–1% мл: Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis (0.5–1% of infants): hyperproliferation of pyloric smooth muscle causes forceful, projectile, nonbilious vomiting after feeding — nonbilious because the obstruction is proximal to the papilla. The enlarged pylorus may be palpated as an olive-shaped mass in the epigastrium near the right costal margin; management is usually surgical.
Атрезия двенадцатиперстной кишки: на рен: Duodenal atresia: the radiographic “double-bubble sign” (air in the stomach and proximal duodenum separated by the pylorus); associated with Down syndrome; treatment is usually duodenoduodenostomy.
Синдром верхней брыжеечной артерии: 3-я: SMA syndrome: the 3rd or 4th portion is compressed between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta — nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, early satiety, distension. Loss of the retroperitoneal fat that cushions the duodenum enables compression; congenital predisposition includes asthenic habitus, high duodenal fixation at the ligament of Treitz or low SMA origin; acquired factors include retroperitoneal tumors, lumbar lordosis, trauma, rapid growth, weight loss and starvation.
Язвы: кишка подвержена язвам, чаще при и: Ulceration: the duodenum is prone to ulcers, most often with H. pylori infection; posterior-wall ulcers are especially dangerous because they can injure the gastroduodenal artery. Celiac disease diagnosis requires duodenal biopsy; traumatic duodenal hematomas may follow seatbelt injuries or direct blows; duodenal adenocarcinoma is rare and may be linked to polyposis syndromes.

Тонкая кишка переваривает и всасывает пи: The small intestine digests and absorbs nutrients, has endocrine functions and provides immune protection. It averages 3 to 5 m in length and runs from the gastric pylorus to the ileocecal junction.
Три части: двенадцатиперстная, тощая и п: It has 3 parts: duodenum, jejunum and ileum. Small bowel disease can cause severe abdominal pain, GI bleeding, enterocutaneous fistulae and nutrient deficiencies.
Тощая кишка — около 2,5 м, начинается от: The jejunum is about 2.5 m long, starting at the duodenojejunal junction, and contains plicae circulares and villi. The ileum is about 3 m long, ending at the cecum.
Тощая кишка краснее, имеет более толстую: The jejunum is redder, has a thicker wall and is more vascular. The ileum has more mesenteric fat and more Peyer patches.
Брыжейка — двойная складка брюшины, кото: The mesentery is a double peritoneal fold that anchors the jejunum and ileum to the posterior abdominal wall; it carries vessels, lymphatics and nerves, supports the bowel and aids immune surveillance.

The thin longitudinal muscle shortens and lengthens the gut; the thick circular muscle constricts it. The myenteric (Auerbach) plexus between them coordinates proximal-to-distal propulsion.
Подслизистая основа содержит сосуды, нер: The submucosa holds blood vessels, nerves (Meissner plexus) and lymphatics; the lamina propria is loose connective tissue containing immune cells, vessels and lymphatics.
Слизистая приспособлена к максимальному: The mucosa is adapted for maximal absorption through villi that increase surface area. Crypts of Lieberkühn are sites of continuous cell renewal; stem cells migrate to villi and differentiate, and epithelial cells last only 3 to 5 days.
Энтероциты — самые многочисленные клетки: Enterocytes are the most abundant villous cells, with microvilli, and absorb nutrients. Goblet cells secrete mucus. Paneth cells (in crypts) secrete defensins, lysozyme, growth factors, enzymes and cytokines.

Taste receptor cells in the duodenum and jejunum detect sweet, umami and bitter.
Двенадцатиперстная кишка принимает химус: The duodenum receives chyme; bicarbonate from Brunner glands neutralizes acid; with the upper jejunum it is the main site of dietary iron absorption.
Тощая кишка всасывает углеводы, аминокис: The jejunum absorbs carbohydrates, amino acids and fatty acids via villi; plicae circulares increase surface area.
Подвздошная кишка всасывает то, что не в: The ileum absorbs what the upper segments miss, most notably vitamin B12 and bile acids, which are recycled.
Эндокринная роль: кишка вырабатывает хол: Endocrine role: the intestine produces cholecystokinin, secretin, gastric inhibitory peptide and glucagon-like peptide-1.

Вены идут параллельно артериям, впадают: Veins parallel the arteries and drain into the superior mesenteric vein, which joins the splenic vein to form the portal vein.
Лимфатические сосуды идут за артериями:: Lymphatics follow the arteries: the mucosa drains to mesenteric, arcade and superior mesenteric artery nodes, then to the celiac nodes, cisterna chyli and thoracic duct, which empties at the left venous angle. They transport absorbed lipids, support immunity and can carry cancer cells. Left supraclavicular (Virchow) node enlargement can occasionally indicate small bowel cancer.
Парасимпатическая иннервация — блуждающи: Parasympathetic: the vagus nerve increases secretion and motility. Sympathetic: the greater splanchnic nerve (T5–T9) synapses in the celiac ganglia and supplies the foregut (proximal to the ligament of Treitz); the lesser splanchnic (T10–T11) synapses in the superior mesenteric ganglia and supplies the midgut (distal duodenum, jejunum, ileum). Sympathetic activity decreases secretion and motility and causes vasoconstriction; painful stimuli travel via sympathetic afferents.
Тощая и подвздошная кишка происходят из: The jejunum and ileum come from the midgut; the duodenum comes from the distal foregut and proximal midgut. The celiac artery supplies the foregut; the superior mesenteric artery supplies the midgut.
К 6-й неделе средняя кишка выпячивается: By week 6 the midgut herniates through the umbilicus (physiologic umbilical herniation), forming a loop connected to the yolk sac by the vitelline duct; the SMA forms the loop’s axis. In week 10 the loop rotates 270° counterclockwise and returns to the abdomen. The lumen is obliterated, then recanalized in weeks 8 to 10; villi develop afterward and crypts form between weeks 10 and 12.

Classically presents in young males with hematochezia and periumbilical pain, though often asymptomatic. The “rule of 2’s”: common at age 2, twice as likely in males, about 2 inches long, about 2 feet from the ileocecal valve, occurs in about 2% of people and may contain two epithelial types (gastric and pancreatic).

The tip often lies in the peritoneal cavity, most commonly retrocecal. A short, triangular mesoappendix provides its vascular supply.

It is retroperitoneal; the right paracolic gutter separates it from the abdominal wall.

The left (splenic) flexure is less mobile and is anchored to the diaphragm by the phrenicocolic ligament. The colon is suspended by the transverse mesocolon, whose root runs along the inferior border of the pancreas. It becomes the descending colon at the splenic flexure.

Прямая кишка лежит в вогнутости крестцов: The rectum occupies the concavity of the sacrococcygeal curvature. It is fixed, primarily retroperitoneal and subperitoneal, and becomes the anal canal at the puborectal sling (levator ani fibers). The ampulla (middle segment) serves as a fecal storage reservoir.

Total rotation is 270° around the SMA axis.

The lower anal canal arises from an invagination of surface ectoderm, the proctodeum, below the pectinate line.

Hindgut-derived parts (distal 1/3 of the transverse colon, descending colon and sigmoid colon) are innervated by the inferior mesenteric plexus.

Варианты резекции: правосторонняя гемико: Resection options: right hemicolectomy, extended right hemicolectomy, left hemicolectomy, extended left hemicolectomy and abdominoperineal resection; simple excision with primary anastomosis is another option. Side-to-side and side-to-end anastomoses are preferred over transanal anastomoses because of lower anastomotic leakage risk. If anastomosis isn’t feasible, an ostomy lets stool exit into an ostomy bag.
Ишемический колит — серьёзное осложнение: Colonic ischemia (ischemic colitis) is a serious complication after aortic surgery or any perioperative hypotension, typically presenting postoperatively with abdominal pain and bloody diarrhea.
Заболевания ободочной кишки: дивертикуля: Disorders of the colon: diverticular disease, colorectal cancer, bowel obstruction, lower GI bleeding from polyps and arteriovenous malformations, strictures and abnormal peristalsis. Colonic perforation is an uncommon cause of retroperitoneal abscess, occurring when the ascending or descending colon is involved.
Заболевания толстой кишки включают колор: Disorders of the large intestine include colorectal cancer, inflammatory bowel disease and diverticulosis; surgeries include colectomy, hemicolectomy and proctectomy.

The inferior liver is closely associated with the gallbladder and right kidney.

The caudate lobe is bounded medially by the ligamentum venosum (a remnant of the ductus venosus), posteriorly by the inferior vena cava and anteriorly by the porta hepatis. The quadrate lobe lies anterior to the porta hepatis and lateral to the round ligament, closely associated with the gallbladder, on the inferior surface of the right lobe. The caudate lobe sits between the left and right lobes, anterior and superior.

Долька — функциональная единица: шестигр: The lobule is the functional unit: hexagonal collections of hepatocytes arranged in cords around a central vein. Sinusoids between the cords contain Kupffer cells (resident macrophages) and stellate cells (hepatic lipocytes). The portal triad sits at the hexagon’s vertices: a bile duct branch, a portal vein branch and a hepatic artery branch. Blood flows across the lobule into the central vein, a branch of the hepatic vein.
Альтернативная модель — портальный ацину: The alternative model is the portal acinus, a rhomboid with central veins at its ends, used to describe functional zones: zone 1 surrounds portal tracts (mainly oxidative energy metabolism); zone 2 is mixed; zone 3 surrounds the central veins (main site of drug biotransformation).
Печень — самая крупная железа организма;: The liver is the largest gland in the body, well placed to receive absorbed nutrients and detoxify drugs and noxious substances. Cytochrome P-450 handles phase I reactions; phase II reactions conjugate substances with glucuronide, glutathione or sulfate.
Экзокринная функция: синтез жёлчных соле: Exocrine: synthesis and excretion of bile salts into the common hepatic duct; bilirubin conjugation and excretion into the gut. Endocrine: glycemic control via insulin and glucagon. Protein synthesis: fibrinogen, albumin, prothrombin. Lipids: fatty acid metabolism and synthesis of lipoproteins, cholesterol and phospholipids. Carbohydrates: glycogen storage and gluconeogenesis. The liver metabolizes lactic acid, converts ammonia to urea and stores vitamins and minerals, including iron.
Двойное кровоснабжение: 75–80% крови пос: Dual blood supply: about 75% to 80% from the portal vein and 20% to 25% from the hepatic artery. The portal vein forms from the superior mesenteric and splenic veins posterior to the pancreatic neck. The proper hepatic artery (a celiac trunk branch) and the common bile duct join the portal vein to form the portal triad, enclosed in the hepatoduodenal ligament.
Жёлчь выходит по жёлчным протокам, а кро: Bile leaves in the bile ducts while blood enters via the portal vein and hepatic artery, creating countercurrent flow that supports exchange of electrolytes, bile acids and other compounds.
Венозный отток в основном по трём печёно: Venous drainage is mainly through three hepatic veins: left (20.7%) — the left lobe; middle (32.7%) — the middle portions of the left and right lobes; right (39.6%) — the lateral right lobe. The caudate lobe usually drains into the middle hepatic vein; in some cases it drains directly into the retrohepatic inferior vena cava. The article does not discuss lymphatics.
Печень иннервирует печёночное сплетение:: The hepatic plexus innervates the liver: sympathetic fibers come from the celiac plexus and parasympathetic fibers from the anterior and posterior vagal trunks. The plexus travels with the vessels and bile ducts in the portal triad.
Печень развивается из вентрального эндод: The liver arises from a ventral endodermal proliferation of the caudal foregut that grows into mesoderm in the fourth week (the hepatic diverticulum, or liver bud). The endoderm becomes hepatocytes and the mesoderm becomes connective tissue and blood vessels. The liver has a hematopoietic role throughout the fetal period.
Частичная трансплантация возможна, в осн: Partial liver transplants are possible, mainly by harvesting the right lobe. Common variations include an absent main-right portal vein (14.5%) and multiple bile duct abnormalities; patients with portal vein abnormalities are highly likely to have multiple bile ducts (88.9%).
При портальной гипертензии применяют шун: Portal hypertension can be treated with a shunt procedure (abbreviated TIPS in the article) that connects the portal vein to the inferior vena cava, bypassing the damaged hepatic system. The article’s reference list names it a transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt, so the expansion in the body text may be inconsistent with its sources.
Нарушение экзокринной функции (закупорка: Impaired exocrine function (bile duct blockage, hepatocyte damage or conjugation dysfunction) raises blood bilirubin, causing jaundice of the skin and sclera; it may come with itching, mental status changes, edema and spider vessels.
Печень — главное место портокавальных ан: The liver is the main site of portocaval anastomosis; portal hypertension causes venous congestion there, which can lead to esophageal varices, rectal hemorrhoids and caput medusae. Budd–Chiari syndrome is blockage of hepatic venous drainage by thrombosis of one or more major hepatic veins; it is diagnosed with ultrasound or MRI.

Жёлчный пузырь — грушевидный мешковидный: The gallbladder is a pear-shaped, saccular organ in the right upper quadrant, about 7–10 cm long and 4 cm wide. It sits in a fossa between hepatic segments IV and V and is attached to the liver’s visceral surface by connective tissue.
Основной источник крови — пузырная артер: Arterial supply comes mainly from the cystic artery, usually a branch of the right hepatic artery. Small cystic veins drain into hepatic sinusoids and the gallbladder bed. Innervation comes via the hepatic plexus: parasympathetic fibers from the vagus nerve (CN X) and sympathetic fibers from the celiac plexus.
Развивается из печёночного дивертикула к: It develops from the caudal foregut hepatic diverticulum. Anatomic variants include agenesis and duplication. It is a frequent source of pathology and one of the most commonly resected organs in surgery.
Слои стенки изнутри наружу: слизистая об: Wall layers, inner to outer: mucosa (simple columnar epithelium with apical microvilli that absorb water and electrolytes), lamina propria, an irregular smooth muscle layer, perimuscular connective tissue and serosa or adventitia. The wall lacks a muscularis mucosae and a submucosa. Rokitansky–Aschoff sinuses are deep mucosal invaginations into the muscular layer; they can retain luminal contents and contribute to chronic wall inflammation.
Пузырь лежит вдоль сегментов IV и V; нас: The gallbladder lies along segments IV and V; it has no true capsule and its free surface is lined by visceral peritoneum. The fundus and body are expansile. The body narrows through an asymmetric infundibulum (Hartmann pouch) into a neck, which connects to the common bile duct via a single cystic duct in most cases. Spiral mucosal folds in the cystic duct (valves of Heister) modulate bile flow in response to neurohormonal stimuli. Fundal folding creates a Phrygian cap, a normal variant that can mimic wall thickening on imaging.
Пузырь хранит 30–50 мл жёлчи и участвует: The gallbladder stores 30–50 mL of bile and aids lipid digestion. Bile is made by hepatocytes and contains cholesterol, bilirubin, bile salts, phospholipids, water and electrolytes.
Растяжение желудка и обнаружение жирных: Gastric distension and duodenal enteroendocrine detection of fatty acids trigger cholecystokinin release; it causes fundal contraction and relaxation of the sphincter of Oddi, pushing bile through the valves of Heister and the sphincter into the duodenum.
Гиперхолестеринемия, гемолитические забо: Hypercholesterolemia, hemolytic disorders (e.g., sickle cell disease) and biliary infections alter bile composition, promoting crystallization and cholelithiasis. Stones range from microlithiasis or biliary sludge (“sand-like”) to stones over 3 cm; cholesterol stones are most common, while pigmented stones consist mainly of bilirubin derivatives and are often linked to hemolysis.
Правый и левый печёночные протоки соедин: The left and right hepatic ducts unite outside the liver to form the common hepatic duct; the cystic duct joins it to form the common bile duct. It runs inferiorly in the hepatoduodenal ligament, with the proper hepatic artery to its left and the portal vein posteriorly. Normal diameter is 4–7 mm; dilation may indicate distal obstruction from a stone, benign stricture or neoplasm of the bile duct, pancreatic head or ampulla.
Главный проток поджелудочной железы и об: The main pancreatic duct and the common bile duct join to form the hepatopancreatic ampulla (ampulla of Vater), encircled by the sphincter of Oddi; the sphincter regulates bile and pancreatic flow and prevents duodenal reflux.
Протоки Лушка — добавочные протоки, отво: Ducts of Luschka are accessory ducts draining the liver to the gallbladder or its fossa; they may be injured during cholecystectomy, potentially causing biloma. Loose fibrous bands called the peritoneal cholecystoduodenal fold may connect the gallbladder neck to the first part of the duodenum.
Пузырная артерия обычно — ветвь правой п: The cystic artery is typically a branch of the right hepatic artery, which arises from the proper hepatic artery; variants include posteriorly situated and accessory cystic arteries. The common bile duct has a segmental plexiform supply from the right hepatic, gastroduodenal, right gastric and posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal arteries; preserving these small vessels is essential, since disruption may cause ischemia, bile leak and stricture. Paracholedochal arteries run at the 3 and 9 o’clock positions and should be avoided when incising the common bile duct.
Главной пузырной вены обычно нет: венозн: No dominant cystic vein is typically present; venous drainage occurs through short venules directly into the gallbladder bed. Subserosal and submucosal lymphatics drain to the cystic lymph node of Lund (node of Calot) in the hepatocystic triangle; gallbladder carcinoma may bypass this node and spread directly to porta hepatis lymph nodes.
Печёночно-пузырный (Кало) треугольник со: The hepatocystic (Calot) triangle contains the cystic artery and the node of Lund; its boundaries are the cystic duct (right), the common hepatic duct (left) and the inferior liver surface (superior).
Вегетативные волокна доходят до пузыря и: Autonomic fibers reach the gallbladder and cystic duct through the hepatic plexus: parasympathetic from the vagus nerve and sympathetic from the celiac plexus. Visceral pain afferents generally travel with sympathetic fibers; diaphragmatic peritoneal irritation may refer pain to the right shoulder via the right phrenic nerve.
Операции на желудке (резекции, бариатрич: Gastric surgeries (resections, bariatric procedures, vagotomy for peptic ulcer disease) may denervate the gallbladder; the resulting dysfunction can lead to biliary stasis, cholelithiasis and cholecystitis, and prophylactic cholecystectomy may be considered.
К концу 4-й недели печёночная почка выст: By the end of week 4 a liver bud protrudes from the distal ventral foregut wall: the cranial part forms the liver and intrahepatic ducts, the caudal part forms the gallbladder and cystic duct, and the narrow connection with the duodenum becomes the extrahepatic bile duct system. The pancreas arises from dorsal and ventral buds. Around week 6, duodenal rotation moves the common bile duct and ventral pancreatic bud posteriorly, allowing the buds to fuse. The gallbladder and ducts canalize and bile production begins around week 12; the sphincter of Oddi develops during weeks 10–28.
Камни могут вызывать холелитиаз, холецис: Gallstones may cause cholelithiasis, cholecystitis, choledocholithiasis and ascending cholangitis. Obstruction of the cystic, biliary and pancreatic ducts, along with stasis, contraction and reflux, contributes to these conditions. Biliary pain can occur without stones, including in sphincter of Oddi dysfunction and acalculous cholecystitis. The gallbladder is distensible and may enlarge to about twice its size when the cystic duct is obstructed. Chronic diarrhea is a known complication after cholecystectomy.
Диагностика: лейкоциты, общий и фракцион: Labs: white blood cell count, total and fractionated bilirubin, lipase and amylase; imaging: ultrasound, HIDA scan with or without CCK, CT and MRCP. Treatment: cholecystectomy (open, laparoscopic or robotic; laparoscopic is safe and effective with shorter recovery), bile duct exploration, ERCP, percutaneous cholecystostomy and percutaneous transhepatic cholangiography.

It lies transversely in the upper abdomen, between the duodenum (right) and the spleen (left). It is divided into head, neck, body and tail.

Exocrine secretion (pancreatic juice from acinar cells) enters the duodenum via the main and accessory pancreatic ducts; endocrine secretions (glucagon and insulin from the islets of Langerhans) enter the blood.
Головка — расширенная часть, окружённая: The head is the enlarged portion surrounded by the C-shaped duodenal curve; the bile duct runs in a groove on its posterosuperior surface or is embedded in the gland. The neck is short.

The anterior surface of the body is covered by peritoneum; the posterior surface is not. The posterior body contacts the aorta, superior mesenteric artery, left suprarenal gland, left kidney and renal vessels.
Хвост лежит впереди левой почки, тесно с: The tail lies anterior to the left kidney and is closely related to the splenic hilum and left colic flexure.
Главный проток поджелудочной железы слив: The main pancreatic duct joins the bile duct to form the hepatopancreatic ampulla, opening into the descending duodenum. The sphincter of Oddi is a smooth muscle sphincter around the ampulla; it regulates the flow of bile and pancreatic juice and inhibits reflux of duodenal contents into the ductal system.
Около 80% железы — экзокринная ткань из: About 80% of the pancreas is exocrine tissue, made of acini formed by pyramidal acinar cells. Acinar cells have dense zymogen granules apically; the basolateral membranes have receptors for secretin, cholecystokinin and acetylcholine, which regulate enzyme exocytosis.
Островки Лангерганса содержат четыре тип: The islets of Langerhans contain four endocrine cell types: A cells — glucagon, B cells — insulin, D cells — somatostatin, F cells — pancreatic polypeptide. Their secretions enter the bloodstream via a capillary network. Stellate cells promote inflammation and fibrosis in chronic pancreatitis.
Железа развивается из эндодермы задней ч: The pancreas develops from posterior foregut endoderm. At about 4 weeks of gestation the dorsal and ventral buds form; around week 6 the ventral bud rotates around the developing duodenum; the buds fuse at about the 17th week. The dorsal bud gives the upper head, body and tail; the ventral bud gives the lower head and uncinate process.
Два протока: главный (вирсунгов) и добав: Two ducts drain the pancreas: the duct of Wirsung (major) and the duct of Santorini (minor). The ventral duct forms the proximal major duct, which opens via the ampulla of Vater; the dorsal duct forms part of the major duct and the minor (accessory) duct. The minor duct usually empties through the ampulla of Vater but may empty independently in about 5% of individuals.
Артерии: ветви селезёночной артерии (от: Arterial supply comes from branches of the splenic artery (from the celiac trunk), the superior mesenteric artery and the common hepatic artery. The gastroduodenal artery (from the common hepatic artery) supplies the head and uncinate process via the pancreaticoduodenal artery; the inferior head receives additional supply from the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery, a branch of the SMA. The body and tail are supplied by the splenic artery and its branches.

У железы есть парасимпатическая, симпати: The pancreas has parasympathetic, sympathetic and sensory innervation plus an intrinsic nerve plexus; sympathetic and parasympathetic fibers innervate acinar cells. Parasympathetic fibers arise from the posterior vagal trunk and act as secretomotor fibers. Secretion is mainly regulated by cholecystokinin and secretin, produced by duodenal and proximal intestinal mucosal epithelial cells and stimulated by acidic gastric contents. Sympathetic innervation comes from the T6 to T10 splanchnic nerves and the celiac plexus.
Частичная или дорсальная агенезия часто: Partial or dorsal agenesis is often asymptomatic and may be associated with diabetes, polysplenia, malabsorption syndrome or recurrent pancreatitis. Ectopic pancreatic tissue most often occurs in the stomach or small intestine (about 3% to 5% of the population), usually incidentally; rarely it may act as a lead point for intussusception or cause obstruction. Pancreatic dysgenesis or dysfunction is part of the Johanson–Blizzard and Shwachman–Diamond syndromes.
Разделённая поджелудочная железа (pancre: Pancreas divisum is the most common developmental anomaly (about 10% to 15%): the buds fail to fuse and the tail, body and part of the head drain through the accessory duct of Santorini; it has historically been associated with recurrent pancreatitis. Diagnosis: ERCP or MRCP, with endoscopic ultrasound increasingly used; for recurrent pancreatitis, stent insertion and sphincterotomy under ERCP guidance.
Кольцевидная поджелудочная железа — резу: Annular pancreas results from incomplete rotation of the ventral pancreatic bud and usually presents in infancy with complete or partial bowel obstruction; it is commonly associated with trisomy 21, tracheoesophageal fistula, malrotation, cardiac or renal anomalies; management is duodenojejunostomy. Choledochal cysts are congenital dilations of the biliary tract (jaundice, abdominal pain, sometimes fever).
Панкреатит связан с рецидивирующими камн: Pancreatitis is associated with recurrent gallstones, alcohol use, measles, mumps, medications, α1-antitrypsin deficiency and scorpion stings; it causes intense central abdominal pain radiating to the back, sometimes with jaundice, pale stools and dark urine.
Аденокарцинома поджелудочной железы труд: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma is difficult to treat and often diagnosed at a stage unsuitable for surgery; median age at diagnosis is 71 years. Established risk factors: smoking, obesity, diabetes, multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 and hereditary nonpolyposis colon cancer.
Сахарный диабет 1-го типа — аутоиммунное: Type 1 diabetes is autoimmune destruction of insulin-secreting cells, usually developing in childhood and requiring lifelong insulin; type 2 is the most common form, with hyperglycemia from insulin resistance combined with impaired insulin secretion; management is diet and physical activity plus pharmacotherapy such as metformin. Perforation releases amylase and lipase into the abdominal cavity, causing pancreatic self-digestion.

The name comes from Latin intestinum rectum, meaning straight intestine, which describes its course compared with the rest of the GI tract. It is the most posterior visceral organ in the pelvic cavity, with differing relations to male and female structures.

It differs from the colon in that the taeniae coli coalesce here to form the outer longitudinal muscle layer.

Three lateral flexures are formed by submucosal folds called valves of Houston, often two on the left and one on the right.
Ампула — конечный расширенный отдел, леж: The ampulla is the final, expanded segment resting on the pelvic diaphragm; the rectum transitions to the anal canal at the level of the levator ani muscle.
Покрытие брюшиной: верхняя треть — спере: Peritoneal coverage: the upper third is covered anteriorly and laterally; the middle third anteriorly only; the lower third is not covered by peritoneum and is enveloped by fascia propria, more pronounced laterally, forming the lateral rectal stalks. Posteriorly it is attached to the presacral fascia at S4 via Waldeyer fascia.
Брюшинная складка находится обычно на ра: The peritoneal reflection is variable, generally 6 to 8 cm from the anal verge: in men it forms the rectovesical pouch (reflection to the posterior bladder); in women the rectouterine pouch, also called the pouch of Douglas (reflection to the posterior cervix).
Слои изнутри наружу: слизистая, глубокий: Wall layers (lumen outward): mucosa, deep mucosa, submucosa, muscularis propria and serosa covered by peritoneum. The muscularis propria has inner circular and outer longitudinal layers; the inner circular layer thickens at the anorectal junction to form the internal anal sphincter, and the outer longitudinal layer continues as the longitudinal layer of the anal sphincter.
Функция: прежде всего временный резервуа: Function: primarily a temporary reservoir for feces; it also plays an integral role in controlling defecation and maintaining continence.
Мышцы тазового дна поддерживают прямую к: The pelvic floor muscles support the rectum and aid defecation and continence; the levator ani comprises much of the pelvic floor, consisting of the iliococcygeus, pubococcygeus and puborectalis muscles.
Нижняя брыжеечная артерия — самая дистал: The inferior mesenteric artery, the most distal branch of the abdominal aorta before its bifurcation, ends as the superior rectal (hemorrhoidal) arteries, which supply the rectum and upper third of the anal canal. The middle rectal artery (branch of the internal iliac artery) supplies the distal rectum and proximal anal canal; the inferior rectal artery arises from the internal pudendal artery (branch of the internal iliac artery). Collaterals between the inferior and superior hemorrhoidal arteries exist at the dentate line, making rectal ischemia uncommon.

Most rectal blood drains into the superior rectal vein, which reaches the portal system through the inferior mesenteric vein; the distal rectum and anal canal drain via the middle and inferior rectal veins into the internal iliac veins, via the pudendal vein.
Лимфа: от верхних прямокишечных сосудов: Lymph: superior rectal lymphatics drain to the retroperitoneal inferior mesenteric lymph nodes; middle and inferior hemorrhoidal vessels drain to the internal iliac nodes; below the dentate line, lymph drains to the inguinal nodes.
Симпатическая иннервация — поясничные вн: Sympathetic: derived from the lumbar splanchnic nerves, from the L1 through L2 nerve roots; preganglionic fibers follow the IMA to innervate the left colon and rectum, join to form the preaortic and superior hypogastric plexuses, and fibers from these plexuses enter the rectum laterally to supply the lower rectum.
Парасимпатическая иннервация начинается: Parasympathetic fibers originate in the sacral region and course anteriorly to join sympathetic fibers, forming the pelvic plexus; postganglionic parasympathetic and sympathetic fibers reach the rectum through the inferior mesenteric plexus. The sensation of rectal distension is carried by the parasympathetic system to the S2, S3 and S4 spinal nerves.
Прямая кишка развивается из задней кишки: The rectum derives from the hindgut; the hindgut also gives rise to the GI segment from the transverse colon down to the dentate line.
Опухоли верхней и средней трети можно уд: Tumors in the upper and middle third can be managed with sphincter-sparing procedures, such as low anterior resection. Tumors within 5 cm of the anal verge may require an abdominoperineal resection, removing the cancer, normal rectum and anal sphincter through the perineum and resulting in a permanent colostomy. Nerve injury can cause sexual dysfunction in men, presenting as erectile or ejaculatory dysfunction.
Места возможного повреждения нервов: у н: Potential sites of nerve injury: the origin of the IMA (the purely sympathetic hypogastric plexus) — injury during IMA pedicle ligation could cause retrograde ejaculation; posterior dissection outside the fascia propria — purely sympathetic damage because parasympathetic fibers have not yet joined; anterior dissection (the fascia between the rectum and prostate, alongside the seminal vesicles) — a narrow, hard-to-access space where mostly parasympathetic fibers can be damaged, causing impotence.
У мужчин предстательная железа лежит пер: In men the prostate sits anterior to the rectal wall, allowing manual palpation of nodules, shape and size during digital rectal examination (carcinoma screening). In women the cervix, uterus and vagina sit anterior to the rectum; digital rectal examination is often performed together with the manual pelvic exam. Weakening of the posterior vaginal wall can cause a rectocele, in which the rectum herniates into the vagina.

Официальное название по Terminologia Ana: The official Terminologia Anatomica name is “Appendix Vermiformis.” It is a true diverticulum arising from the posteromedial cecal border, close to the ileocecal valve. Its base can be reliably found near the convergence of the taeniae coli at the cecal tip. “Vermiform” is Latin for worm-like.
В отличие от приобретённого дивертикула: Unlike an acquired diverticulum, it contains all colonic layers: mucosa, submucosa, longitudinal and circular muscularis propria and serosa. Histologically, it is distinguished from the colon by the presence of B and T lymphoid cells in its mucosa and submucosa.
Длина от 5 до 35 см, в среднем 9 см. Фун: Length varies from 5 to 35 cm, averaging 9 cm. Its function has long been debated: mucosal neuroendocrine cells produce amines and hormones for biological control; lymphoid tissue contributes to B lymphocyte maturation and IgA antibody production. No clear evidence establishes its function in humans; gut-associated lymphoid tissue in the lamina propria suggests an immune role, but its specific nature is unidentified.
It has traditionally been regarded as vestigial. The “safe house” theory proposes that it stores symbiotic gut microbes that can repopulate the gut after severe diarrhea clears commensal bacteria, which weakens the vestigial view.
Устье отростка у основания слепой кишки: The appendiceal orifice at the cecal base is consistent, but the tip’s position is not. Tip positions include retrocecal (intraperitoneal), subcecal, pre-ileal, post-ileal, pelvic and extending into the hepatorenal recess. Posture, respiration and distention of adjacent bowel can alter its position. The retrocecal position is by far the most common and can complicate appendicitis diagnosis.
Агенезия, удвоение и утроение отростка в: Agenesis, duplication and triplication are rare. In pregnancy, the enlarging uterus pushes the appendix cephalad; by the end of the third trimester, appendicitis pain may be felt in the right upper quadrant.
Артерия отростка — конечная ветвь подвзд: The appendicular artery, a terminal branch of the ileocolic artery, supplies the appendix; the ileocolic artery is a branch of the superior mesenteric artery, consistent with the midgut origin. Lymph from the appendix and cecum drains to the ileocolic lymph nodes (cecal lymph through several intermediate mesenteric nodes, appendiceal lymph through a single intermediate node), then to the superior mesenteric nodes.
Вегетативная иннервация — от верхнего бр: Autonomic innervation arises from the superior mesenteric plexus. Afferent sensory fibers travel with sympathetic fibers and enter the spinal cord at T10, corresponding to the umbilical dermatome.
Отросток развивается из средней кишки. С: The appendix arises from the midgut. The cecal diverticulum, the precursor of the cecum and appendix, appears at week 6 and is histologically visible by 8 weeks of gestation. With colonic elongation, the cecum and appendix rotate medially with the midgut and descend into the right lower abdomen; the appendix is pushed ahead of the cecum and adopts various positions. During weeks 14 and 15 the mucosa develops lymphoid tissue.
Аппендэктомия при остром аппендиците — о: Appendectomy for acute appendicitis is one of the most frequent indications for emergency abdominal surgery. The convergence of the taeniae coli marks the appendiceal base; following the taeniae coli inferiorly helps locate and resect the appendix.
После постановки диагноза пациента остав: Once diagnosed, patients are kept NPO, given antibiotics and hydrated, with surgery usually the same day. Laparoscopic appendectomy is associated with less pain and faster recovery than open surgery, with similar long-term outcomes.
Патогенез сходен с другими полыми органа: Pathogenesis resembles that of other hollow viscera and is most often due to obstruction: a fecalith, sometimes a gallstone, tumor or worms; in young patients lymphoid hyperplasia is more common. Obstruction raises intraluminal pressure and compromises venous outflow. The appendicular artery is an end artery; when intraluminal pressure exceeds perfusion pressure, ischemia, bacterial overgrowth and inflammation follow. Perforation can spill bacteria into the abdominal cavity, making this a surgical emergency.
Воспалённые висцеральные афференты, вход: Inflamed visceral afferents entering at T8–T10 cause diffuse periumbilical pain and nausea; irritation of the parietal peritoneum produces more localized pain, depending on the tip’s position. A retrocecal appendix can cause right flank pain, elicited by extending the right hip. The psoas sign is pain from stretching the iliopsoas via hip extension in the left lateral decubitus position. McBurney’s sign is pain on palpation at McBurney’s point, two-thirds of the way from the umbilicus to the right anterior superior iliac spine. Signs and symptoms are not always present; common features include nausea, vomiting, low-grade fever and a slightly elevated white count.
Карциноид — самая частая опухоль отростк: Carcinoid tumor is the most common appendiceal cancer: it typically forms a 2–3 cm mass at the distal tip and is of neuroendocrine origin; it can secrete serotonin or other vasoactive substances, causing carcinoid syndrome (flushing, diarrhea, wheezing or right-sided valvular heart disease). Most arise in the distal third, rarely cause obstruction and may be asymptomatic; about 10% of neuroendocrine tumors arise at the base and can cause appendicitis.
Аденокарцинома отростка часто проявляетс: Appendiceal adenocarcinoma often presents like acute appendicitis, is seen in the elderly and is treated with simple appendectomy or right colectomy.

Брюшина — серозная оболочка, выстилающая: The peritoneum is a serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity, made of mesothelial cells supported by a thin layer of fibrous tissue, and it develops from mesoderm. It supports abdominal organs and serves as a passage for nerves, blood vessels and lymphatics.
У неё два листка с потенциальным простра: It has two layers with a potential space between them, containing about 50 to 100 mL of serous fluid that reduces friction and lets organs glide. The outer layer is the parietal peritoneum, attached to the abdominal and pelvic walls; the inner layer is the visceral peritoneum, which wraps the organs inside the intraperitoneal space.
Границы брюшинной полости: передние мышц: The boundaries of the peritoneal cavity are the anterior abdominal muscles, vertebrae, pelvic floor and diaphragm. The cavity contains the omentum, ligaments and mesentery.
Внутрибрюшинные органы: желудок, селезён: Intraperitoneal organs: the stomach, spleen, liver, first and fourth parts of the duodenum, jejunum, ileum, transverse colon and sigmoid colon. Retroperitoneal organs: the aorta, esophagus, second and third parts of the duodenum, ascending and descending colon, pancreas, kidneys, ureters and adrenal glands. Intraperitoneal organs are generally mobile, while retroperitoneal organs are usually fixed to the posterior abdominal wall.
Большой сальник свободно свисает от боль: The greater omentum hangs loosely from the greater curvature of the stomach, drapes over the intestines, then curves back superiorly to attach to the transverse colon; it acts as a protective or insulating layer.
Брыжейка прикрепляет органы к стенке жив: The mesentery attaches abdominal organs to the abdominal wall and contains blood vessels, nerves and lymphatics. The dorsal mesentery gives rise to the transverse and sigmoid mesocolons, which carry the blood, nerve and lymphatic supply to related structures.
Сальниковое (винслово) отверстие соединя: The epiploic foramen (foramen of Winslow) connects the greater and lesser sacs. Borders: the hepatoduodenal ligament (anterior), inferior vena cava (posterior), duodenum (inferior) and caudate lobe of the liver (superior). It gives surgeons access to clamp the hepatoduodenal ligament for hemorrhage control or to reach the lesser sac, and can be a site for a lesser sac hernia.
Брюшина происходит из мезодермы и подвеш: The peritoneum derives from mesoderm and suspends the primitive gut tube. Parietal peritoneum comes from somatic mesoderm; visceral peritoneum comes from splanchnic mesoderm. The gut tube is suspended by ventral and dorsal mesenteries, which extend the peritoneum to anchor the anterior and posterior abdominal walls.
Вентральная брыжейка превращается в малы: The ventral mesentery becomes the lesser omentum, divided into the gastrohepatic and hepatoduodenal ligaments; it contains the portal triad and is clinically relevant for hemorrhage control in trauma. The dorsal mesentery remains a mesentery, gives rise to the gastrosplenic ligament and greater omentum, and keeps midgut and foregut organs anchored to the posterior abdominal wall.
Париетальная брюшина получает кровь из с: The parietal peritoneum is supplied by abdominal wall vessels, including the iliac, lumbar, epigastric and intercostal arteries, and drains to the inferior vena cava. The visceral peritoneum is supplied by the superior and inferior mesenteric arteries and drains to the portal vein.
Париетальная брюшина иннервируется спинн: The parietal peritoneum is innervated by spinal nerves T10 to L1; this somatic supply transmits well-localized pain and temperature sensation. The visceral peritoneum receives autonomic innervation from the vagus nerve and sympathetic fibers, producing abdominal sensations triggered by organ distension that are difficult to localize. This explains the presentation of conditions such as peritonitis and appendicitis.
Паховая грыжа: лапароскопические методы: Inguinal hernia repair: laparoscopic approaches are named by their relation to the peritoneum — transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) and totally extraperitoneal (TEPP). In TAPP the peritoneum is opened, the hernia is repaired through the created defect and the defect is closed; in TEPP the peritoneum is left intact and the hernia sac is accessed and repaired from superficial to it.
Спайки возникают после инфекции, травмы: Adhesions arise from injury due to infection, trauma or surgery, can lead to small or large bowel obstruction and serve as a nidus for volvulus. Hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is under investigation for malignancies that originate in or have widely spread to the peritoneum. Major peritoneal defects are classically closed with slowly absorbable monofilament sutures; recent research suggests non-closure may improve outcomes in some cases, such as open appendectomy, cesarean section and gastric bypass.
Исследование FAST — УЗИ для быстрого обн: The FAST exam uses ultrasound to detect intraperitoneal fluid quickly and noninvasively in trauma; four windows are assessed: the hepatorenal recess (Morrison’s pouch), splenorenal recess, pelvis and pericardium. A positive finding (anechoic fluid) in a hemodynamically unstable patient suggests emergency surgery.
Перитонит — воспаление брюшины, часто св: Peritonitis is peritoneal inflammation, often linked to intestinal perforation and severe infection; other causes include free blood, gastric or pancreatic juices, medications and chemicals in the cavity. It may be localized or diffuse, typically presenting as an acute abdomen with rigidity, rebound tenderness or guarding. Treatment depends on the cause: all perforations need surgery, and infections need antibiotics. Mortality is highest in elderly patients.
Асцит — патологическое увеличение жидкос: Ascites is a pathologic increase of fluid in the peritoneal cavity (normally up to 100 mL) in conditions such as cirrhosis or chyle leaks. Cirrhotic ascites is attributed to portal hypertension, which increases vessel permeability and alters oncotic and hydrostatic pressures. Chylous ascites involves excess lymphatic fluid in the cavity, which may result from a chyle leak or from surgery or trauma.
Перитонеальный диализ: в брюшную полость: Peritoneal dialysis involves infusing a hypertonic fluid into the peritoneal cavity, allowing waste products to be absorbed, then draining the fluid; multiple cycles are performed. The most common complication is infection; another is bowel perforation during catheter insertion. The most common primary peritoneal malignancy is mesothelioma; cancer can spread to the peritoneum, causing peritoneal carcinomatosis; pseudomyxoma peritonei is a rarer manifestation, believed to originate from the appendix or colon. The peritoneum is used in ventriculoperitoneal shunts: excess cerebrospinal fluid is diverted to the peritoneum, where the body reabsorbs it.

Левая печёночная вена (20,7%) отводит кр: The left hepatic vein (20.7%) drains the left lobe; the middle (32.7%) drains the middle portions of the left and right lobes; the right (39.6%) drains the lateral right lobe. The caudate lobe usually drains into the middle hepatic vein; in some cases it drains directly into the retrohepatic inferior vena cava.

При портальной гипертензии венозный заст: Portal hypertension causes venous congestion at portocaval anastomoses, which can lead to esophageal varices, rectal hemorrhoids and caput medusae. A shunt procedure (TIPS) connects the portal vein to the inferior vena cava to relieve portal venous congestion.
Синдром Бадда–Киари — блокада печёночног: Budd–Chiari syndrome is blockage of hepatic venous drainage by thrombosis of one or more major hepatic veins; consider it in patients with hypercoagulable states presenting with portal hypertension signs (ascites, jaundice, varices). Right heart failure can produce similar signs through inferior vena cava backup, but these patients do not have Budd–Chiari syndrome.

Почки лежат между поперечными отростками: The kidneys lie between the transverse processes of T12 and L3; the upper poles are slightly medial and posterior relative to the lower poles. The right kidney sits slightly lower, displaced by the liver.
Размер почки положительно связан с площа: Kidney size correlates positively with body surface area, height and weight; it decreases with age from parenchymal loss.

Верхний полюс лежит кпереди от диафрагмы: The upper pole lies anterior to the diaphragm (covering its upper third) and is often crossed by the 12th rib; the lower pole lies anterior to the psoas and lateral to the quadratus lumborum.
