Левая почка: кзади от нисходящей ободочн: Left kidney: posterior to the descending colon, the tail of the pancreas (which may cover the hilum), the greater curvature of the stomach and the spleen (via the splenorenal ligament).
Нижние полюса расположены латеральнее, к: The lower poles are more lateral, anterior and farther apart than the upper poles, which makes them more prone to trauma.
Ворота почки — медиальный край: через ни: Renal hilum (medial margin): the artery enters; the vein and pelvis exit. The renal vein lies anterior to the artery; the renal pelvis lies posterior to both.
Капсула двухслойная; почка окружена окол: The capsule is two-layered; the kidney is surrounded by perinephric fat, Gerota fascia (anterior) and Zuckerkandl fascia (posterior). “Gerota fascia” often refers to both.
Околопочечная клетчатка толще всего по к: Perinephric fat is thickest at the kidney borders and extends into the renal sinus.
Забрюшинное пространство лежит между зад: The retroperitoneum lies between the posterior parietal peritoneum and the posterior abdominal wall. Its contents include the pancreas (except its tail), the ascending and descending colon, the duodenum (except the 1st segment), the adrenals, the kidneys, the ureters, the renal vessels, the abdominal aorta, the IVC and the posterior bladder wall.
Кора — наружный слой: почечные тельца, п: The cortex is the outer layer: renal corpuscles, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, collecting tubules and cortical collecting ducts. Renal columns (of Bertin) are cortical extensions flanking the pyramids toward the sinus.
Мозговое вещество лежит между корой и па: The medulla lies between the cortex and the sinus and is organized into pyramids with medullary rays (limbs of the loop of Henle, medullary collecting ducts).
Каждая доля открывается одним сосочком (: Each lobe drains through one papilla (area cribrosa) into a minor calyx; there are on average about 9 lobes per kidney. A pyramid plus its overlying cortex forms a renal lobe.
Собирательная система: в 70% почек 7–9 м: Collecting system: most kidneys (70%) have 7–9 minor calyces, with 2 or 3 converging into a major calyx. A simple calyx drains one papilla; a compound calyx drains several (more common in the upper poles). Major calyces unite into the funnel-shaped renal pelvis, which continues as the proximal ureter; the pelvis typically receives 2 or 3 major calyces, each drained by 2 or 3 minor calyces (variable).
Нефронов в одной почке взрослого около 1: There are about 1–1.5 million nephrons per adult kidney, occasionally over 2.5 million. The afferent arteriole supplies the glomerulus, enclosed by the double-layered Bowman capsule (together, the renal corpuscle); the efferent arteriole gives rise to the peritubular capillaries and vasa recta.
Отделы нефрона: проксимальный извитой ка: Nephron segments: proximal convoluted tubule, proximal straight tubule (thick descending limb), thin descending limb, thin ascending limb, distal straight tubule (thick ascending limb), distal convoluted tubule, collecting duct. Collecting ducts continue as medullary, then papillary ducts, which open at the area cribrosa into the renal pelvis.
Выводит аммиак и мочевину; регулирует на: Excretes ammonia and urea; regulates sodium, potassium and calcium; maintains acid-base balance via hydrogen ion excretion and bicarbonate reabsorption.
Регулирует артериальное давление и объём: Regulates blood pressure and intravascular volume via the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system.
Реабсорбирует глюкозу, аминокислоты, фос: Reabsorbs glucose, amino acids, phosphate, calcium and water.
Вырабатывает эритропоэтин (стимулирует о: Secretes erythropoietin (stimulates red cell production) and calcitriol (active vitamin D; regulates calcium and phosphate).
Почка развивается из промежуточной мезод: The kidney develops from intermediate mesoderm in three phases: pronephros, mesonephros and metanephros.
Пронефрос — шейный, нефункциональный, по: The pronephros is cervical and nonfunctional, and appears transiently in week 4. The mesonephros spans the upper thoracic to upper lumbar regions; about 40 pairs of functional units drain into the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct, which empties into the early cloaca; it is fully formed by week 6 and regresses between weeks 8 and 10. In males the mesonephric duct is retained and forms the epididymis, vas deferens, seminal vesicles and ejaculatory ducts.
Метанефрос появляется на 5-й неделе из м: The metanephros appears in week 5 from metanephric mesoderm and gives rise to the permanent kidney; it depends on reciprocal interaction between the metanephric blastema and the ureteric bud. The transcription factor WT1 regulates these signals; WT1 mutations are linked to Wilms tumor and Denys-Drash, Frasier and WAGR syndromes.
Расширение мочеточникового выпячивания о: Dilation of the ureteric bud forms the renal pelvis and ureter, which split into major calyces by the end of week 6; early splitting can produce a bifid ureter. At week 7 the buds from the calyces divide into collecting tubules, which become the minor calyces.
Около 60% нефронов формируются во второй: About 60% of nephrons form in the latter half of gestation; nephrons become functional by week 12. At birth there are about 1 million per kidney (range 250,000 to over 2 million). A low nephron count is linked to later susceptibility to renal disease and kidney failure.
Почка поднимается из области S1–S2 до ур: The kidney ascends from S1–S2 to T12–L3 and rotates 90° so that the hilum faces medially.
Подковообразная почка: нижние полюса сра: Horseshoe kidney: the lower poles are fused, typically anterior to the aorta; fusion restricts ascent (obstruction by the superior mesenteric artery), leaving an atypical lower midline position with anterior-facing pelves. It occurs in about 1 in 400 individuals; linked to UPJ obstruction, nephrolithiasis and urinary tract infection; severe, mainly urogenital, malformations in about 23% of cases.
Тазовая почка — следствие нарушения подъ: Ectopic (pelvic) kidney results from failed fetal ascent in weeks 6–8, about 1 in 12,000, often found incidentally; the adrenal glands remain in their normal position. The pancake (fused pelvic) kidney is a rare variant in which both kidneys unite completely into a single pelvic mass.
Внутрипочечные артерии — концевые, с мин: Intrarenal arteries are end arteries with minimal or no significant collateral circulation; accessory renal arteries must be preserved, as each supplies a discrete region.
Линия Бродела — относительно бессосудист: The Brodel line is a relatively avascular zone between the anterior and posterior renal end arteries, running longitudinally just posterior to the lateral convex border; it is the optimal site for nephrostomy or incision to minimize blood loss.
Сберегающие нефрон операции (частичная н: Nephron-sparing surgery (partial nephrectomy, percutaneous ablation) is first-line for small renal masses.

Почки получают около 20% сердечного выбр: The kidneys receive about 20% of cardiac output, or 1–1.1 L/min. With a GFR of 120 mL/min, about 180 L/day is filtered; urine output is about 1.5 L/day, so 178.5 L must be reabsorbed.
Почечные артерии отходят от аорты чуть н: The renal arteries arise from the aorta just below the superior mesenteric artery and enter the hilum at L2. The artery is usually single but may be duplicated or accompanied by accessory arteries; all are end arteries that must be preserved in surgery or transplantation.
Правая почечная артерия длиннее и проход: The right renal artery is longer and passes posterior to the IVC. It divides into an anterior branch (receiving 75% of renal flow) and a posterior branch, which becomes the posterior segmental artery. The first branch is typically the inferior suprarenal artery (variable).
Передняя ветвь делится на четыре сегмент: The anterior branch divides into four segmental arteries: superior (apical), anterosuperior, anteroinferior and inferior.
Сегментарные артерии делятся на междолев: Segmental arteries divide into interlobar arteries (between calyces), arcuate arteries (at the base of the pyramids) and interlobular arteries (in the cortex). The interlobular arteries form afferent arterioles, peritubular capillaries, efferent arterioles and vasa recta. Some branches supply the capsule, renal pelvis and proximal ureter.
Добавочные почечные артерии есть примерн: Accessory renal arteries are present in about 20–30% of people: they arise from the main renal artery, the aorta or aberrant sources; they are end arteries with no intrarenal anastomoses, so they are not supplemental, and may contribute to UPJ obstruction. The most common is an extrahilar branch to the superior pole.
Почечные вены зеркально повторяют артери: The renal veins mirror the arteries anteriorly. The left renal vein is several centimeters longer, crossing the midline to reach the IVC (to the right of the aorta) at L2 or L3. This length difference often favors selecting the left kidney for transplantation.
Синдром «щелкунчика» — сдавление левой п: Nutcracker syndrome is compression of the left renal vein between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta; it presents with nonspecific symptoms: abdominal pain, hypotension, intermittent flank pain and microscopic hematuria.
Левая яичковая (гонадная) вена впадает в: The left testicular (gonadal) vein drains into the higher-pressure left renal vein, the right into the lower-pressure IVC; this explains the higher prevalence of left-sided varicoceles. An isolated right varicocele may signal IVC obstruction, possibly from tumor thrombus extending from the right renal vein.
Позадиаортальная левая почечная вена (ле: A retroaortic left renal vein (left renal venous drainage passing posterior to the aorta) has an incidence of 1.7%–2.5%.
Лимфа от почек (и, возможно, проксимальн: Renal (and possibly proximal ureteral) lymphatic channels enter the aortic lymphatic chain on the left and the right lateral IVC lymphatics on the right.
Почечное нервное сплетение иннервирует п: The renal nerve plexus innervates the kidneys, the suprarenal glands and part of the proximal ureters; it contains sympathetic and parasympathetic fibers and receives input from the abdominopelvic splanchnic nerves.
Симпатические эфферентные волокна иннерв: Sympathetic efferents supply nephrons and renal vasculature only, densest around afferent arterioles, thick ascending limbs and distal convoluted tubules. Preganglionic fibers arise from T8–L1 and synapse in the inferior mesenteric ganglion; postganglionic fibers follow the renal artery and vein.
Активация симпатических волокон усиливае: Sympathetic activation increases sodium retention, renin release and renal vasoconstriction, contributing to hypertension. Transcatheter renal denervation (renal arterial ultrasound or radiofrequency ablation) is used for resistant hypertension; it is contraindicated with significant renal artery stenosis, kidney transplants, untreated secondary hypertension, GFR below 40 mL/min or solitary kidneys.
Чувствительные афферентные волокна (меха: Sensory afferents (mechanoreceptors and chemoreceptors) arise from the renal cortex and proximal ureter, densest in the renal pelvis walls; there are no sensory fibers in the medulla. They follow the renal artery to the ipsilateral dorsal root ganglia T12–L3.
Висцеральная боль идёт по симпатическим: Visceral afferent pain travels via sympathetic pathways to the T11–L2 spinal segments and is often referred to the corresponding dermatome, so flank discomfort may originate from the kidney. Renal pain usually results from stretching (obstruction, dilation), inflammation, infection or ischemia; nonobstructing calculi generally do not cause flank pain or renal colic.
Заболевания почек по гистологическому ко: Renal disease by histologic compartment: glomerular (inflammatory glomerulonephritis — nephritic syndrome with hematuria, hypertension, reduced GFR and proteinuria below 3.5 g/day; noninflammatory glomerulopathy — nephrotic syndrome with proteinuria above 3.5 g/day, hypoalbuminemia and edema), tubular, interstitial and vascular.
Показаны почки, мочеточники и мочевой пу: The kidneys, ureters and urinary bladder are shown (BodyParts3D 3.0). The wall layers and the segments of the ureter are not separated in the model. The skeleton is shown semi-transparent.
Мочеточники — парные тонкие мышечные тру: The ureters are paired, thin muscular tubes about 3 to 4 mm in diameter that carry urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder; their muscular layers produce peristalsis.
Мочеточник начинается на лоханочно-мочет: The ureter begins at the ureteropelvic junction (UPJ), posterior to the renal vein and artery in the hilum; it descends retroperitoneally, passes anterior to the psoas, enters the pelvis at the iliac bifurcation, follows the posterolateral pelvic wall and enters the bladder posterolaterally at the trigone.
Средняя длина у взрослого — около 26 см: The average adult length is 26 cm (range 22 to 30 cm); the course is S-shaped.
ЛМС расположено примерно на уровне L2, г: The UPJ lies at about L2, where the renal pelvis narrows into the ureter. At the iliac bifurcation the ureter crosses the iliac vessels within the cleft between the external and internal iliac arteries; it is fixed here and enters the pelvic brim at an acute angle. This is one of the few spots where the ureter can reliably be found during open surgery.
Физиологические сужения (места застреван: Narrowings where renal calculi can lodge: the UPJ and the ureterovesical junction (UVJ); later sections of the article describe three, including the iliac bifurcation.
Проксимальный (брюшной) отдел — от лохан: The proximal (abdominal) segment runs from the renal pelvis to the iliac bifurcation. It sits mostly in retroperitoneal fat, except where it crosses the psoas, so it is hard to identify surgically; the genitofemoral nerve lies on the psoas just posterior to it. The ureter usually runs inferior to the gonadal vessels, which cross anterior to it about one-third of the way down.
Дистальный (тазовый) отдел — от бифуркац: The distal (pelvic) segment runs from the iliac bifurcation to the bladder: it turns sharply posteriorly on entering the pelvis, then curves back and follows the lateral pelvic wall to the posterolateral bladder.
Внутристеночный отдел длиной около 2 см: The intramural segment, about 2 cm long, is buried in the bladder wall and covered by Waldeyer sheath; it is aperistaltic, the narrowest part and the most common site of ureteral stone obstruction.
Правый мочеточник лежит около восходящей: The right ureter lies near the ascending colon, cecum and appendix; the left lies near the descending and sigmoid colon.
У мужчин мочеточник проходит позади семя: In men the ureter passes posterior to the vas deferens and anterior to the seminal vesicles. In women it passes inferior to the insertion of the infundibulopelvic ligament, then posterior to the ovaries and fallopian tubes; it lies about 2.5 cm posterior to the uterine artery and travels with it and the inferior hypogastric nerve plexus in the cardinal ligament, passing close to the cervix.
Слои: слизистая, мышечная оболочка и нар: Layers: mucosa, muscularis and outer adventitia. The mucosa is a stratified transitional epithelium over a thick fibroelastic lamina propria; together they form a watertight barrier. There is no submucosa and there are no glandular elements.
Мышечная оболочка состоит из гладкомышеч: The muscularis consists of smooth muscle fibers in several orientations, arranged as inner longitudinal, middle circular and outer longitudinal layers.
Клетки-водители ритма, запускающие перис: Pacemaker cells that start peristalsis lie in the minor calyces of the proximal renal pelvis; peristalsis travels down the ureter and fades at the UVJ, where the circular layer disappears. The adventitia is an outer fibroelastic layer housing blood vessels, lymphatics and nerves.
Антирефлюксный механизм: мочеточник косо: Antireflux valve: the ureter crosses the detrusor obliquely to form the intramural segment, which prevents backflow during detrusor contraction. The ureteral orifices are about 2.5 cm apart when the bladder is empty and up to 5 cm apart when it is full.
Кровоснабжение сегментарное: верхний отд: The blood supply is segmental: the upper ureter from the renal arteries; the middle ureter from branches of the abdominal aorta, the common iliac and gonadal arteries; the distal ureter from branches of the internal iliac artery (vesical and uterine). Arteries reach the abdominal ureter from the medial side.
Артерии образуют вдоль мочеточника анаст: The arteries form an anastomotic plexus along the ureter. This allows safe mobilization during surgery, but the ureter should not be resected at both proximal and distal levels at once, as this would severely compromise its blood supply.
Вены и лимфатические сосуды повторяют хо: Venous and lymphatic drainage mirrors the arterial supply. Lymph drains to the internal, external and common iliac nodes; left ureteral lymph drains to the left paraaortic nodes, right ureteral lymph mainly to the right paracaval and interaortocaval nodes.
Движущая сила перистальтики — собственны: The drive for peristalsis comes from intrinsic smooth muscle pacemaker sites located in the minor calyces; the exact role of innervation is unclear.
Симпатическая: преганглионарные волокна: Sympathetic: preganglionic fibers from T10–L2, postganglionic fibers from the aorticorenal, superior hypogastric and inferior hypogastric plexuses. Parasympathetic: S2–S4 pelvic splanchnic nerves. The T12–L2 roots form the ureteric plexus; ureteral pain refers to the T12–L2 dermatomes.
На 4-й неделе из нефрогенного тяжа образ: At week 4 the nephrogenic cord gives rise to the pronephros, the mesonephros with the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct, and the metanephros (the permanent kidney). The ureter forms from the ureteric bud of the mesonephric duct near the cranial end of the metanephros; collecting tubules fuse to form the major calyces.
Врождённая обструкция ЛМС: сужение, пере: Congenital UPJ obstruction: the ureter is narrowed, kinked or scarred at the UPJ; it is twice as common in males, the left side is affected twice as often as the right, with an estimated incidence of 1 in 1,000 to 1,500 children. Aberrant vessels from the lower pole of the kidney cross the UPJ and can obstruct the ureter.
Позадикавальный мочеточник (предмочеточн: Retrocaval ureter (preureteral vena cava): the right ureter is trapped posteriorly; incidence is about 1 in 1,100, and symptoms typically appear from the 3rd or 4th decade onward.
Удвоение мочеточника: неполное (раздвоен: Ureteral duplication: incomplete (bifid ureter) or complete (each ureter enters the bladder separately). By the Meyer-Weigert rule the upper moiety drains to the more distal, medial, inferior orifice and the lower moiety to the superior, lateral orifice; the medial, inferior ureter is typically obstructed, the lateral one is prone to reflux.
Эктопированный мочеточник открывается не: An ectopic ureter does not enter the bladder at the trigone: in males it may open at the bladder neck or prostatic urethra, in females into the vestibule or vagina; incontinence often results because there is no sphincter mechanism.
Пузырно-мочеточниковый рефлюкс: короткий: Vesicoureteral reflux: a short or functionally incompetent intramural ureter allows urine to flow backward toward the kidneys; up to one-third of recurrent UTIs in children involve it. Grades I and II may resolve as the bladder grows; grade III or higher usually causes scarring and generally requires surgery.
Большинство повреждений мочеточника ятро: Most ureteral injuries are iatrogenic, with an overall incidence of 0.5% to 10%. Hysterectomy is the most common procedure associated with inadvertent injury (54%) because the uterine artery lies close to the distal ureter: each ureter lies about 2 cm from the cervix, and in 12% of women the distance is under 0.5 cm. Laparoscopic hysterectomy causes more injuries than open hysterectomy.
Типичные места повреждения в гинекологии: Common injury sites in gynecologic surgery: the pelvic brim, the cardinal ligament at the cervix where the ureter crosses the uterine artery, the anterolateral vaginal fornix, the uterosacral ligaments if thickened by endometriosis, the broad ligament during hemostatic sutures and the hypogastric artery during ligation. In general surgery, colonic procedures are the most frequent cause.
Чтобы найти мочеточник, его прослеживают: To find the ureter, trace it from a known landmark (UPJ, iliac bifurcation or UVJ). Injury is diagnosed with intraoperative indigo carmine dye, creatinine testing of suspicious surgical-field fluid and retrograde pyelogram. Treatment is stenting, with or without direct repair; length can be restored by reimplantation, psoas hitch or Boari flap.
Боковой доступ к брюшной стенке открывае: A lateral abdominal incision exposes the proximal ureter, and a medial pelvic incision exposes the distal ureter.
Три физиологических сужения — самые част: The three physiologic narrowings are the most common sites of obstruction; in a retrospective study of 94 emergency department patients with colic, 60.6% of renal stones were at the UVJ.

Мочевой пузырь — расположенный подбрюшин: The bladder is a subperitoneal, hollow muscular organ that serves as a urine reservoir. It sits in the lesser pelvis when empty and extends into the abdominal cavity when full; in children it lies in the abdomen and does not fully descend into the pelvis until puberty.
Растяжимый, вмещает до 500 мл мочи. Ёмко: It is distensible and typically holds up to 500 mL of urine. Pediatric bladder size can be estimated as (Age + 2) × 30 mL.
Пузырь лежит сразу позади лобкового симф: It lies just posterior to the pubic symphysis. Posterior relations: the anterior vaginal wall in females and the rectum in males; inferiorly the pelvic diaphragm muscles support it. It is relatively free within the subperitoneal fat, except for fixed ligamentous connections at the bladder neck.
Верхняя и часть задней поверхности покры: The superior and part of the posterior surfaces are covered by peritoneum; the inferior and inferolateral portions are covered by endopelvic fascia. Above, it is continuous with the ureters; below, with the urethra.
Четыре части: верхушка (купол) — передне: Four anatomical parts: the apex (dome), the anterosuperior part pointing toward the abdominal wall; the body, the large area between the apex and the fundus; the fundus (base), the posteroinferior part; and the neck, the constricted part leading to the urethra.
Пустой пузырь имеет складчатую внутренню: The empty bladder has an undulating interior, except for the triangular trigone, which is bounded by the two ureteric openings and the internal urethral orifice; the trigone contains stretch receptors that sense bladder fullness.
Между пузырём и лобковой костью лежит за: A fat-filled potential space, the pre-vesical space (space of Retzius), lies between the bladder and the pubic bone.
Моча поступает из почек по мочеточникам: Urine passes from the kidneys through the ureters and the ureterovesical junction into the bladder. As it fills, sensory nerves signal the CNS, which coordinates efferent somatic and autonomic nerves; voiding involves detrusor stimulation with simultaneous relaxation of the internal and external urethral sphincters.
Детрузор — основная мышца пузыря (гладка: The detrusor is the primary bladder muscle (smooth muscle), lined by transitional epithelium (urothelium), a stratified epithelium whose cells are round and large when empty and flatten as the bladder fills. The detrusor has muscarinic (M3, parasympathetic) and beta-adrenergic (sympathetic) receptors.
Внутренний сфинктер уретры — гладкая мыш: The internal urethral sphincter is smooth muscle at the bladder neck, with alpha-adrenergic receptors; constriction aids filling, relaxation aids voiding.
Наружный сфинктер уретры — поперечнополо: The external urethral sphincter is striated skeletal muscle with nicotinic receptors, controlled by the pudendal nerve; pudendal fibers fire continuously to keep it closed until voiding is appropriate, and toilet training teaches voluntary control of this sphincter.
Артерии: верхняя и нижняя пузырные — неп: Arterial supply: the superior and inferior vesical arteries, indirect branches of the internal iliac arteries; additionally the obturator artery and the inferior gluteal artery. The inferior vesical artery may sometimes arise from the internal pudendal artery.
Венозный отток — в пузырное венозное спл: Venous drainage is through the vesical venous plexus into the internal iliac vein. Lymph drains to nodes along nearby veins, mainly the external iliac lymph nodes.
Парасимпатическая иннервация — крестцовы: Parasympathetic: sacral S2–S4, forming the pelvic splanchnic nerves. Sympathetic: T10–L2, via the superior and inferior hypogastric plexuses and nerves. Somatic: the pudendal nerve (S2–S4, from the sacral plexus) controls the external urethral sphincter voluntarily; pudendal motor neurons arise from Onuf nucleus in the sacral ventral horn.
Рецепторы растяжения стенки передают сиг: Stretch receptors in the bladder wall send signals via general visceral afferent fibers in the hypogastric and pelvic splanchnic nerves; superior wall sensation follows sympathetic pathways, inferior wall sensation follows parasympathetic pathways. The pontine micturition center (brainstem) regulates filling and voiding.
В целом парасимпатическая активность спо: Generally, parasympathetic activity promotes emptying (detrusor contraction and internal sphincter relaxation); sympathetic activity promotes filling (detrusor relaxation and internal sphincter constriction). During filling, spinal reflexes dominate: stretch signals activate sympathetic output via the hypogastric nerves, parasympathetic output is inhibited, and pudendal output keeps the external sphincter closed.
При полном пузыре сигналы достигают мост: With a full bladder, signals reach the pontine center, which activates parasympathetic output and inhibits sympathetic tone, enabling voiding; cortical input acts via the pontine micturition center (PMC) and periaqueductal gray (PAG) to delay voiding until appropriate.
Произвольный контроль формируется в 2–4: Voluntary control develops at about 2–4 years; before this, voiding occurs through spinal reflexes triggered at a specific bladder volume.

Мочеиспускание: моча из пузыря поступает: Urination: urine drains from the bladder into the bladder neck, where the internal urethral sphincter relaxes (involuntary, parasympathetic control); it passes into the prostatic and membranous urethra, the external sphincter relaxes, and urine moves into the spongy penile urethra, then the navicular fossa, and exits through the external urethral orifice.
Луковично-губчатые мышцы пересекают выхо: The bulbospongiosus muscles cross the pelvic outlet and intersect with the superficial transverse perineal muscles; they support the perineal body and pelvic viscera, compress the bulb and corpus spongiosum (which can help empty the spongy urethra) and can compress the deep dorsal veins, reducing drainage from the cavernous spaces.
Ножки окружены седалищно-пещеристой мышц: The crura are encircled by the ischiocavernosus muscle, which can pump blood into the distal corpora cavernosa to help maintain erection and compress the deep dorsal vein as it leaves the crus, restricting venous outflow.
Главный источник — ветви внутренних поло: The main blood supply is branches of the internal pudendal arteries. Dorsal arteries run along the dorsal vein between the corpora cavernosa and supply the fibrous tissue around the corpora cavernosa, the corpus spongiosum, the spongy urethra and the penile skin. Deep arteries run through the center of each corpus cavernosum and supply its erectile tissue; helicine arteries branch from them and are coiled when the penis is flaccid. Arteries of the bulb supply the bulbous corpus spongiosum, the urethra and the bulbourethral gland. Superficial and deep branches of the external pudendal arteries supply the penile skin.
Глубокая дорсальная вена получает кровь: The deep dorsal vein receives blood from the venous plexus, which drains the cavernous spaces; the superficial dorsal vein drains skin and subcutaneous tissue.
Лимфа: от кожи члена и всей промежности,: Lymphatic drainage: penile skin and all of the perineum, except the glans, drain to the superficial inguinal nodes; the intermediate and proximal urethra and the cavernous bodies drain to the internal iliac nodes; the distal spongy urethra and glans drain to the deep inguinal nodes.
Иннервация — сегменты S2–S4 через тазовы: Innervation comes from spinal segments S2 to S4 via the pelvic splanchnic nerves and the pudendal nerves. The dorsal nerve of the penis, a branch of the pudendal nerve, provides sympathetic and sensory innervation to the skin and glans; the glans has abundant sensory nerve endings. The root of the penis is innervated by the ilioinguinal nerve. Cavernous nerves carry parasympathetic fibers to the helicine arteries, which supply the erectile tissue.
Половой член развивается из полового буг: The male penis develops from the genital tubercle, which becomes the phallus under androgen influence from the testis. Elongation draws the urethral folds forward to form the lateral walls of the urethral groove, and the groove's epithelium forms the urethral plate. The penile urethra forms when the urethral folds enclose the urethral plate, usually near the end of month 3; the most distal urethra forms at the end of month 4. The two urethral folds fuse to form the spongy body, and two cavernous bodies then arise above it.
Гипоспадия — довольно частый врождённый: Hypospadias is a fairly common congenital variant: the external urethral orifice opens on the ventral glans or shaft because of incomplete fusion of the urogenital folds. Epispadias is less common: the meatus is on the dorsal surface, most commonly associated with bladder exstrophy. Phimosis: the prepuce fits too tightly over the glans to be retracted. Micropenis: stretched penile length, measured dorsally from the pubis to the tip, is 2.5 SDs below the mean (insufficient androgen stimulation in the fetal period). Chordee is a ventral curvature that develops in the fetal period and is most noticeable during erection.
Эректильная дисфункция — неспособность д: Erectile dysfunction is the inability to achieve or maintain an erection, and the most common penile disorder; it may stem from psychological stress, organic disease or both. Risk factors: obesity, smoking, atherosclerotic disease, physical inactivity, obstructive sleep apnea, diabetes and medications (antidepressants and antihypertensives are common drug classes). Vascular disease is the most common cause; first-line treatment is a PDE5 inhibitor (sildenafil, vardenafil or tadalafil), which increases nitric oxide–induced vasodilation by raising cyclic GMP; PDE5 inhibitors are contraindicated with nitrates because combined vasodilation can cause severe hypotension.
Болезнь Пейрони — аномальное искривление: Peyronie disease is an abnormal penile curvature that is usually benign but may cause painful erections or ED; the cause is unknown, with evidence suggesting repeated microtrauma leads to fibrin deposition, and fibrous plaques contain excess collagen. Diagnosis is usually clinical, though imaging may help.

Матка — полый грушевидный орган, участву: The uterus is a hollow, pear-shaped organ involved in gestation, menstruation and labor. On coronal section, the cavity looks like an inverted triangle.
Лежит в женском тазу позади мочевого пуз: It sits in the female pelvis, behind the bladder and in front of the rectum. It has four segments from superior to inferior: the fundus, the broad curved upper region where the fallopian tubes connect (it lies above the tubal openings); the corpus (body), which begins below the level of the tubes and is the largest; the isthmus, the narrowed segment at the lower end of the uterus; and the cervix, which projects downward from the isthmus into the vagina.
Размеры: около 8 см в длину, 5 см в шири: Average dimensions: about 8 cm long, 5 cm wide and 4 cm thick; cavity volume 80 mL to 200 mL. It measures about 3 × 2 × 1 inches in a nulliparous woman; in late pregnancy it can extend to the epigastric region through myometrial hypertrophy and hyperplasia.
Функция: обеспечивает имплантацию и разв: Function: supports implantation and fetal development. After fertilization, the ovum travels through the fallopian tube and implants in the endometrium, which nourishes it through specialized vessels; the uterus expands as the fetus grows, and during labor coordinated contractions and cervical dilation enable delivery.
Три слоя. Эндометрий (внутренняя оболочк: The wall has three layers. The endometrium (inner lining): the superficial functional layer responds to reproductive hormones, and shedding it causes menstrual bleeding; the deeper basal layer, damage to which may cause intrauterine adhesions and fibrosis (Asherman syndrome). The myometrium: the middle layer of smooth muscle that contracts during labor. The serosa (perimetrium): the thin outer layer of epithelial cells.
Шейка матки — короткая широкая цилиндрич: The cervix is the short, broad, cylindrical lower part extending from the internal to the external os, with a narrow central lumen. The external os is circular in nulliparous women and a horizontal slit in multiparous women, dividing the cervix into anterior and posterior lips. The narrow upper third is the isthmus, the lower uterine segment used for lower segment cesarean sections.
Положение матки варьирует: наклон кперед: Position varies: anteverted, retroverted, anteflexed, retroflexed or midline, and it may rotate, especially in pregnancy. About 50% of women have an anteflexed and anteverted uterus; about 80% have anteversion (a uterus at a right angle to the vagina, tilted forward) and about 20% retroversion (tilted backward over the vagina).
Anteversio — почти прямой угол между дли: Anteversion is the near-right-angle relation between the cervix's long axis and the vagina; anteflexion is an obtuse angle of about 120° to 125° between the body and the cervix; the body sits in the vesicouterine space. Rarely, the uterus is retroverted-retroflexed, with the body in the pouch of Douglas.
Связки: маточно-яичниковая, круглая, шир: Support ligaments: utero-ovarian, round, broad, cardinal and uterosacral. Additional inferior support: the pelvic diaphragm, the urogenital diaphragm and the perineal body.
Ретроверсия или ретрофлексия может быть: A retroverted or retroflexed uterus may be linked to pelvic pain, dyspareunia, mild urinary incontinence, infertility and difficulty inserting tampons; in pregnancy it can lead to uterine incarceration.
Около 8-й недели появляются зачатки внут: Around week 8 of gestation, the primordia of the internal genitalia appear: the paramesonephric (Müllerian) and mesonephric (Wolffian) ducts. The paramesonephric ducts extend caudally to the urogenital sinus, projecting into its posterior wall to form the Müllerian tubercle.
Каждый проток состоит из трёх сегментов:: Each duct has three segments: a vertical segment running parallel and lateral to the Wolffian duct, a horizontal segment crossing anterior to the ipsilateral Wolffian duct, and a second vertical segment fusing with its contralateral counterpart at the midline. The first two form the fallopian tube; the fused third segment canalizes to form the uterus, cervix and upper 1/5 of the vagina.
У женского зародыша отсутствие Y-хромосо: In female embryos, the absence of a Y chromosome and of testicular testosterone allows uninterrupted paramesonephric development; the ducts fuse and canalize at the midline while the mesonephric ducts regress. Disruptions in this phase may cause a range of Müllerian anomalies.
Основное кровоснабжение — маточные и яич: The primary arterial supply is the uterine and ovarian arteries, both arising from the anterior branch of the internal iliac artery; the uterine arteries are the main source of perfusion. Within the myometrium, branches form arcuate arteries, then radial arteries; at the endometrium, radial arteries divide into basal and spiral arteries.
Лимфоотток сегментарный: дно — главным о: Lymphatic drainage is segmental: the fundus drains primarily to the para-aortic lymph nodes, mirroring the ovaries and fallopian tubes; round ligament channels reach the superficial inguinal lymph nodes; the lower segments drain along the uterine vessels to the external and internal iliac lymph nodes.
Маточная артерия отходит общим стволом с: The uterine artery arises from a common trunk with the umbilical artery, from the anterior division of the internal iliac artery; it is highly tortuous, crosses the pelvic floor within the cardinal ligament, runs anterior and superior to the ureter near the lateral fornix and anastomoses with the ovarian artery in the broad ligament. The uterine vein follows the uterine artery within the cardinal ligament and drains into the internal iliac vein. In hysterectomy, ligation is typically at the level of the internal cervical os.
Симпатическая иннервация — уровни T11–T1: Sympathetic innervation comes from spinal levels T11 and T12, via the hypogastric plexus; parasympathetic from S2 to S4. The uterus and cervix are sensitive to distension; cervical dilation during labor contributes significantly to labor pain.
Чувствительные волокна матки идут по под: Uterine sensory fibers travel via the hypogastric nerves to T10–L1, causing referred pain to the lower back and abdomen; vaginal sensory input reaches S2–S4 via pelvic nerves, causing referred pain to the gluteal region and posterior leg; cervical pain signals travel through both the hypogastric and pelvic nerves.
До полового созревания матка мала, шейка: Prepubertal: a small uterus, with the cervix longer than the body (cervix-to-body ratio 2:1). Reproductive years: mature size, body larger than cervix (ratio 1:2). After menopause: atrophy, body smaller than cervix, ratio back to 2:1. A nulliparous uterus is smaller than a multiparous uterus.
Аномалии мюллеровых протоков: сегментарн: Müllerian anomalies: segmental hypoplasia (a small uterus with a body-to-cervix ratio resembling a prepubertal girl's); unicornuate uterus (one Müllerian duct fails to develop); uterine didelphys (complete nonfusion: two cavities and two cervices, often with a longitudinal vaginal septum); bicornuate uterus (incomplete Müllerian fusion, heart-shaped cavity); septate uterus, the most common anomaly (incomplete resorption of the uterovaginal septum; septum resection can improve reproductive outcomes); a T-shaped cavity after fetal exposure to diethylstilbestrol (DES).
Происхождение маточной артерии варьирует: The origin of the uterine artery varies in up to 1 in 5 cases: it may arise from the internal iliac, superior gluteal, obturator or internal pudendal artery; surgeons must anticipate these variants for successful ligation.
Гистерэктомия — вторая по частоте операц: Hysterectomy is the 2nd most common surgical procedure for women in the U.S., after cesarean section. The uterus may be involved in prolapse, fibroids, polyps, infections, cancer, malformations and adhesions.
Лейомиома (миома) — самая частая доброка: Leiomyoma (fibroid) is the most common benign tumor in women, often multiple and estrogen-sensitive; it grows during pregnancy and shrinks after menopause, and can cause abnormal uterine bleeding, miscarriage, iron deficiency anemia, distortion of uterine shape and constipation.
Другие состояния: полип эндометрия; гипе: Other conditions: endometrial polyps; endometrial hyperplasia (excess estrogen stimulation, increases carcinoma risk); adenomyosis (endometrial glandular tissue in the myometrium: dysmenorrhea and menorrhagia, an enlarged uniform globular uterus); endometritis (inflammation, typically linked to retained products of conception); endometriosis (nonneoplastic endometrial tissue outside the cavity, most common in the ovaries, pelvis and peritoneum; an endometrioma is a “chocolate cyst”; retrograde menstruation is the likely cause).
Рак матки — самый частый гинекологически: Uterine cancer is the most common gynecologic cancer in developed countries and is strongly associated with excess estrogen (tamoxifen use, unopposed estrogen replacement therapy; polycystic ovary syndrome, obesity, estrogen-secreting tumors). Most patients present with abnormal vaginal bleeding, especially postmenopausal bleeding.
Яичник — женская гонада, парный внутрибр: The ovary is the female gonad: a paired, intraperitoneal endocrine organ, usually in the lower left and right abdominal quadrants. It supports reproduction and hormone production.
Гранулёзные и тека-клетки секретируют го: Granulosa and theca cells secrete hormones, including estrogen and progesterone. Follicles mature in the ovary during the proliferative phase; after the dominant follicle matures and LH surges, the oocyte is released and travels through the fallopian tube to the uterus.
Жёлтое тело — временная эндокринная стру: The corpus luteum is a temporary endocrine structure that secretes mainly progesterone, plus smaller amounts of inhibin A and estradiol. If fertilization occurs, the blastocyst secretes hCG, which keeps the corpus luteum producing progesterone until the placenta takes over; if fertilization does not occur, the corpus luteum becomes the corpus albicans, and falling progesterone then triggers menstruation.
Яичники лежат рядом с маточными трубами: The ovaries lie near the fallopian tubes in the ovarian fossa, formed by the bifurcation of the external iliac artery. Anterior: the medial umbilical ligament. Posterior: the ureter and the internal iliac artery. Superior: the infundibulum of the uterine tube and the suspensory (infundibulopelvic) ligament of the ovary, which connects the ovary to the body wall. Inferior: the angle of the body and the uterine tube, via the proper ligament of the ovary.
Подвешивающая связка несёт яичниковые ар: The suspensory ligament carries the ovarian artery and vein, plus sympathetic and parasympathetic plexuses. The proper ligament is a remnant of the gubernaculum, containing no vessels.
Размер: 2,0 см в ширину, 3,5 см в длину,: Size: 2.0 cm wide, 3.5 cm long, 1.0 cm thick, comparable to a golf ball. Volume changes with age: the average is 0.7 mL at age 2, peaking at 7.7 mL at age 20, slowly decreasing until menopause, when the average is 2.8 mL. The ovary is pinkish with a smooth surface in nulliparous women and greyer with a puckered surface in multiparous women.
Снаружи внутрь: зародышевый эпителий (пр: From outer to inner: the germinal epithelium (simple cuboidal outer layer); the tunica albuginea (collagen-rich connective tissue beneath it); the cortex (contains follicles of varying sizes and maturity); the medulla (central loose connective tissue with major blood vessels, also called the hilus).
Ось гипоталамус–гипофиз–яичник: гипотала: The HPO axis: the hypothalamus secretes GnRH, which acts on the anterior pituitary to produce FSH and LH. FSH acts on granulosa cells to promote follicle growth and maturation; LH acts on theca cells, which produce androgens and estradiol precursors. Rising estrogen at puberty drives secondary sex characteristics.
Ооциты начинают развиваться внутриутробн: Oocytes begin developing in utero, then pause until puberty; maturation and release occur when the pituitary LH surge triggers ovulation. The average antral follicle is 2 to 9 mm; antral follicles enlarge through the menstrual cycle until one dominant follicle forms and the others degenerate.
Яичники развиваются из промежуточной мез: The ovaries originate from the intermediate mesoderm; the medulla is the central region and the germinal epithelium covers the surface. Immature ova arise from the dorsal endoderm of the yolk sac, migrate to the hindgut, then reach the gonadal ridge, which forms by week 4. At the gonadal ridge the cells are called oogonia; they are surrounded by connective tissue that becomes granulosa cells.
Яичники опускаются, но, в отличие от яич: The ovaries descend but, unlike testes, the descent ends in the abdomen: they attach to the gubernaculum, whose other end connects to the uterus, preventing further descent. The proper ovarian ligament arises from the gubernacular remnant.
Двойное кровоснабжение — яичниковая и ма: Dual blood supply from the ovarian artery and the uterine artery. The ovarian artery is paired, arising from the abdominal aorta below the renal artery, around L2; it runs through the suspensory ligament, enters the mesovarium and may anastomose with the uterine artery in the broad ligament.
Яичниковая вена идёт в подвешивающей свя: The ovarian vein travels with the suspensory ligament; the left ovarian vein drains into the left renal vein, the right ovarian vein directly into the inferior vena cava. Average ovarian vein diameter is 5 mm. Venous anastomoses: para-ovarian, uterine, vesical, rectal and vulvar venous plexuses.
Лимфа главным образом идёт в парааорталь: Most lymph drains to the paraaortic nodes, around L2, traveling with the ovarian vessels; alternative pathways go laterally to hypogastric nodes, then to paraaortic nodes, or along the round ligament to external iliac and inguinal nodes. These pathways are clinically important as routes of ovarian cancer metastasis.
Симпатическая иннервация: яичниковое спл: Sympathetic innervation has two sources: the ovarian plexus (originating from the renal plexus, carried by the suspensory ligament) and the superior ovarian nerve (carried within the ovarian ligament). Parasympathetic innervation comes from the uterine (pelvic) plexus, arising from the pelvic splanchnic nerves. No muscles play a significant role in ovarian anatomy.
Кисты — самый частый вариант: простые фу: Cysts are the most common variant: simple functional cysts form naturally with hormone changes during the menstrual cycle; persistent or very large cysts increase ovarian volume and raise the risk of torsion.
Добавочные яичники (редко) — более двух: Accessory ovaries (uncommon) are more than two ovaries attached to the typical ligaments; supernumerary ovaries (extremely rare) are not attached to the typical ligaments and connect to structures such as the large intestine, bladder or rectum; removal is necessary because of a higher risk of neoplastic transformation. A single ovary is uncommon. In Turner syndrome the ovaries are “streak” or atrophied: they start developing normally but degenerate before birth, causing infertility in most patients.
Яичники обильно кровоснабжаются; при пер: Ovaries have abundant blood supply; bleeding must be controlled, and in torsion blood flow must be restored before irreversible damage occurs. The bladder, intestines and arterial and venous systems lie close to the ovaries; the bilateral ureters lie close to the ovary and its ligaments, and accidental clamping can cause ureteral dysfunction and possible ipsilateral renal failure.
Преждевременная недостаточность яичников: Premature ovarian failure (premature menopause) causes infertility and menopausal symptoms and reduces the benefits of estrogen (premature bone weakening and loss of cardioprotective factors). Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS): oligomenorrhea, acne, hirsutism and infertility; ultrasound usually shows over 25 active follicles.
Рак яичника обычно протекает скрыто и на: Ovarian cancer is typically insidious and, as stated in the article, the third leading cause of cancer-related death in women; its slow, benign-appearing onset means it is often diagnosed only after metastasis.
Маточные трубы — парные проводники между: The fallopian tubes are paired conduits linking the ovaries and uterus in the female pelvis. They transport oocytes and are the site of fertilization; they are a common cause of infertility and a target of surgical sterilization, and can be sites of ascending infection or neoplasms.
Яйцеводы, или маточные трубы, — полые се: Also called oviducts or uterine tubes, they are hollow seromuscular organs. Each tube starts at a uterine horn, runs laterally within the superior edge of the broad ligament's mesosalpinx and ends near the ipsilateral ovary. Length: 11 to 12 cm; lumen diameter: less than 1 mm.
Четыре отдела: маточная часть (самая мед: Four regions: the uterine part (most medial; includes the uterine ostium and a short segment nearest the uterine horn), the isthmus, the ampulla (lateral to the isthmus; the most common site of fertilization) and the infundibulum (most distal; ends at the abdominal ostium opening into the peritoneal cavity; its fimbriae catch the oocyte released each menstrual cycle). The fimbria ovarica connects the infundibulum to the nearby ovary.
Стенка: мышечный слой лежит между внутре: Wall: the muscular layer lies between the inner mucosa (with longitudinal cilia extending into the lumen) and the outer serosa; the article describes an inner circular and an outer longitudinal layer. Muscle contractions, ciliary movement and tubal secretions together move the ovum along the tube; short, frequent contractions mix tubal fluid, while continuous tonic contractions aid anterograde transport and allow the embryo to pass the utero-tubal junction at the most hormonally optimal time of the menstrual cycle.
Труба обеспечивает пространство для опло: The tube provides a fertilization space and a passageway for the ovum or gamete from the ovary to the uterus. A second description lists four parts: the fimbriated infundibulum, the ampulla, the isthmus and the intramural part (the narrow medial segment within the uterine wall).
Парамезонефральные (мюллеровы) протоки о: Paramesonephric (Müllerian) ducts form around weeks 5 to 6 in female embryos, due to absence of anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH). With estrogen stimulation, the cranial ends form the fallopian tubes; the caudal ends fuse in the midline to form the uterus and superior vagina. A remnant may persist cranially as the vesicular appendage (hydatid cyst of Morgagni).
Артерии: анастомозы между трубной и яичн: Arterial: anastomoses between the ovarian artery's tubal and ovarian branches and the ascending branches of the uterine artery. Ovarian arteries arise from the abdominal aorta, inferior to the renal artery origins; uterine arteries arise from the internal iliac arteries (ascending branches run superiorly to the uterine horns, descending branches inferiorly toward the superior vagina). Ovarian arteries supply the lateral tube, uterine artery ascending branches the medial tube; anastomoses generally prevent ischemia if either supply is compromised.
Вены — трубные ветви маточной и яичников: Veins drain to tubal branches of the uterine and ovarian veins, mirroring the arterial pattern; the right ovarian vein drains to the IVC, the left ovarian vein to the left renal vein, the uterine veins to the internal iliac veins. Lymphatic drainage is similar to the ovaries, to the para-aortic (lumbar) and pelvic lymph nodes.
Афферентные болевые волокна идут по тому: Afferent pain fibers follow the same pathway as sympathetic efferents, originating from T11, T12 and L1. The minor parasympathetic supply is shared: vagal fibers from the ovarian plexus serve the lateral tube, and pelvic splanchnic nerves (S1, S2, S3) serve the medial tube. The medial isthmus has the densest innervation; innervation and musculature both become sparser from proximal to distal.
Доброкачественные околотрубные кисты — ч: Benign paratubal cysts are often found incidentally, most often in middle age, and are usually asymptomatic; the hydatid of Morgagni may be present at the distal-most tube. Rare reported cases include diverticula, agenesis and duplication; diverticula or duplications raise the risk of hydrosalpinx, torsion and ectopic pregnancy, and occlusion or agenesis may contribute to infertility. In utero diethylstilbestrol (DES) exposure is linked to abnormal tubal development.
Операции: сальпингоофорэктомия — удалени: Procedures: salpingo-oophorectomy (removal of the ovary and fallopian tube), salpingectomy (removal of the fallopian tube), salpingostomy (surgical incision into the tube to create an opening) and tubal ligation (an umbrella term for sterilization by occlusion, removal or ligation). Tubal ligation is very safe, highly effective and permanent; post-procedure regret risk factors: age under 30, lower parity, sterilization in the immediate postpartum period and low socioeconomic status.
Ампула — самое частое место внематочной: The ampulla is the most common site of ectopic pregnancy; treatment is medical or surgical (salpingostomy or salpingectomy). Tube removal may be needed for malignancies of the ovary, tube or uterus, and for benign conditions such as hydrosalpinx and tubo-ovarian abscess. High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) is the most common ovarian cancer, often diagnosed at an advanced stage with poor prognosis; most cases are believed to originate in the fallopian tubes years before ovarian cancer presents.
Нарушения труб участвуют до трети случае: Tubal abnormalities are implicated in up to one-third of infertility cases; causes include congenital absence or malformation, infections (Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, genital tuberculosis) and endometriosis adhesions. A history of recurrent pelvic inflammatory disease or intra-abdominal surgery with adhesions correlates with a higher risk of tubal factor infertility; more past infections correlate with more severe tubal damage. Investigation: hysterosalpingography or hysteroscopy.
Внутренние половые органы лежат в истинн: The internal genitalia lie within the true pelvis: vagina, cervix, uterus, fallopian tubes and ovaries. The external genitalia lie outside the true pelvis and include the labia, vestibule, Bartholin and Skene glands, clitoris, mons pubis, perineum, urethral meatus and periurethral area.
Влагалище — фибромышечный канал длиной 6: The vagina is a fibromuscular canal, 6 to 8 cm long, anterior to the rectum and posterior to the bladder and urethra, directed downward and forward. The anterior wall is about 6 cm and the posterior wall about 8 cm. Its upper segment forms the vaginal vault, enclosing the vaginal portion of the cervix.
Шейка делится на надвлагалищную и влагал: The cervix is divided into supravaginal and vaginal parts. Fornices: anterior (between the anterior cervical lip and the anterior vaginal wall), posterior (between the posterior cervical lip and the vaginal wall) and lateral (on each side). The posterior fornix is the deepest and a common site for ruptures, foreign bodies and malignancies.
Развитие: верхняя треть влагалища образу: Development: the upper third of the vagina arises from the uterovaginal primordium with the uterus and cervix, while the vaginal plate, derived from the sinovaginal bulbs, canalizes to form the lower two-thirds of the vagina.
Кровоснабжение: влагалищная артерия — не: Blood supply: the vaginal artery is a small inferior branch of the uterine artery (it may also arise from the internal iliac artery) supplying the cervix and vagina. The uterus, cervix and vagina drain lymph to the internal and external iliac nodes. Parasympathetic fibers arise from S2–S4 in the pelvic splanchnic nerves; sensory fibers come from S2–S4; the pudendal nerve provides sensory innervation to the lower vagina.
Матка чаще всего антеверсирована-антефле: The uterus is most commonly anteverted-anteflexed, with the body in the vesicouterine space; rarely it is retroverted-retroflexed, with the body in the pouch of Douglas. The ovaries are oval, about 3 × 1.5 × 1 cm and homologous with the testis; they lie lateral to the uterus within the ovarian fossa, in front of the ureters and behind the external iliac vessels, with the long axis oriented downward and forward.
Яичник покрыт брюшиной, кроме брыжеечног: The ovary is covered by peritoneum except along the mesovarian (anterior) border, where vessels, nerves and lymphatics pass; it contains thousands of follicles, and each month one becomes the dominant (Graafian) follicle, releasing an ovum at ovulation. The ovaries secrete estrogen and progesterone, controlled directly by pituitary FSH and LH.
Мышцы тазовой диафрагмы: грушевидная, ко: The pelvic diaphragm muscles are the piriformis, coccygeus, iliococcygeus, pubococcygeus and puborectalis; the last three are the levator ani muscles. They support the uterus, the urogenital diaphragm, and the round, broad, lateral and cardinal ligaments. Vaginal delivery is a major cause of levator ani defects, genital prolapse and urinary incontinence; during the second stage of labor the pubococcygeus bears the largest tissue strain among pelvic floor muscles.
Основная (поперечная шеечная) связка идё: The transverse cervical (cardinal) ligament extends from the cervix to the pelvic sidewall and appears at the base of the broad ligament. The uterosacral ligament extends from the cervix to the sacrum and is key in maintaining anteversion and supporting the uterus posteriorly. The pubocervical ligament provides anterior uterine support and helps prevent cystocele. The broad ligament is a double peritoneal fold with four regions — mesosalpinx, mesovarium, mesometrium and the suspensory ligament of the ovary — overlying the ovaries, uterus and tubes and fixing the uterus laterally to the pelvic sidewalls.
Выпадение тазовых органов распространено: Pelvic organ prolapse is common in women; it is managed conservatively, with pessaries, or surgically. Laparoscopic promontofixation has excellent long-term results, with low recurrence and morbidity and improved quality of life.
Послеродовое кровотечение (особенно посл: Postpartum hemorrhage is serious, especially after cesarean section; initial management is clamping or embolizing the uterine artery, and for persistent bleeding the internal iliac artery is clamped below the origin of the superior gluteal artery. The ureter runs under the cardinal ligament and is prone to ligation because of its proximity to the uterine artery and cervix; in hysterectomy the uterine artery should be isolated to prevent inadvertent ligation.
Сальпингит (бактериальная инфекция труб,: Salpingitis (bacterial tubal infection, most often from Neisseria gonorrhoeae or Chlamydia trachomatis) can cause tubal scarring, infertility and ectopic pregnancy; ectopic pregnancy is most common in the ampulla and may be confused with appendicitis in young women. A pudendal nerve block is an option for labor pain but does not relieve pain from uterine contractions and is rarely used now.

Гипофиз (hypophysis cerebri) жизненно ва: The pituitary (hypophysis cerebri) is vital to life and is nicknamed “the master gland”. It sits in the sella turcica of the sphenoid bone.
Различают переднюю и заднюю доли, обе фу: It has an anterior lobe and a posterior lobe, both functionally active, with an intermediate lobe between them. The anterior lobe produces most of the pituitary's hormones, and hypothalamic hormones regulate them.
С рождения до взрослого возраста гипофиз: The gland grows rapidly from birth to adulthood, reaching about 500 mg; adult dimensions are an anteroposterior diameter of 8 mm and a transverse diameter of 12 mm. Size differs between males and females; it nearly doubles during pregnancy because the pars distalis enlarges.
Границы: диафрагма седла (сверху), клино: Boundaries: the diaphragma sellae (superior), the sphenoid sinus (anteroinferior) and the cavernous sinus (lateral). The optic chiasm lies anterosuperior to the gland.
Серый бугор и срединное возвышение гипот: The tuber cinereum and median eminence of the hypothalamus give rise to the infundibulum, a tubular link to the brain. Its dual embryonic origin gives it a distinct histology, with three lobes: anterior (adenohypophysis), posterior (neurohypophysis) and intermediate.
Турецкое седло — вогнутое углубление кли: The sella turcica is a concave depression in the sphenoid bone, enclosed by bone anteriorly, posteriorly and inferiorly, and by dural reflections laterally and superiorly. The tuberculum sellae forms the anterior wall and the dorsum sellae the posterior wall; the sulcus chiasmaticus lies anterosuperior to the tuberculum.
Задние клиновидные отростки отходят от к: The posterior clinoid processes arise from the dorsum sellae margins and the anterior clinoid processes from the anterolateral margin; both anchor dural folds. The sphenoid sinus roof forms the floor of the pituitary fossa.
Диафрагма седла — складка твёрдой мозгов: The diaphragma sellae is a dural fold with a central aperture that incompletely roofs the sella; it separates the adenohypophysis from the optic chiasm, is continuous with the dura and is passed through by the stalk and blood vessels.
Околоседловая область — пещеристый синус: The parasellar region comprises the cavernous sinus and the suprasellar cistern. The cavernous sinus contains the internal carotid artery, sympathetic fibers and cranial nerves III, IV, V and VI; the suprasellar cistern contains the optic chiasm, part of the third ventricle, the hypothalamus and the tuber cinereum.
Шесть клеточных линий: пять гормонопроду: Six cell lines exist: five hormone-producing (somatotrophs, lactotrophs, corticotrophs, thyrotrophs, gonadotrophs) and one nonhormonal (folliculostellate cells). The pars distalis is the main bulk of the anterior pituitary: acidophils (somatotrophs, lactotrophs; cytoplasm stains red to orange), basophils (thyrotrophs, gonadotrophs, corticotrophs; blue to purple) and chromophobes (poorly staining, possibly stem cells not yet differentiated).
Бугорная часть — трубчатое продолжение д: The pars tuberalis is a tubular extension of the pars distalis encircling the infundibular stem. The pars intermedia lies between the pars distalis and the posterior lobe, has colloid-containing follicles and includes remnants of the Rathke pouch cleft; it is mostly nonfunctional but produces melanocyte-stimulating hormone and endorphins.
Гормоны: АКТГ (в ответ на КРГ; стимулиру: Hormones: ACTH (released in response to CRH; reaches the adrenal cortex, negative feedback by cortisol); prolactin (dopamine inhibits its release; promotes mammary gland growth and milk production); LH and FSH (GnRH acts on gonadotrophs; in males LH acts on Leydig cells to secrete testosterone and FSH on Sertoli cells to secrete inhibin B; in females LH initiates steroid hormone production and its surge triggers ovulation, FSH initiates follicular development); growth hormone (released in response to GHRH; anabolic effects, negative feedback by GH and IGF-1); TSH (released in response to TRH; stimulates the thyroid to release T3 and T4).
Задняя доля — специализированная нейроэн: The posterior pituitary is a specialized neuroendocrine structure made of the pars nervosa and the infundibular stalk; it does not synthesize hormones and is not glandular. Axons originate from magnocellular neurons of the paraventricular and supraoptic nuclei and form the hypothalamohypophyseal tract, which ends near posterior lobe sinusoids; pituicytes (glial cells) surround the axons.
Окситоцин участвует в рефлексе выделения: Oxytocin is involved in the milk letdown (ejection) reflex during lactation and in myoepithelial, smooth muscle and uterine contraction; exogenous oxytocin is used for postpartum hemorrhage (the recommended IV dose is 5 IU, given after delivery of the fetal anterior shoulder). Arginine vasopressin (AVP, ADH) regulates water content and maintains blood tonicity and blood pressure: V1 receptors on vascular smooth muscle cause arteriolar contraction; V2 receptors in the renal collecting duct upregulate aquaporin-2 channels, increasing free water reabsorption.
Аденогипофиз развивается из ротовой экто: The adenohypophysis derives from oral ectoderm and the neurohypophysis from neural ectoderm (an outpouching of the third ventricle's neural primordia, making it an extension of the CNS). Organogenesis begins around the 4th intrauterine week: a hypophyseal placode forms at the oral ectoderm and gives rise to Rathke pouch, which evaginates upward toward the neural ectoderm to form the anterior lobe; the ventral diencephalon extends downward to form the posterior lobe.
На 6–8-й неделе основание кармана Ратке: Around weeks 6 to 8 the base of Rathke pouch constricts and closes, separating it from the oral epithelium. The hypothalamus communicates with the adenohypophysis through the hypothalamohypophyseal portal system.
Гипофиз хорошо васкуляризирован, его кро: The pituitary is well vascularized, with its supply linked to the hypothalamus through the hypothalamohypophyseal portal system. The anterior lobe is supplied by the superior hypophyseal artery (arising from the internal carotid artery or the posterior communicating artery): these arteries form a primary plexus supplying the median eminence; its capillaries form venules leading to the portal hypophyseal veins; secondary plexuses drain into the cavernous sinus.
Промежуточная доля получает кровь от ана: The intermediate lobe receives blood from anastomoses between anterior and posterior lobe capillaries. Small branches of the superior hypophyseal artery supply the pituitary stalk and parts of the optic nerve and chiasm. The posterior lobe is supplied by the inferior hypophyseal artery (from the meningohypophyseal trunk, a branch of the internal carotid artery) and drains into the cavernous sinus. Lymphatic drainage is not described in the article.
Масса железы у женщин и мужчин различает: Gland weight differs between females and males; in females it may roughly double during pregnancy. The gland may be flattened laterally by pressure from the carotid arteries; gland height ranges from 3 to 11 mm. If the gland does not fill the hypophyseal fossa, the subarachnoid cisterns can encroach on it.
Размеры и пневматизация клиновидной пазу: Sphenoid sinus size and pneumatization vary; the sellar type is the most common pattern. These variations matter for transsphenoidal surgery complications. The distance between the optic chiasm and tuberculum sellae ranges from 1.5 to 8 mm.
Нефункционирующие аденомы удаляют только: Nonfunctioning adenomas are resected only when they cause mass effect, such as compressing the optic chiasm and producing bitemporal hemianopsia (nasal retinal fibers decussate within the chiasm); prolactinomas are resected only if dopaminergic medication fails. Transsphenoidal surgery is commonly chosen, especially for Cushing disease.
Доступы: транскраниальный, микроскопичес: Approaches: transcranial, microscopic transsphenoidal and endoscopic endonasal. Microscopic transsphenoidal surgery is the most commonly used method; the endoscopic approach is considered more favorable because it shortens surgery and hospital stay, is minimally invasive, has a lower complication risk and causes less postoperative pain. Stereotactic radiosurgery may help patients unwilling to undergo repeat surgery for recurrent or residual adenomas.
Аденома гипофиза — самая частая патологи: Pituitary adenoma is the most common sellar pathology: microadenomas are under 10 mm, macroadenomas over 10 mm; macroadenomas can compress adjacent structures, and lateral extension can compress the cavernous sinus, causing ophthalmoplegia and diplopia. Prolactinoma is the most common functioning secretory adenoma. Cushing disease is caused by an ACTH-secreting adenoma (proximal myopathy, psychiatric disturbances, obesity, abdominal purple striae, fat deposition at the neck (“buffalo hump”), hypertension). A GH-secreting adenoma causes acromegaly or gigantism.
Апоплексия гипофиза — геморрагический ин: Pituitary apoplexy is hemorrhagic infarction of an adenoma: abrupt headache, visual symptoms and panhypopituitarism; the “apoplexy triad” is headache, visual changes and vomiting, and it may be mistaken for subarachnoid hemorrhage. Sheehan syndrome is infarction and necrosis of the gland after postpartum hemorrhage (hypopituitarism, failure to lactate). Empty sella syndrome: a diaphragma sellae defect (primary) or tumors/surgery (secondary); associated with multiparous women, obesity and benign intracranial hypertension.
Другие состояния: синдром сдавления ножк: Other conditions: stalk compression syndrome (hyperprolactinemia), lymphocytic and granulomatous hypophysitis, SIADH (excess ADH with hyponatremia), craniopharyngioma (adamantinomatous in children, papillary in adults), Rathke cleft cyst and MEN-1 (a genetic syndrome with abnormal growth in the pituitary, parathyroid and pancreas).
