Надпочечники (adrenal, или suprarenal gl: The adrenal glands, also called suprarenal glands, are a major part of the endocrine system. They drive the fight-or-flight response by producing stress hormones, and also secrete hormones that regulate the immune system, metabolism, and salt and water balance.
Парные треугольные органы около 5 × 2 см: They are paired, triangular organs, about 5 cm by 2 cm, sitting on the upper end of each kidney; each gland weighs about 4 to 5 grams.
Каждая железа лежит на верхнем полюсе по: Each gland rests on the upper pole of its kidney, enclosed by the superior renal fascia and lying in the perirenal space. At birth each gland is about one-third the size of the kidney; in adulthood it is about one-thirtieth the kidney's size.
Правый надпочечник пирамидальный, левый: The right gland is pyramidal; the left is crescent-shaped. Dimensions: height 50 mm, breadth 30 mm, thickness 10 mm; weight is roughly 5 g.
Правый надпочечник лежит под печенью, по: The right gland lies below the liver, posterior to the inferior vena cava and anterior to the diaphragm. The left gland lies medial to the spleen, superior to the splenic artery and vein, lateral to the abdominal aorta and anterior to the diaphragm.
Две ткани — наружная кора и внутреннее м: Two tissues, an outer cortex and an inner medulla, are surrounded by a thick connective tissue capsule. The cortex is fattier and yellower; the medulla is reddish-brown; the cortex makes up about 15% of the gland.
Клубочковая зона (наружная) вырабатывает: The zona glomerulosa (outer) produces mineralocorticoids, chiefly aldosterone, which regulates electrolytes and blood pressure. The zona fasciculata (middle) produces glucocorticoids, mainly cortisol, which raises blood sugar through gluconeogenesis, modulates immunity and regulates fat, protein and carbohydrate metabolism; its secretion is controlled by ACTH from the pituitary. The zona reticularis (inner) produces androgens, including DHEA, which the article calls the most abundant hormone in the body and a precursor for progesterone, estrogen, cortisol and testosterone. Mnemonic for function: “Salt, Sugar, Sex.”
Мозговое вещество синтезирует катехолами: The medulla synthesizes catecholamines; the article states norepinephrine forms from a dopamine precursor combined with tyrosine and is then methylated by PNMT, which is present only in the adrenal medulla.
Железа состоит из двух эмбрионально разл: The gland has two embryologically distinct parts: a mesoderm-derived cortex that makes steroid hormones and a neuroectoderm-derived medulla that secretes catecholamines.
На 5-й неделе в мочеполовом валике появл: At week 5 a cluster of cells in the urogenital ridge, described as adrenal-gonadal primordial germ cells, appears; mesothelial cells penetrate the mesenchyme and form the fetal cortex and Leydig cells. Large acidophilic cells first form a primitive cortex; smaller cells then migrate in, engulf them and form the definitive cortex.
На 7-й неделе клетки нервного гребня миг: At week 7 neural crest cells from the apex of the neural folds migrate in via a ventral route, enter from the medial face and differentiate into chromaffin cells arranged in central cords and masses; late in development the cortex grows around and gradually encloses the medulla.
Железы очень богато васкуляризированы, к: The glands are highly vascularized because they release systemically important hormones; blood flow is tightly regulated by neuroendocrine and paracrine mechanisms. The three main arterial sources are the superior adrenal arteries (small branches of the inferior phrenic artery), the middle adrenal artery (arising directly from the abdominal aorta) and the inferior adrenal artery (arising from the renal artery on each side).
Частые варианты: верхняя артерия может о: Common arterial variants: the superior adrenal artery may arise from the abdominal aorta, the celiac axis or rarely an intercostal artery and is often multiple; the middle adrenal artery may arise from the inferior phrenic, renal or superior mesenteric arteries or the celiac axis; the inferior adrenal arteries may arise from the abdominal aorta or the inferior phrenic artery.
Вены: левая надпочечниковая вена впадает: Venous drainage: the left adrenal vein drains into the left renal vein, because the left gland is farther from the IVC; the right adrenal vein drains directly into the inferior vena cava. Venous variants are common, especially on the left: connections with the left genital and inferior phrenic veins and double left adrenal veins.
Функция регулируется и гормонально, и си: Function is controlled by both hormonal and synaptic stimulation; ACTH from the anterior pituitary activates the cortex, which then produces corticosteroids.
Мозговое вещество: преганглионарные воло: Medulla innervation: preganglionic type B fibers come from the intermediolateral cell column of the lateral horn, spinal segments T5–T8, and form the greater splanchnic nerve without entering the paravertebral sympathetic chain. Some fibers synapse at the celiac ganglion (postsynaptic fibers from the celiac ganglion innervate the adrenal blood vessels); other fibers bypass the celiac ganglion and synapse directly on chromaffin cells. The medulla acts as a neuroendocrine junction: chromaffin cells release hormones directly into the blood, functioning as a specialized postsynaptic neuron.
При феохромоцитоме до манипуляций с опух: In pheochromocytoma, the adrenal vein should be ligated before manipulating the tumor; otherwise catecholamines can enter circulation, causing a surge with rapid severe hypertension and tachycardia.
Эктопированная корковая ткань часто нахо: Ectopic cortical tissue is often near the kidney or pelvis, and ectopic medullary tissue lies along the path of neural crest cell migration; assess for it during resection. The adrenal may fuse with the liver (adrenohepatic fusion), complicating right adrenalectomy. Arterial embolization is used when surgery is not indicated or is unsafe.
Корковые гормоны синтезируются из холест: The cortex uses cholesterol as the main precursor for its hormones. Zona glomerulosa: Conn syndrome (hyperaldosteronism; persistent hypertension, hypokalemia, mild hypernatremia). Zona fasciculata: Cushing syndrome (abdominal striae, central obesity, a buffalo hump, hyperglycemia, poor wound healing). Zona reticularis: early puberty in males or virilization in young females.
Хромаффинные клетки мозгового вещества л: Chromaffin cells of the medulla cluster near blood vessels and make epinephrine and norepinephrine, raising heart rate, contractile force, metabolic rate and alertness. Multiple endocrine neoplasia type II is associated with pheochromocytoma and medullary thyroid cancer.
Инциденталомы надпочечников видны пример: Incidental adrenal masses appear on up to about 4% of CT scans. With a prior cancer history biopsy may be indicated; without a known primary cancer, functional overproduction is ruled out (low-dose dexamethasone suppression test, plasma metanephrines, plasma aldosterone); incidentalomas should not be biopsied without a known cancer history, because biopsy can seed adrenal cancer into surrounding tissue. Breast and lung cancers are the most common primaries that metastasize to the adrenal. Masses under 4 cm: repeat CT in 4 to 6 months; over 4 to 6 cm: functional workup and consider adrenalectomy.
Щитовидная железа лежит по средней линии: The thyroid gland lies in the midline of the anterior neck at about C5–T1. Thyroid hormone and calcitonin regulate metabolism, growth and serum calcium.
Железа находится рядом с околощитовидным: It lies next to the parathyroid glands, the recurrent laryngeal nerves and regional vessels, which makes these structures important in neck surgery.
Масса железы у взрослого около 25 г, сре: In adults the gland weighs about 25 g, with an average volume of 6.6 mL. It sits in the middle (visceral) compartment of the neck, which extends from the hyoid to the arch of the aorta; strap muscles lie anteriorly and the deep cervical fascia posteriorly, also enclosing the esophagus, pharynx and trachea.
Две доли соединяет перешеек, лежащий поп: Two lobes are joined by an isthmus crossing the upper trachea at the level of the 2nd–3rd tracheal rings. A pyramidal extension, the “tubercle of Zuckerkandl”, is often present.
Железа лежит позади грудино-подъязычной: The gland lies posterior to the sternothyroid and sternohyoid muscles, wraps the cricoid cartilage and tracheal rings, and lies inferior to the thyroid cartilage. The lateral suspensory (Berry) ligament anchors each lobe to the trachea. Laterally is the sternothyroid, medially the larynx and trachea, and posteriorly the carotid sheath, partly overlapping the common carotid artery.
Железа развивается из эндодермы у слепог: The gland derives from endoderm at the foramen cecum (the junction of the anterior two-thirds and posterior third of the tongue). A bilobed diverticulum descends anterior to the pharynx, hyoid and laryngeal cartilages, reaching its final position by the 7th week; the thyroglossal duct involutes.
Ультимобранхиальное тело (вентральный от: The ultimobranchial body (from the ventral 4th pharyngeal pouch) gives rise to the parafollicular C cells, which produce calcitonin.
Верхняя щитовидная артерия — первая ветв: The superior thyroid artery is the first branch of the external carotid artery, near the superior horn of the thyroid cartilage (branches: infrahyoid, sternocleidomastoid, superior laryngeal and cricothyroid; the superior laryngeal artery pierces the thyrohyoid membrane with the internal laryngeal nerve). The inferior thyroid artery arises from the thyrocervical trunk (its largest branch is the ascending cervical artery). A thyroid ima artery is present in about 10% of people, usually from the brachiocephalic trunk.
Вены: верхняя, средняя и нижняя щитовидн: Veins: superior, middle and inferior thyroid veins; the superior and middle drain to the internal jugular vein, the inferior to the subclavian or brachiocephalic vein. Lymph drains to prelaryngeal, pretracheal, paratracheal and lower deep cervical nodes.
Иннервация вегетативная: парасимпатическ: Innervation is autonomic: parasympathetic vagal branches and sympathetic fibers from the superior, middle and inferior cervical ganglia. They modulate vascular tone, not hormone secretion.
Соседние мышцы: подкожная мышца шеи, гру: Related muscles: platysma, sternocleidomastoid and digastric; the infrahyoid (strap) muscles — omohyoid, sternohyoid, sternothyroid (directly over the anterior gland) and thyrohyoid; and the inferior pharyngeal constrictor.
Эктопическая ткань встречается с частото: Ectopic tissue occurs in 1 per 100,000–300,000 people, the lingual thyroid being most frequent. A pyramidal lobe is present in 28–55% (most often on the left). The isthmus may be prominent, narrowed or absent.
Возвратный гортанный нерв идёт вдоль лат: The recurrent laryngeal nerve runs along the lateral thyroid near the inferior thyroid artery; its distal 2–3 cm are the most vulnerable (tubercle of Zuckerkandl, Berry ligament). A nonrecurrent laryngeal nerve occurs in about 1% on the right. The external branch of the superior laryngeal nerve lies near the superior thyroid artery and is vulnerable in about 20% when the vessels are clamped together. The cervical sympathetic trunk must also be kept in mind.
Гипертиреоз — например, болезнь Грейвса: Hyperthyroidism, for example Graves disease (TSH-receptor antibodies). Hypothyroidism is often autoimmune and up to 7 times more common in women. Goiter is associated with iodine deficiency. Ectopic tissue can cause symptoms at its location. Cancers: papillary, follicular, medullary.
Эндокринные железы, обычно расположенные: Endocrine glands usually near the thyroid; normally four (two superior and two inferior). Supernumerary glands are found in up to 13% of autopsies and ectopy in up to 16% of glands (mediastinum, retro-esophageal, lateral neck).
Верхние железы развиваются из 4-го глото: The superior glands come from the 4th pharyngeal pouch and classically lie near the posterolateral superior pole of the thyroid, about 1 cm above where the recurrent laryngeal nerve meets the inferior thyroid artery, deep to that nerve.
Нижние железы — из 3-го кармана; лежат у: The inferior glands come from the 3rd pouch and lie near the inferior thyroid poles within 1–2 cm of where the inferior thyroid artery enters the lower pole, classically superficial to the recurrent laryngeal nerve. Their position is more variable (intrathyroidal, thymus, mediastinum, aortic arch).
Главные клетки вырабатывают паратгормон: Chief cells secrete PTH (smaller and more numerous, with prominent Golgi and endoplasmic reticulum). Oxyphil cells are larger, their purpose is unclear, and their number increases with age.
Паратгормон повышает уровень кальция в к: PTH raises blood calcium by acting on the kidneys, intestine and skeleton. Synthesis: pre-proPTH (115 aa) → proPTH (90 aa) → PTH (84 aa). Kidney: calcium reabsorption (ascending loop of Henle, distal and collecting tubules), phosphate excretion (reabsorption is prevented in the proximal tubule), and 1-hydroxylase activates vitamin D (1,25-dihydroxy D3). Intestine: active vitamin D increases calcium absorption. Bone: a rapid phase (minutes) and a slow phase (days; osteoblasts signal osteocytes and osteoclasts proliferate). Release is regulated by the calcium-sensing G-protein receptor.
Железы развиваются из эндодермы 3-го и 4: The glands develop from endoderm of the 3rd and 4th pharyngeal pouches with neural crest and ectoderm; elongation occurs at about 6 weeks. The inferior glands come from the 3rd pouch and the superior from the 4th.
Кровоснабжение общее со щитовидной желез: Blood supply is shared with the thyroid: the inferior thyroid arteries supply both superior and inferior glands, with collaterals from the superior thyroid, thyroid ima, laryngeal, tracheal and esophageal arteries. Veins drain to the thyroid venous plexus; lymph to the deep cervical and paratracheal nodes. Nerves are branches of the cervical ganglia (vasomotor).
Положение желёз варьирует, поэтому при т: Gland location varies, so they are at risk of injury in thyroidectomy. Approaches are bilateral neck exploration or focused parathyroidectomy (Tc-99m sestamibi, gamma probe); double adenomas occur in up to 10%. Removing both pairs causes tetany and arrhythmias.
Первичный гиперпаратиреоз (аденома, гипе: Primary hyperparathyroidism (adenoma, 4-gland hyperplasia, malignancy, MEN 1/2), secondary (CKD, vitamin D deficiency), tertiary, and malignant (PTH-like protein); presents with hypercalcemia. Hypoparathyroidism: primary and secondary (surgical, radiation).

Селезёнка — самый крупный орган лимфатич: The spleen is the largest organ of the lymphatic system, in the left hypochondriac region between the diaphragm and the gastric fundus, typically spanning ribs 9 to 11. It is highly vascular, reddish-purple and enclosed by a thin connective tissue capsule that permits only limited expansion.
Основные функции: фильтрация крови, имму: Primary functions: blood filtration, immune surveillance and sequestration of blood elements. Visceral relations include the stomach, the left kidney, the colon and the pancreatic tail.
Орган лежит между дном желудка и диафраг: It lies between the gastric fundus and the diaphragm, below the left costal margin between ribs 9 and 11; spongy and reddish-purple, typically not palpable on routine examination. The parenchyma is subdivided into lobules, with anterior and posterior segments. The spleen rests on the upper pole of the left kidney and the pancreatic tail. It measures about 10 to 12 cm and weighs about 150 to 200 g.
Три края: верхний (с вырезкой на передне: Three borders: superior (with a notch at its anterior end), inferior and intermediate. Two surfaces: the diaphragmatic surface is convex and smooth; the visceral surface is concave and irregular, with multiple impressions.
Вдавления: желудочное (самое вогнутое, о: Impressions: gastric (the most concave, from the stomach fundus), renal (left kidney, on the intermediate and inferior borders), colic (splenic flexure of the colon) and pancreatic (pancreatic tail, between the hilum and the colic impression).
Ворота лежат на нижнемедиальной части же: The hilum lies on the inferomedial aspect of the gastric impression; it transmits nerves and splenic vessels and provides attachment for the splenorenal and gastrosplenic ligaments.
Белая пульпа — периартериальные лимфоидн: White pulp consists of periarteriolar lymphoid sheaths (PALS) around central arterioles and discrete lymphoid follicles; it is the site of lymphocyte production and maturation, supporting B and T cells and antibody synthesis after antigen exposure.
Краевая зона — переход между белой и кра: The marginal zone is the transition between white and red pulp, containing specialized macrophages and lymphocytes; it mediates contact between circulating blood and lymphoid tissue and directs pathogens into the white pulp.
Красная пульпа составляет большую часть: Red pulp makes up most of the parenchyma: a reticular network supporting the cords of Billroth and venous sinusoids. The cords of Billroth are irregular, anastomosing reticular fibers and fibroblasts densely populated by red cells, white cells (especially macrophages) and platelets. Sinusoids are elongated tubular channels lined by fenestrated endothelium with discontinuous basal laminae and communicate with the cords. Its components are lymph, lymphatic vessels and plexuses, lymph nodes, lymphatic cells and lymphoid organs. Its channels are more variable and complex than blood vessels but generally follow the same pattern.
На лимфатические сосуды печени и кишечни: The liver and intestinal lymphatics account for about 80% of body lymph volume. Regions without lymphatics include bone marrow, the epidermis and tissues lacking blood vessels. The CNS was long thought to lack lymphatic vessels, but they were recently identified in the cranial meninges; a vessel with lymphatic features has also been observed in the eye.
Лимфатические капилляры — мелкие тонкост: Lymphatic capillaries are tiny, thin-walled, blind-ended vessels in the tissue extracellular space, wider than blood capillaries. At the blind ends the endothelium lacks a basement membrane; overlapping endothelial cells open when interstitial pressure exceeds intracapillary pressure, letting in fluid, lymphocytes, bacteria, debris and plasma proteins. Lacteals in the small intestine absorb dietary fats. Capillaries form plexuses that converge into larger vessels.
Приносящие сосуды несут нефильтрованную: Afferent vessels carry unfiltered lymph from tissues to nodes; efferent vessels carry filtered lymph from nodes to further nodes or into the venous system and converge into the right lymphatic duct and the thoracic duct. Collecting and larger vessels have one-way valves; capillaries do not. Flow is driven by a pressure gradient from vascular smooth muscle, skeletal muscle contraction and respiratory movements.

Зрение — одно из самых полезных чувств ч: Vision is one of the most useful human senses: more than half of the body's sensory receptors are in the eyes, and a large part of the cerebral cortex processes visual information. The eyes detect visible light, roughly 400 to 700 nanometers in wavelength. An object looks white if it reflects all wavelengths and black if it absorbs all of them.
К вспомогательным структурам относятся в: Accessory structures include the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows, the lacrimal apparatus and the extrinsic eye muscles. The eyelids (palpebrae) cover the eyes during sleep, shield them from excess light and possible objects, and spread lubricating secretions over the eyeball. The upper lid moves more widely than the lower because it contains the levator palpebrae superioris (innervated by cranial nerve III); orbicularis oculi, which closes the lids, is innervated by cranial nerve VII.
Глазная щель — промежуток между веками,: The palpebral fissure is the gap between the upper and lower lids that exposes the eyeball. The lacrimal caruncle, a small pink spot at the medial canthus, contains oil and sweat glands. The tarsal plate is the connective tissue that supports the eyelids. The conjunctiva is a thin protective mucous membrane covering the sclera; it does not cover the cornea.
Диаметр глазного яблока у взрослого окол: The adult eyeball is about 2.5 cm in diameter; only about one-sixth is exposed to air and the orbit protects the rest. The wall has three layers: the fibrous tunic, the vascular tunic and the retina.
Фиброзная оболочка — наружный слой из пе: The fibrous tunic is the outermost layer, made of the anterior cornea and the posterior sclera. The cornea is transparent and covers the iris: its outer surface is non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium, its middle layer contains collagen fibers and fibroblasts, and its inner surface is simple squamous epithelium. The central cornea gets oxygen from the air, so contact lenses must allow oxygen to pass. The sclera is the white of the eye: it covers everything except the cornea, protects the inner structures, shapes the eyeball and adds rigidity.
Сосудистая оболочка (увеальный тракт) —: The vascular tunic (uvea) is the middle layer with three parts: the choroid, the ciliary body and the iris. The choroid lines the sclera, supplies nutrients to the retina through its many blood vessels and contains melanocytes; melanin absorbs excess light to limit reflection and scatter inside the eye (albinism, a lack of melanin throughout the body, makes bright light cause glare, so affected people often need sunglasses). The ciliary body is the anterior continuation of the choroid, made of the ciliary processes and the ciliary muscle: capillaries in the processes secrete aqueous humor, zonular fibers attach the lens to them, and the ciliary muscle contracts and relaxes to change zonular fiber tension, reshaping the lens for near or distant vision. The iris is the colored part, between the cornea and lens and attached to the ciliary processes; melanin content determines eye color, and it controls how much light enters through the pupil.
Сетчатка — внутренний слой с пигментным: The retina is the innermost layer with a pigmented layer and a neural layer. The pigmented layer is melanin-containing epithelial cells between the choroid and the neural retina. The neural layer is an outgrowth of the brain: it processes visual data before sending impulses along the optic nerve axons. There are three neuronal layers — ganglion cell, bipolar cell and photoreceptor — and light passes through the ganglion and bipolar layers before reaching the photoreceptors. Photoreceptors (rods and cones) convert light into nerve impulses: each retina has about 6 million cones and more than 100 million rods.
Колбочки обеспечивают цветное зрение (во: Cones enable color vision through stimulation of blue, green and red cones in different combinations; rods enable vision in dim light. The optic disc, or blind spot, has no rods or cones. The macula lutea is a flat spot at the center of the posterior retina; the fovea centralis lies in the macula's center, contains only cones and has the highest visual acuity. See the “Retina” card for more.
Хрусталик лежит позади зрачка и радужки,: The lens sits behind the pupil and iris, suspended by zonular fibers from the ciliary muscle; the ciliary muscle enables accommodation for near vision. The lens divides the eye into an anterior cavity and a vitreous cavity. The anterior cavity has an anterior chamber (between the cornea and iris) and a posterior chamber (behind the iris, in front of the zonules and lens).
Обе камеры содержат водянистую влагу, пи: Both chambers contain aqueous humor, which nourishes the cornea and lens; the ciliary body epithelium produces it and it is replaced about every 90 minutes. It drains into Schlemm's canal and then into the body's circulation. The vitreous cavity lies between the lens and retina and contains the vitreous body, a transparent jelly-like substance that holds the retina against the choroid. It is not rapidly replaced and contains phagocytic cells that clear debris; debris can cast shadows on the visual field, called vitreal floaters, which are more common in older adults.

Neuroepithelium forms the retina, ciliary body, iris and optic nerve. Surface ectoderm forms the lens, corneal epithelium and eyelids. Extracellular mesenchyme (neural crest and mesoderm) forms the sclera, corneal endothelium, corneal stroma, blood vessels, muscles and vitreous.

The ophthalmic artery, a branch of the internal carotid, divides into the posterior ciliary, retinal and muscular arteries, which supply the ciliary bodies, retina and muscles. The central retinal artery, a branch of the ophthalmic artery, runs within the optic nerve. Lymphatic drainage is not described in the article.

The oculomotor, trochlear and abducens nerves innervate the extraocular muscles. The ophthalmic nerve branches into the lacrimal, frontal and nasociliary nerves: the lacrimal nerve supplies the lacrimal gland, the frontal nerve supplies sensation to the upper eyelid and forehead, and the nasociliary nerve provides sensory innervation to the eyeball.

Motor units are small, sometimes with a neuron serving only two or three muscle fibers, which allows precise, rapid movement; parts of the brainstem and cerebellum coordinate eye movements. See the “Eye muscles” card for details.
Повреждение любой части глаза может вызв: Injury to any part of the eye can cause discomfort, reduced vision or blindness; the eye is also affected by injury, infection and various diseases. Retinal detachment can result from head trauma or from aging: the neural retina separates from the pigment epithelium, fluid collects between the layers and vision becomes distorted or partially lost; laser surgery can reattach the retina and should be done quickly to prevent permanent damage.
Возрастная макулярная дегенерация (ВМД): Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a degenerative retinal disorder affecting the macula lutea: people keep peripheral vision but lose central, straight-ahead vision. According to the article, AMD is the leading cause of blindness in people over 75, affects over 13 million Americans, and there is no effective treatment.

Роговица — наружный прозрачный слой глаз: The cornea is the outermost clear layer of the eye, directly anterior to the anterior chamber, iris and pupil. It borders the sclera at the corneal limbus and helps refract light entering the eye. It has five layers, from exterior to interior: epithelium, Bowman's membrane, stroma, Descemet's membrane and endothelium. Albumin is the most abundant soluble protein in the human cornea.
Роговица защищает глаз от внешних инфиль: The cornea protects the eye from outside infiltrates and ultraviolet radiation and accounts for about 65% to 75% of light refraction: it makes the initial refraction onto the lens, which further focuses light onto the retina. Tears spread across the eye surface when blinking; their lipid, aqueous and mucin components keep the cornea moist and clean.
Эпителий — клетки и базальная мембрана;: The epithelium consists of epithelial cells and a basement membrane; it blocks foreign objects and substances and absorbs nutrients such as oxygen from tears. Bowman's membrane is a thin, transparent collagen layer; trauma can disrupt it, possibly causing scarring that impairs vision, depending on location and extent.
Строма — самый толстый слой, в основном: The stroma is the thickest layer, made mainly of water and collagen; it maintains the cornea's spherical shape, which is critical for light passage and refraction. Descemet's membrane is a thin layer with relative strength from its collagen fibers, produced by the corneal endothelial cells; it repairs itself with relative ease after injury and protects the internal eye structures from infection and trauma. The endothelium is the innermost thin layer: it maintains corneal clarity by pumping excess fluid out of the stroma; its cells do not appear to regenerate appreciably, so their destruction can cause lasting dysfunction.
Предполагаемый эпителий роговицы образуе: The presumptive corneal epithelium forms from cranial ectoderm adjacent to the lens placode. Neural crest cells migrate to the area between the presumptive epithelium and the lens and later form keratocytes (stromal fibroblasts) and the corneal endothelium.
В роговице нет кровеносных сосудов — это: The cornea contains no blood vessels, which preserves its transparency. It receives nutrients by diffusion: from tear fluid externally and aqueous humor internally. Its nerve fibers also supply neurotrophins.
Эпителий содержит тысячи нервных окончан: The corneal epithelium contains thousands of nerve endings, giving it high sensitivity to foreign objects. Long ciliary nerves from the ophthalmic division of the trigeminal nerve (V1) provide sensory innervation. Corneal nociceptor density is estimated at 300 to 600 times that of skin. Ciliary nerves form mid-stromal, subepithelial/sub-basal and epithelial networks.
Виды трансплантации: сквозная (полнослой: Transplant types are penetrating (full-thickness) keratoplasty and partial-thickness transplants; the recipient cornea's condition mainly determines which is performed. DSAEK (Descemet's-stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty) replaces Descemet's membrane and the endothelium with a graft that includes some stroma, leaving the recipient's superficial layers intact; DMEK (Descemet's membrane endothelial keratoplasty) is the least aggressive: only Descemet's membrane and the endothelium are replaced, with donor tissue that has no stromal component. Phototherapeutic keratectomy uses an excimer laser to remove diseased superficial cornea: scar removal, smoothing, epithelial erosion treatment and changing corneal shape.
Частые состояния: аллергия (пыльца, пыль: Common conditions: allergies (pollen, dust or pet dander; itchiness, redness, stinging or burning, tearing; antihistamine or mast-cell stabilizer drops often help), keratitis (corneal inflammation, often from minor injury, improper contact lens use or infection; antibacterial or antifungal drops, and steroid drops may reduce inflammation), dry eye (poor-quality tear production, a “scratchy” sensation) and injuries (minor scratches typically resolve on their own; deep abrasions can scar, causing blurry vision, light sensitivity or pain).
Дистрофии роговицы — помутнение или изме: Corneal dystrophies involve opacification or altered shaping of one or more layers; they affect both eyes, have a genetic component and progress gradually. Keratoconus (about 1 in 2000) is thinning and cone-shaped bulging, most often diagnosed in teenagers and young adults; treatments include corrective lenses, intracorneal inserts (Intacs) and transplantation in severe cases; corneal cross-linking (riboflavin followed by ultraviolet light) — the FDA first approved these systems for keratoconus in April 2016. Lattice dystrophy is amyloid deposition in the stroma, with autosomal dominant inheritance. Fuchs dystrophy: corneal endothelial cells die, fluid builds up in the stroma — in stage 1 vision is hazy in the morning, in stage 2 it is impaired all day. Map-dot-fingerprint (Cogan's) dystrophy is abnormal development of the epithelial basement membrane, most common at ages 40 to 70, with chronic epithelial erosions.
Иридокорнеальный эндотелиальный синдром: Iridocorneal endothelial syndrome causes glaucoma, visible iris changes and corneal swelling. Pterygia are triangular, pinkish corneal growths, more prevalent in sunny climates; surgical removal is recommended only when vision is impaired, and recurrence is approximately 50%. Varicella-zoster and herpes simplex viruses commonly affect the cornea; herpes zoster ophthalmicus is varicella-zoster reactivation involving the V1 dermatome.
Сетчатка — слой фоторецепторных и глиаль: The retina is a layer of photoreceptor and glial cells in the eye that captures light and sends it along neural pathways as electrical and chemical signals for visual perception. It sits in the posterior segment and forms the innermost boundary, inside the vascular choroid and the fibrous sclera. Diseases of the retina can occur at any life stage and often seriously impair vision and quality of life.
Палочки и колбочки лежат в задней части: Rods and cones are located toward the posterior side of the retina, farthest from where light enters the eye. Rods handle dim light (scotopic vision) and are concentrated in the retinal periphery. Cones handle daylight (photopic vision), detect wavelengths of colored light and are concentrated at the fovea. The retina contains about 6 million cones and often more than 100 million rods. Three cone types are named for the wavelengths they detect: short (tritans), medium (deutrans) and long (protans); together they produce the visible spectrum humans perceive.
Палочки содержат родопсин — светочувстви: Rods contain rhodopsin, a light-sensitive pigment built from retinal, a vitamin A aldehyde; vitamin A is therefore essential to phototransduction. Vitamin A deficiency is a major risk factor for childhood blindness in South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
Десять слоёв сетчатки: The ten layers of the retina
От внутреннего к наружному: (1) внутренн: From innermost to outermost: (1) the inner limiting membrane forms a smooth boundary with the vitreous humor and is formed by Müller glial cells; (2) the retinal nerve fiber layer contains ganglion cell axons mixed with astrocytes and Müller cell processes; (3) the ganglion cell layer contains ganglion cell bodies, whose axons eventually form the optic nerve; (4) in the inner plexiform layer bipolar cell axons synapse onto ganglion cells, and amacrine cell dendrites modulate conduction and prevent lateral potentiation; (5) the inner nuclear layer contains the cell bodies of bipolar, horizontal and amacrine cells; (6) in the outer plexiform layer photoreceptor projections synapse with dendrites of inner nuclear layer cells; (7) the outer nuclear layer contains rod and cone cell bodies; (8) the external limiting membrane is made of gap junctions between photoreceptors and Müller cells; (9) the photoreceptor layer contains rod and cone inner and outer segments (outer segments hold discs with pigments such as rhodopsin; inner segments are rich in mitochondria); (10) the retinal pigment epithelium.
Пигментный эпителий сетчатки (ПЭС) — оди: The retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) is a single cell thick, between the neural retina and Bruch membrane, next to the highly vascularized choroid. With the retinal vessel endothelium it forms the blood-retinal barrier; its functions include ion and water transport and secreting growth factors and cytokines; it recycles all-trans-retinal back to 11-cis-retinal for reuse by rods and cones, and supports photoreceptors and the underlying capillary endothelium.
Макула, или жёлтое пятно (macula lutea),: The macula, also called the macula lutea because of its yellowish pigment, is the most sensitive area and offers the highest visual acuity; on fundoscopy it lies temporal to the optic disc. Lutein and zeaxanthin, carotenoids, form the macular pigments, with anti-inflammatory and blue-light filtering properties; dietary lutein and zeaxanthin increase pigment density and are associated with reduced risk of diabetic retinopathy in adults and retinopathy of prematurity in preterm infants.
Центральная ямка (fovea) — бессосудистое: The fovea is an avascular central depression rich in cones. Concentric subzones, becoming smaller and showing decreasing rod density and fewer covering cell layers: perifovea, parafovea, fovea, foveal avascular zone, foveola and umbo.
Сетчатка развивается из эмбрионального п: The retina develops from the embryonic diencephalon as the optic vesicle during the first month, forming an invagination called the optic sulcus. Invagination forms the neural and pigmented retinal layers: the neural retina comes from the inner layer and the pigmented retina from the outer layer. Mesenchyme surrounding the optic vesicle later develops into the uvea. Ganglion cell axons pass through the optic stalk and form the optic nerve. The optic fissure, an additional ventral invagination, encloses the hyaloid artery, which later becomes the central retinal artery.
Хориоидея питает наружные слои сетчатки,: The choroid supplies the outer retinal layers and major vessels supply the inner layers. The central retinal artery (from the ophthalmic artery) supplies the inner retina: it runs within the optic nerve sheath, enters the eye at the optic disc and divides into superior and inferior arcades. The central retinal vein, the main retinal drainage, runs alongside the artery within the optic nerve sheath. The retina has no lymphatic vessels.
Две длинные задние ресничные артерии (ве: Two long posterior ciliary arteries (branches of the ophthalmic artery) pierce the posterior sclera near the optic nerve entry and supply the choroid in the medial and lateral horizontal planes, then anterior eye structures. The short posterior ciliary arteries (10 to 20 smaller vessels) pierce the posterior sclera in a ring around the optic nerve and form the circle of Zinn, which supplies the optic cup region at the choroid level; terminal arterioles also supply Bruch membrane and the outer retina. Bruch membrane sits between the RPE and the choriocapillaris; the choriocapillaris is thickest behind the fovea (10 micrometers) and thins toward the periphery (7 micrometers).
Зрительный нерв несёт зрительную информа: The optic nerve carries visual information from photoreceptors to the brain. Ganglion cell axons converge and exit the globe at the optic disc, which lacks rods and cones; this produces the blind spot in the visual field.
Близорукость (миопия) — частое нарушение: Myopia is a common refractive disorder in which light converges short of the fovea; one cause is axial elongation of the globe, which strains the retina. High myopia (refractive error of about −6.0 to −8.0 diopters) is a risk factor for retinal detachment and is common in Eastern Asia. Pathological myopia involves axial elongation plus posterior segment deformations such as posterior staphyloma and often causes retinal lesions; myopic maculopathies are among the leading causes of low vision and legal blindness worldwide.
Глазной альбинизм — X-сцепленное заболев: Ocular albinism is an X-linked disorder with fundus hypopigmentation, congenital nystagmus, iris translucency, severely reduced visual acuity and strabismus; it results from mutations in the GPR143 gene, which encodes a melanosome transmembrane protein, disrupting melanin transport into the RPE and iris.
Отслойку сетчатки с круглым разрывом час: Round-hole retinal detachment is often repaired with laser demarcation, which promotes adhesion between the neural retina and RPE; laser photocoagulation is commonly used for small detachments, acting as a barrier that limits subretinal fluid progression. Vitrectomy, removal of the vitreous through the pars plana, is commonly performed for vitreous clouding (such as steroid hyalosis) or vitreoretinal traction.
Клиническое значение: отслойка и сосудис: Clinical significance: detachment and vascular disease
Отслойка сетчатки — отделение ПЭС от вну: Retinal detachment is separation between the RPE and the inner neural retina, causing ischemia and photoreceptor degeneration; it is usually an ocular emergency and early treatment prevents permanent vision loss. Risk factors include myopia, trauma, cataract surgery, diabetic retinopathy and older age. Three types: rhegmatogenous (most common; a retinal tear lets liquefied vitreous seep under the retina), tractional (less common; caused by scarring, often in diabetic retinopathy) and exudative (fluid accumulation and blood-retinal barrier breakdown without tears, as in intraocular tumors or AMD). Posterior vitreous detachment commonly causes rhegmatogenous detachment, when vitreous collagen fails to separate from the inner limiting membrane and tears the retina.
Окклюзия артерий сетчатки: центральной (: Retinal artery occlusion: of the central retinal artery (an ophthalmic emergency, usually from atherosclerosis or embolism from the carotid arteries; fundoscopy shows a cherry-red macular spot with pale surrounding edema) or of branch arteries (about 38% of acute retinal occlusions, with a better visual prognosis). Diabetic retinopathy is retinal microvascular disease caused by high blood sugar, the most common diabetic eye complication and a leading cause of blindness in adults under 75 in developed countries: a nonproliferative stage (microaneurysms, plasma leakage, macular edema) and a proliferative stage (neovascularization, vitreous hemorrhage, tractional retinal detachment).
Клиническое значение: дегенерации и друг: Clinical significance: degenerations and other conditions

Dry (atrophic, non-neovascular) AMD accounts for about 90% of cases: RPE lesions from lipofuscin buildup, with drusen between the RPE and Bruch membrane. Wet (neovascular) AMD accounts for about 10%: abnormal choroidal neovascularization penetrates Bruch membrane, and fragile vessels can bleed and leak plasma, causing macular edema. Advanced age is a major risk factor; AMD is the leading cause of blindness in males and females aged 55 and older.
Глаукома — постепенная дегенерация гангл: Glaucoma is gradual degeneration of ganglion cells and their axons, causing loss of peripheral then central vision; optic cupping occurs as the optic cup enlarges relative to the disc. Closed-angle: the iridocorneal angle closes, blocking aqueous outflow through the trabecular meshwork and raising intraocular pressure; open-angle: the angle is not obstructed, the cause is poorly understood and intraocular pressure may or may not be elevated.
Другие состояния: цитомегаловирусный рет: Other conditions: cytomegalovirus retinitis (an opportunistic viral infection in HIV/AIDS, immunosuppression and organ transplant recipients; the leading cause of blindness in AIDS); retinopathy of prematurity (abnormal vessel proliferation driven by hypoxia, five stages); retinitis pigmentosa (inherited rod-cone dystrophies: night blindness, tunnel vision; the most common inherited retinal disease); retinoblastoma (a malignant tumor of the developing neural retina in young children, loss of function of the Rb1 gene; about 3% of pediatric cancers; leukocoria and strabismus); central serous chorioretinopathy (recurrence in 30 to 40% of cases, more common in middle-aged males, associated with glucocorticoid use); color vision deficiency (red-green is X-linked recessive and affects males more; blue-yellow is rarer; achromatopsia means rods only, grayscale vision).

Мышцы глаза важны для его функции и движ: Eye muscles are integral to eye function and motion. Three groups are described: extraocular muscles, which control external eye movement; intraocular muscles, which control pupil accommodation and light reaction; and protractors and retractors of the eyelids. Deficits in the muscles or their innervating nerves can cause functional impairment.
Все — гладкие: ресничная мышца, сфинктер: All are smooth muscle: the ciliary muscle, the sphincter pupillae and the dilator pupillae. The ciliary muscle is a smooth muscle ring that controls accommodation by altering lens shape and controls aqueous humor flow into Schlemm's canal; it attaches to the zonular fibers that suspend the lens. Contraction lessens lens tension, so the lens becomes more spherical for near focus; relaxation optimizes distant focus. The sphincter pupillae encircles the pupil and constricts its diameter; the dilator pupillae is arranged radially and increases pupillary diameter.
Оси и движения глаза: Axes and movements of the eye
Три оси: вертикальная (приведение — меди: There are three axes: vertical (adduction, medial, and abduction, lateral), transverse (elevation, superior, and depression, inferior) and anteroposterior (intorsion, the superior pole moving medially, and extorsion, the superior pole moving laterally). Rotation about the anteroposterior axis lets the eye adjust to head tilt.
Медиальная прямая — медиальный поворот в: The medial rectus produces medial rotation around the vertical axis and the lateral rectus lateral rotation. The superior rectus primarily elevates and contributes to adduction and intorsion; the inferior rectus depresses and laterally rotates and contributes to adduction and extorsion. The superior oblique abducts, depresses and medially rotates; the inferior oblique abducts, elevates and laterally rotates.
Четыре прямые мышцы начинаются от сухожи: The four rectus muscles originate at the annulus of Zinn, are approximately 40 mm long and insert on the sclera a few millimeters from the limbus. The inferior oblique originates on the orbital floor and inserts on the sclera in the inferotemporal globe. The superior oblique originates in the posterior orbit, travels medially and inserts on the sclera in the superotemporal globe.
Ретракторы верхнего века: мышца, поднима: Upper eyelid retractors: the levator palpebrae superioris, the primary retractor (a skeletal muscle), and the superior tarsal muscle (Müller's muscle; smooth muscle), which also contributes to upper eyelid elevation. Lower eyelid retractors: the capsulopalpebral fascia and the inferior tarsal muscle. Orbicularis oculi is the main eyelid protractor (closure): a flat, ringlike skeletal muscle surrounding the anterior orbit with three parts — orbital, palpebral and lacrimal.
Ресничная и обе зрачковые мышцы — произв: The ciliary and both pupillary muscles are cranial neural crest derivatives that develop from choroid mesenchyme. The extraocular muscles, including the levator palpebrae superioris, derive from periocular mesenchyme. Five of the six extraocular muscles originate at the annulus of Zinn, a tendinous ring overlying the superior orbital fissure and optic foramen; the inferior oblique originates on the orbital portion of the maxilla. Orbicularis oculi derives from second pharyngeal arch mesenchyme and forms from eyelid mesoderm.
Основной приток к глазнице — глазная арт: Most of the orbit's blood supply comes from the ophthalmic artery, a branch of the internal carotid; the infraorbital artery, a branch of the external carotid, also supplies the orbital floor. Ophthalmic artery branches: central retinal, supraorbital, supratrochlear, lacrimal, dorsal nasal, short posterior ciliary, long posterior ciliary, posterior ethmoidal and anterior ethmoidal arteries; the anterior ciliary arteries arise from the muscular branches. The central retinal and ciliary arteries supply intraocular structures; the other branches, plus the infraorbital artery, supply the extraocular muscles and related structures. Venous drainage is by the superior and inferior ophthalmic veins. The existence and location of orbital and eyelid lymphatics are an area of ongoing research and debate.
Нервы наружных мышц входят в глазницу че: Nerves to the extraocular muscles enter the orbit through the superior orbital fissure. The oculomotor nerve (CN III) divides into superior and inferior branches and innervates the superior, medial and inferior recti, the levator palpebrae superioris and the inferior oblique; it carries presynaptic parasympathetic fibers to the ciliary ganglion, and its sympathetic fibers contribute to upper eyelid retraction through the superior tarsal muscle. The trochlear nerve (CN IV) innervates the superior oblique and the abducens nerve (CN VI) innervates the lateral rectus. Orbicularis oculi is innervated by the temporal and zygomatic branches of the facial nerve (CN VII).
Глазной нерв (ветвь V1) делится на лобны: The ophthalmic nerve (a branch of V1) divides into the frontal, nasociliary and lacrimal nerves. The ciliary ganglion contains postsynaptic parasympathetic cell bodies; short ciliary nerves originate from it and carry parasympathetic and sympathetic fibers to the iris and ciliary body; long ciliary nerves branch from the nasociliary nerve and carry postsynaptic sympathetic fibers to the dilator pupillae and afferent fibers from the cornea and iris. The sphincter pupillae is parasympathetically stimulated and the dilator pupillae sympathetically stimulated.
Операции на наружных мышцах глаза выполн: Strabismus surgery is performed on the extraocular muscles to correct eye misalignment. The main types are loosening or weakening, tightening or strengthening, and transposition or repositioning; sutures can be permanent or adjustable (adjustable sutures can be shortened or lengthened in a short period after surgery). Loosening procedures: recession (moving the muscle insertion posteriorly toward its origin), tenotomy, tenectomy, myotomy and myectomy. Tightening procedures: resection (removing a distal portion of the muscle before reattachment), advancement (moving the insertion to a more anterior position) and tucking.
Косоглазие — несовпадение осей глаз, при: Strabismus is misalignment of the eyes so that an object is not focused simultaneously on each fovea. Phoria: an eye turns in (esophoria) or out (exophoria) when the opposite eye is occluded; often asymptomatic but may progress to tropias. Tropia: a spontaneous eye turn without occlusion; more prevalent with tiredness, as phorias become more pronounced and compensation decreases; certain drugs can cause temporary tropias.
Амблиопия — снижение зрения одного глаза: Amblyopia is reduced vision in one eye because the eye and brain do not work together correctly; strabismic amblyopia results from eye misalignment and is initially treated by patching the good eye, possibly requiring strabismus surgery; after age five amblyopic vision is difficult to reverse. Extraocular muscle paralysis: in oculomotor nerve (CN III) palsy most extraocular muscles, the sphincter pupillae and the levator palpebrae superioris are affected — a “down and out” eye on the affected side and a fully dilated, non-reactive pupil; in abducens nerve (CN VI) palsy only the lateral rectus is affected — inability to abduct the eye, which reverts to an adducted position due to unopposed pull of the medial rectus.
