Носослёзная система отводит слёзы с пове: The nasolacrimal system drains tears from the ocular surface to the lacrimal sac and ultimately the nasal cavity. Blockage causes tears to spill over the eyelid and down the cheek, a condition called epiphora.
Каждая слёзная железа размером с миндаль: Each lacrimal gland, about the size of an almond, secretes tears into six to 12 excretory ducts that open onto the upper conjunctiva. Tears enter two small openings (lacrimal puncta), pass through two lacrimal canals, reach the lacrimal sac and drain into the nasolacrimal duct, which empties into the nasal cavity; this explains why the nose gets stuffy when a person cries.
На краю верхнего и нижнего века у медиал: Each upper and lower eyelid has a small opening (punctum) on the lid margin near the medial canthus; each punctum leads to a drainage canal that flows into the lacrimal sac, then the nasal cavity. Lower eyelid: the punctum leads to a 2 mm ampulla running perpendicular to the lid margin, which turns 90° medially to become the inferior canaliculus, traveling 8 to 10 mm to the common canaliculus. Upper eyelid: the superior canaliculus travels 2 mm superiorly in the lid, turns 90° medially, then travels 8 to 10 mm to join the common canaliculus. The common canaliculus drains into the lacrimal sac.
Клапан Розенмюллера на соединении общего: The valve of Rosenmuller, at the junction of the common canaliculus and lacrimal sac, is a one-way valve that prevents reflux from the sac back to the puncta. The lacrimal sac drains inferiorly into the nasolacrimal duct, which is bordered medially by the palatine bone and inferior turbinate and laterally by the maxillary bone. The duct opens at the inferior meatus, beneath the inferior nasal turbinate; the valve of Hasner, a mucosal fold, partially covers the inferior nasal meatus. The lacrimal sac is about 10 to 15 mm in axial length; the nasolacrimal duct is 12 to 18 mm long.
Носослёзный проток начинает формироватьс: The nasolacrimal duct begins forming around 5 weeks of gestation as a linear ectodermal thickening in a groove between the nasal and maxillary prominences. The thickening separates into a solid cord that sinks into surrounding mesenchyme and canalizes, forming the lacrimal sac and the start of the duct. The duct extends intranasally and exits under the inferior turbinate; the lacrimal sac extends caudally to complete the canalicular system. The system is generally patent by birth.
Кровоснабжение — обычно от угловой артер: Blood supply is generally from the angular artery, usually considered a branch of the facial artery (some studies show it can originate from the ophthalmic artery in some individuals); it terminates in anastomosis with the dorsal nasal branch of the ophthalmic artery. The angular artery and vein run alongside the nose near the medial orbit. Lymph: the medial one-third of the upper lid and the medial two-thirds of the lower lid drain to the submandibular lymph nodes; the lateral two-thirds of the upper lid and the lateral one-third of the lower lid drain to the pre-auricular lymph nodes.
Лицевой нерв (VII) даёт двигательную инн: Cranial nerve VII provides motor innervation to facial muscles; their movement aids tear drainage via the lacrimal pump. Cranial nerves III and VII innervate muscles controlling eyelid blinking, the primary driver of the lacrimal pump. Irritation of the ocular surface stimulates the ophthalmic branch of cranial nerve V, starting the reflex tear arc; the efferent pathway involves cranial nerve VII and parasympathetic fibers, and the sympathetic nervous system's role in tear production is not well understood. The orbicularis muscle and surrounding tissues help propel tears from the canaliculi to the nasolacrimal duct via the lacrimal pump mechanism.
Повреждения слёзных путей возможны в люб: Lacrimal duct injuries can occur at any age; lacerations most commonly affect the inferior canaliculus, though both superior and inferior canaliculi may be involved. Repair of an isolated canalicular laceration is recommended within 48 hours, with anastomotic suture with or without canalicular intubation. Both puncta are dilated; if a punctum is uninvolved, it is probed to the sac and irrigated to check for blockages; the medial and lateral ends of the lacerated canaliculus are identified. A silicone stent is an option if only one canaliculus is involved; if both are involved, silicone tubing or a Crawford stent are viable. The skin is sutured as in a simple laceration repair.
Врождённая непроходимость носослёзного п: Congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction, one of the most common nasolacrimal duct pathologies, occurs when the distal duct is not patent. Obstruction is symptomatic in 5% of infants at birth, but most present 4 to 6 weeks after birth. The lacrimal gland does not fully develop until week 6, so infants younger than six weeks cannot produce tears, leaving nothing for the system to obstruct. Acquired nasolacrimal duct obstruction can occur later in life from various causes; symptoms depend on the level of obstruction. Intentional obstruction is used therapeutically: punctal plugs are a common treatment for dry eye symptoms.
Наружное ухо включает ушную раковину (pi: The external ear includes the auricle (pinna), the external auditory canal (meatus) and the outer surface of the tympanic membrane (TM). Its roles are gathering sound, shaping the sound spectrum, providing localization cues and matching impedance between the environment and the middle ear. The pinna acts as a funnel, directing sound into the canal and focusing it onto the TM.
Наружное ухо резонирует примерно на част: The external ear resonates at about 2 to 4 kHz, which is relevant to speech. The pinna may enhance sensitivity to this range; combined with canal resonance, this may have aided speech perception.
Раковина фиброзно-хрящевая, с тонкой пло: The auricle is fibrocartilaginous with thin, adherent skin and is made of elastic cartilage, except the lobule, which is fibrofatty and cartilage-free. It is attached to the skull by intrinsic ligaments and extrinsic muscles (vestigial but with limited activity in some people). The skin has abundant sebaceous glands for lubrication and barrier function.
Структуры: завиток (helix) — наружный за: Structures: the helix is the outer posterosuperior rim curving toward the external meatus; the antihelix is a Y-shaped ridge anterior to the helix, splitting into crura and bounding the conchal bowl; the scapha is the depression between helix and antihelix that shapes high frequencies; the concha is the deepest depression, divided into cymba and cavum conchae, the main acoustic funnel; the tragus is a projection anterior to the concha and meatus, partly shielding the canal opening; the lobule is noncartilaginous, made of adipose and areolar tissue, inferior to the canal opening. The Darwin tubercle may appear on the superior helix, an atavistic remnant with no known function.
Длина около 2,5 см, S-образный ход через: The canal is about 2.5 cm long and S-shaped, running from the conchal bowl to the TM; it is divided into a lateral cartilaginous third and a medial bony two-thirds. The isthmus, at the bony-cartilaginous junction, is the narrowest point.
Хрящевая часть содержит волосяные фоллик: The cartilaginous part has hair follicles, sebaceous glands and ceruminous glands; cerumen traps debris and deters insects. The bony part is the tympanic portion of the temporal bone, lined by thin skin without adnexa, and is highly sensitive. The junction is a common site of cerumen impaction and a transition from flexible to rigid tissue, which increases pain sensitivity; it is a major source of pain in otitis externa. Adults need posterior and superior pinna traction for otoscopy because the canal is not linear with the conchal bowl. A cartilaginous canal block causes more hearing loss than a bony canal block.
Самоочищение — латеральная миграция эпит: Self-cleaning is by lateral epithelial migration from the TM and canal skin; disruption can lead to impaction, keratin buildup and acquired canal cholesteatoma. Cerumen is lubricating, hydrophobic and antimicrobial (lipids, acidic pH); overcleaning raises the risk of otitis externa and microtrauma. Edema at the isthmus can quickly obstruct the canal, causing conductive hearing loss and trapping infection. Fissures of Santorini may let infection spread to periauricular tissues; in immunocompromised patients, malignant (necrotizing) otitis externa can extend toward the skull base.
Две раковины позволяют вычислять межушны: Bilateral auricles allow interaural differences to be computed; the brainstem structures involved are the superior olivary complex (medial and lateral superior olives) and the inferior colliculus. Interaural time differences (ITDs) and level differences (ILDs) vary with azimuth: both increase from 0° (midline) to 90° (lateral) and decrease toward 180° (posterior midline). Binaural cues alone do not fully localize sound in 3D.
Дуплексная теория (Рэлей, 1907): ITD пре: Duplex theory (Rayleigh model, 1907): ITDs dominate low-frequency localization (below about 800 Hz), ILDs dominate high frequencies (above about 1600 Hz), where head shadowing matters, and intermediate frequencies use both; the theory mainly explains horizontal localization, not vertical or front–back discrimination. Pinna geometry filters sound through reflection, diffraction and resonance, creating frequency-specific notches and peaks that depend on elevation and front–back position; these monaural spectral cues help resolve front–back and vertical ambiguity when binaural cues are insufficient.
Раковина развивается из 1-й и 2-й глоточ: The auricle develops from the 1st and 2nd pharyngeal arches and the 1st pharyngeal cleft; morphogenesis starts in weeks 5 to 6 from six auricular hillocks of His around the 1st cleft. Hillocks 1 to 3 (1st arch, mandibular) form the tragus and anterior helix; hillocks 4 to 6 (2nd arch, hyoid) form the antihelix, conchal components and lobule. During fetal life the auricle migrates from a low cervical position to its adult lateral cranial position.
Наружный слуховой проход — из эктодермы: The external auditory canal derives from ectoderm of the 1st pharyngeal cleft, which forms a meatal plug; the plug stays solid for months, then canalizes in the late 2nd to 3rd trimester (about 28 to 32 weeks). The medial ectodermal invagination contributes the outer TM epithelium; the inner mucosal layer comes from 1st pharyngeal pouch endoderm and the intermediate fibrous layer from mesenchyme. Glands of the cartilaginous canal develop later.
Врождённые аномалии: микротия и анотия (: Congenital anomalies: microtia and anotia (abnormal hillock development), preauricular tags and pits (aberrant or incomplete hillock fusion), canal atresia or stenosis (failed canalization of the meatal plug; may cause conductive hearing loss). Syndromic associations include Treacher Collins syndrome and oculoauriculovertebral spectrum (Goldenhar syndrome).
Артерии — в основном из системы наружной: Arterial supply is mainly from the external carotid system, with minor internal carotid contributions via the ophthalmic artery. The posterior auricular artery is the main supply to the posterior auricle, lobule and posterior concha; the superficial temporal artery supplies the superior and anterior auricle, including the helix; the occipital artery gives small superior and posterior auricular branches; the deep auricular artery (maxillary branch) supplies the deep bony canal and the lateral TM surface; the anterior tympanic artery (maxillary branch) gives an indirect internal carotid contribution.
Вены: передняя часть раковины — поверхно: Veins: the anterior auricle drains by the superficial temporal vein; the posterior auricle by the posterior auricular vein (into the external jugular system); the deep canal by the pterygoid venous plexus via the maxillary vein. Lymph: the anterosuperior auricle (helix, tragus), anterior canal and temporal skin drain to preauricular (parotid) nodes; the posterior and superior auricle to mastoid (posterior auricular) nodes; the inferior auricle, lobule and inferior canal to superficial and deep cervical nodes, especially the upper deep cervical chain along the internal jugular vein.
Хрящ не имеет сосудов и питается из надх: Cartilage is avascular and relies on perichondrial supply, so it is vulnerable to ischemia from perichondritis or hematoma; rich anastomoses support flap viability but also allow infection to spread quickly.
Раковина получает смешанную чувствительн: The auricle has mixed sensory supply from the trigeminal (V), facial (VII), glossopharyngeal (IX) and vagus (X) nerves, plus the cervical plexus. The auriculotemporal nerve (V3) supplies the anterosuperior auricle, tragus, anterior helix and adjacent canal (explaining referred ear pain from temporomandibular joint disease); the great auricular nerve (C2–C3) supplies the inferior and posterior auricle, lobule and posterior canal wall (referred otalgia from cervical spine disease or neck dissection); the lesser occipital nerve (C2) supplies the superior and posterior auricle.
Наружный слуховой проход: ушно-височный: External auditory canal: the auriculotemporal nerve supplies the anterior and superior walls (the dominant canal nerve); the auricular branch of the vagus (Arnold) supplies the posterior and inferior walls and part of the concha (stimulation can cause cough, gagging or rarely bradycardia); the facial nerve gives small concha branches; the glossopharyngeal nerve has minor fibers near the TM region (deep referred otalgia). Sensory input converges in the spinal trigeminal nucleus and the upper cervical dorsal horn (C2–C3): pathology in the TMJ, teeth, cervical spine, tonsils/pharynx or larynx can present as ear pain, and otalgia with a normal otoscopic exam should prompt evaluation of these structures.
Собственные мышцы: большая и малая мышцы: Intrinsic muscles: helicis major and minor, tragicus and antitragicus, and the transverse and oblique auricular muscles; mostly shape-maintaining in humans, lying in the perichondrial plane between skin and cartilage. Extrinsic muscles: anterior auricular (temporal fascia to the anterior helix and tragus), superior auricular (epicranial aponeurosis to the superior auricle) and posterior auricular (mastoid to the posterior auricle); they produce minimal voluntary movement. All auricular muscles are supplied by the facial nerve (posterior auricular and temporal branches), consistent with their 2nd pharyngeal arch origin.
Оттопыренные уши (увеличенный ушно-череп: Prominent ears (increased auriculocephalic angle or underdeveloped antihelical fold), lop ear (mild folding or inferior rotation of the superior auricle), the Darwin tubercle (benign) and minor asymmetry. The canal varies in length, diameter and curvature; the location and sharpness of the bony-cartilaginous junction vary, affecting cerumen accumulation and discomfort during instrumentation.
Сера бывает влажной (липкой, коричневой;: Cerumen is wet (sticky and brown, predominant in many populations of European and African ancestry) or dry (friable and gray, more common in East Asian populations); differences reflect genetic variation in glandular secretion and are not pathologic. Increased canal hair is benign and more common in older men. Accessory auricles are abnormal appendages that persist after anterior auricle formation.
Три слоя: кожа, надхрящница и эластическ: There are three principal layers: skin, perichondrium and elastic cartilage; the skin is thin and tightly adherent, so excessive undermining risks ischemia; the perichondrium is the key vascular layer for avascular cartilage, and dissection is usually in the subperichondrial plane. Canal surgery must account for the cartilaginous and bony segments and the isthmus: preserve canal skin to prevent stenosis, avoid excessive cautery in the bony canal (osteitis and fibrosis), instrument the isthmus carefully and maintain epithelial migration. Canalplasty must preserve the thin bony walls; the anterior and inferior walls may dehisce into the TMJ or parotid space.
Отопластика формирует хрящ, сохраняя над: Otoplasty reshapes cartilage while preserving perichondrium, using Mustardé sutures (antihelical folds) and Furnas sutures (conchal setback); hematoma must be prevented since it can cause cartilage necrosis and cauliflower ear. Autologous rib cartilage or porous alloplastic frameworks are used in reconstruction (e.g., microtia), often in stages. Complications: auricular hematoma (separates perichondrium from cartilage, disrupts nutrition and leads to fibrocartilage overgrowth; requires prompt drainage and compression), perichondritis and chondritis (often Pseudomonas), skin flap necrosis, canal stenosis and sensory nerve injury. Nerves at risk: the great auricular nerve (posterior auricular and parotid incisions), the auriculotemporal nerve (temporal incisions) and the vagal auricular branch (stimulation during canal surgery can cause cough or vagal symptoms).
С возрастом размеры раковины увеличивают: With age, auricular dimensions increase with elastic cartilage remodeling and loss of recoil, and the lobule elongates. Lobular piercings are generally well tolerated; cartilaginous piercings have higher rates of delayed healing, infection and perichondritis. Keloids are a significant complication, especially in genetically predisposed people; incidence is reported to be up to an order of magnitude higher in darker-skinned populations, and recurrence is common. Blunt trauma or repetitive shear can cause auricular hematoma; untreated or recurrent hematoma causes cauliflower ear, classically seen in boxing and wrestling.
Наружный отит — обычно инфекционный (чащ: Otitis externa is usually infectious (commonly Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus; “swimmer's ear” follows prolonged exposure to moist or contaminated water): otalgia, pruritus, canal edema, otorrhea, and erythematous, narrowed, tender canal walls; management is mainly topical antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory therapy, with systemic antibiotics reserved for complicated or invasive disease. Surfer's ear (canal exostosis) is reactive bone formation from chronic cold-water exposure: noninfectious and slowly progressive, it can cause canal obstruction and conductive loss. Aural myiasis (fly larvae) and foreign bodies, especially in children, can cause infection, trauma and conductive loss.
Серная пробка: сера вырабатывается церум: Cerumen impaction: cerumen is produced by ceruminous and sebaceous glands in the cartilaginous canal; risk rises with epithelial migration failure or improper cleaning, and cotton-tipped applicators often worsen impaction by pushing cerumen medially; presentation is conductive loss, fullness, sometimes otalgia or secondary infection; management is cerumenolytics followed by irrigation or manual removal (instrumentation can trigger vagal responses: cough, dizziness, rarely bradycardia). Environmental exposure: chronic UV exposure predisposes to actinic keratoses, cutaneous horns, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma (the thin soft-tissue envelope and rich lymphatics favor early spread); cold injury — minimal insulation and terminal vascular supply make the ear prone to frostbite, especially the helical rim.
Врождённые и ростовые нарушения: микроти: Congenital and developmental abnormalities include microtia, anotia, auricular dysplasia and canal atresia, which can cause conductive hearing loss; preauricular pits and tags (anterior to the tragus) may be isolated or part of syndromes such as branchio-oto-renal syndrome, and renal ultrasonography is often warranted when they are found in neonates. Other syndromic associations: Treacher Collins and Crouzon syndromes.
Среднее ухо (барабанная полость) — запол: The middle ear is an air-filled space inside the petrous temporal bone, also called the tympanic cavity. It lies between the tympanic membrane (lateral) and the oval window (medial), linking the outer and inner ears. It houses three auditory ossicles (malleus, incus, stapes) that carry and amplify vibrations from the tympanic membrane to the oval window; stapes footplate movement at the oval window passes mechanical energy into the fluid-filled inner ear, starting hearing.
Сзади полость сообщается с системой возд: Posteriorly it connects to the mastoid air cell system; anteriorly to the eustachian tube, which ventilates the space and equalizes pressure. The tensor tympani and stapedius adjust ossicular mobility and drive the acoustic reflex, which reduces sound transmission to protect the cochlea.
Барабанная перепонка отделяет наружный с: The tympanic membrane separates the external auditory canal from the middle ear and is the main sound-energy input. The pars tensa, a taut fibrous region, makes up most of the membrane and transmits most sound to the ossicles; the pars flaccida (Shrapnell membrane) is a small, compliant superior triangle with little fibrous support, and because of its compliance it is usually the first area to retract or bulge with pressure changes (e.g., Valsalva, acute otitis media).
Колебания идут от перепонки к молоточку,: Vibrations pass from the tympanic membrane to the malleus, which is firmly attached to the membrane's medial surface; the malleus articulates with the incus, which connects to the stapes, the smallest human bone. The stapes footplate sits in the oval window and converts vibration into pressure waves in the inner ear's perilymph. The chain works as an impedance-matching system, raising sound pressure at the oval window by about 20–30 dB via area ratio and lever action.
Мышцы среднего уха и акустический рефлек: Middle ear muscles and the acoustic reflex
Две небольшие скелетные мышцы прикрепляю: Two small skeletal muscles attach to the ossicles. The tensor tympani is innervated by the mandibular nerve (V3) via the nerve to the medial pterygoid; it originates from the cartilaginous eustachian tube, the greater sphenoid wing and the adjacent temporal bone and inserts on the malleus manubrium and neck; contraction increases membrane and ossicular tension, reducing mobility and preferentially restricting low-frequency transmission. It is more often active during chewing, swallowing, speaking and startle than in response to sound.
Стременная мышца иннервируется лицевым н: The stapedius is innervated by the facial nerve via the nerve to the stapedius and inserts on the stapes neck; it is the main effector of the acoustic reflex, acting bilaterally on loud stimuli: it stiffens the chain and reduces transmission, mainly of low frequencies. The reflex is typically triggered about 70–100 dB above hearing threshold, with a latency of about 25–150 ms, which limits protection against impulse sounds but works better against prolonged loud sounds. Reflex testing assesses the middle ear, cochlea, auditory nerve, brainstem pathways and facial nerve; facial nerve lesions proximal to the nerve to the stapedius can abolish the reflex and cause hyperacusis.
Труба соединяет барабанную полость с нос: The tube connects the middle ear cleft to the nasopharynx and is the main regulator of ventilation and pressure. In adults it is about 36 mm long, with a lateral osseous and a medial cartilaginous portion; the cartilaginous part is normally closed. Functions: ventilation and pressure equalization, clearance of secretions, and protection from nasopharyngeal pathogens and pressure swings. The mucosa is continuous with the middle ear and airway, with ciliated pseudostratified columnar epithelium that moves secretions toward the nasopharynx.
Мышца, напрягающая нёбную занавеску (ten: The tensor veli palatini is the main active dilator, acting during swallowing, yawning and chewing; it inserts on the cartilaginous tube's lateral lamina. The levator veli palatini lies inferior and medial to the cartilaginous tube and contributes minimally via medial rotation during swallowing; the salpingopharyngeus arises from the tube's inferior cartilage, blends with palatopharyngeus and has limited direct dilating effect.
Нарушение функции ведёт к отрицательному: Dysfunction leads to negative pressure, membrane retraction, effusion, conductive or mixed hearing loss and chronic disease (otitis media with effusion, chronic otitis media, atelectasis, acquired cholesteatoma). Symptoms include aural fullness, pressure, fluctuating hearing, tinnitus and discomfort with pressure changes. In infancy the tube is shorter, nearly horizontal, compliant and with weaker muscular opening, predisposing children to effusion and recurrent otitis media; with growth it lengthens and becomes more oblique.
Слух лучше всего, когда давление в средн: Hearing is best when middle ear pressure approximates atmospheric pressure, allowing the membrane and chain to move freely. Pressure differentials reduce membrane compliance and ossicular motion, causing conductive loss; severe cases cause barotrauma, retraction, effusion, hemotympanum or perforation. The cleft (tympanic cavity plus mastoid cells) acts as one aerated space; gas absorption tends to create negative pressure, which periodic tubal ventilation counters. Pressure changes during rapid altitude shifts (air travel, diving) can exceed the tube's equalizing capacity.
Барабанная перепонка трёхслойна и происх: The tympanic membrane is trilaminar, derived from all three germ layers: an ectodermal outer layer, an endodermal inner layer and a mesenchymal fibrous middle layer (mesodermal and neural crest origin). It forms at the junction of the first pharyngeal cleft (ectoderm) and first pharyngeal pouch (endoderm), with epithelial components forming around the 5th gestational week. The tympanic cavity arises from first pharyngeal pouch endoderm, expanding laterally; this forms the lining and contributes to the eustachian tube, cavity and mastoid antrum.
Косточки развиваются на 6–8-й неделе из: The ossicles develop in weeks 6–8 from neural crest mesenchyme of the first and second arches: the malleus and incus derive from first-arch Meckel cartilage and the stapes from second-arch Reichert cartilage. Mesenchyme filling the cavity is resorbed after ossification, creating an air-filled space; the ossicles are suspended by ligaments and mucosal folds. Mastoid pneumatization follows from the mastoid antrum during childhood.
Мышцы: напрягающая барабанную перепонку: Muscles: the tensor tympani and tensor veli palatini come from first-arch mesoderm and are innervated by the mandibular nerve; the stapedius comes from second-arch mesoderm and is innervated by the facial nerve; the levator veli palatini and salpingopharyngeus come from fourth-arch mesoderm and are innervated by the vagus (via the pharyngeal plexus).
Артерии — из систем наружной и внутренне: Arterial supply comes from both external and internal carotid systems, with extensive anastomoses providing collateral flow (they may enable spread of infection to intracranial and deep neck structures and raise intraoperative bleeding risk). Tympanic membrane: the lateral surface is supplied mainly by the anterior tympanic artery (maxillary) with a contribution from the deep auricular artery; the medial surface receives branches including the stylomastoid artery; the caroticotympanic arteries add a smaller internal carotid contribution. Middle ear cavity: an anastomotic network including the tympanic branch of the middle meningeal artery, the superior tympanic artery, the petrosal branch, caroticotympanic branches and the stylomastoid artery (usually from the posterior auricular artery); the inferior tympanic artery (ascending pharyngeal) supplies the medial wall and promontory.
Слуховая труба: смешанное кровоснабжение: Eustachian tube: mixed supply from middle ear and nasopharyngeal sources, including the middle meningeal, caroticotympanic, deep auricular, maxillary pharyngeal, ascending palatine and inferior tympanic branches; the artery of the pterygoid canal (Vidian) occasionally contributes. Veins: the tympanic membrane and cavity drain mainly into the pterygoid venous plexus, with additional outflow to the superior petrosal sinus; the stylomastoid region drains to the posterior auricular and retromandibular veins; the tube drains mainly to the pterygoid plexus, with minor drainage to the pharyngeal plexus. These pathways can carry infection between the nasopharynx, middle ear and intracranial structures.
Лимфа: латеральная поверхность перепонки: Lymph: the lateral membrane surface drains to preauricular (parotid) nodes; the middle ear cavity and medial membrane surface to deep cervical nodes, especially the jugulodigastric group; the eustachian tube mainly to retropharyngeal nodes, with secondary drainage to deep cervical nodes; this reflects nasopharyngeal endodermal origin and explains possible spread of nasopharyngeal disease.
Наружная поверхность перепонки получает: The external surface of the tympanic membrane receives somatic input from three nerves: facial (auricular branch, posterosuperior), vagus (auricular branch, posteroinferior) and auriculotemporal (anterosuperior); the overlap contributes to poorly localized referred otalgia. The internal surface and cavity mucosa are supplied by the tympanic plexus on the promontory, formed mainly by the glossopharyngeal tympanic branch plus sympathetic fibers from the carotid plexus; the glossopharyngeal contribution continues as the lesser petrosal nerve to the otic ganglion (parasympathetic pathway).
Слуховая труба: хрящевая и носоглоточная: Eustachian tube: the cartilaginous and nasopharyngeal portions receive sensory fibers from the maxillary nerve (V2) via the pterygopalatine ganglion and pharyngeal branches; the bony portion has additional sensory input from the tympanic plexus. Muscles: the tensor tympani is supplied by a mandibular nerve branch (first arch) and the stapedius by the facial nerve (second arch); the tensor veli palatini is supplied by the mandibular nerve, and the levator veli palatini and salpingopharyngeus by the vagus via the pharyngeal plexus.
Нормальная вариация функции трубы, механ: Normal variation in tubal function, ossicular mechanics and membrane compliance affects pressure regulation and sound transmission without necessarily indicating disease. The eustachian tube shows the greatest clinically relevant variation: length, angulation, cartilage stiffness, mucosal compliance and tensor veli palatini strength; infants have shorter, more horizontal, more compliant tubes. Ossicular variation — ligament laxity, incudomalleolar and incudostapedial joint stiffness and membrane flexibility — can shift frequency-specific transmission and sensitivity slightly; acoustic reflex thresholds vary while protective function remains normal.
Патология отличается от вариации: хронич: Pathology is distinct from variation: chronic tubal dysfunction, effusion, ossicular fixation (including otosclerosis), retraction and ossicular discontinuity are structural or inflammatory and persistent or progressive, whereas physiologic variants are reversible and situational.
Тимпаностомия (вентиляционные трубки) —: Tympanostomy (ventilation tubes) is used for effusion and recurrent acute otitis media to restore aeration and drainage; a myringotomy is made in the anteroinferior or posteroinferior membrane, avoiding the ossicles, chorda tympani and major vessels. Tubes may extrude early; complications: persistent perforation, otorrhea, tympanosclerosis, blockage, early extrusion and rarely focal atrophy or scarring.
Стапедэктомия и стапедотомия — при конду: Stapedectomy and stapedotomy are performed for conductive loss from stapes fixation, most often otosclerosis: stapedectomy removes the suprastructure and stapedotomy fenestrates the fixed footplate, and both place a prosthesis to restore chain continuity; stapedotomy is the preferred technique. Complications: vertigo, sensorineural loss, taste disturbance (chorda tympani injury), prosthesis displacement, perilymph fistula and rarely profound loss (“dead ear”). Bone-conduction devices are indicated for conductive or mixed loss when middle ear reconstruction is not feasible or effective; titanium implants in the mastoid transmit vibration directly to the cochlea, bypassing the ossicles; active middle ear implants are an alternative, and newer active transcutaneous systems (Osia®, Bonebridge™) improve efficiency and reduce skin adverse effects.
Баллонная дилатация слуховой трубы (BDET: Balloon dilation eustachian tuboplasty (BDET) is used for chronic obstructive tubal dysfunction; a balloon catheter is passed transnasally into the cartilaginous tube and inflated under controlled pressure. Complications: epistaxis, mucosal injury, submucosal dissection, transient otalgia, barotrauma and rarely carotid injury given proximity to the parapharyngeal carotid space; contraindications are carotid canal dehiscence or aberrant carotid anatomy, active nasopharyngeal or middle ear infection and inability to access the tube transnasally.
Перепонка сильно реагирует на давление и: The membrane responds strongly to internal and external pressure; rupture can result from rapid external changes (diving, flying), loud sounds or trauma. Acute infection causes fluid buildup and sustained positive pressure, producing a bulging membrane on otoscopy. Inadequate equalization causes otalgia, conductive loss or rupture. Children have higher otitis media risk because of a shorter, more compliant, more horizontal tube. Ossicular discontinuity (trauma or chronic erosion) causes maximal conductive loss; ossicular fixation (otosclerosis) causes progressive conductive loss, often with low-frequency predominance.
Хроническое заболевание может привести к: Chronic disease may produce cholesteatoma, a keratinizing epithelial growth from retraction pockets, usually linked to chronic tubal dysfunction: it erodes bone, may involve the ossicles, the facial canal and temporal structures, and can cause conductive loss, otorrhea and extension. Membrane rupture causes otalgia, conductive loss and occasionally tinnitus; most heal spontaneously, but healing carries contamination and infection risk, so water precautions and avoidance of foreign bodies in the canal are advised.
Лицевой нерв и полость среднего уха: дис: Facial nerve and the middle ear cleft: facial dysfunction affects the stapedius, causing loss of the acoustic reflex, reduced damping and hyperacusis. Causes: Bell palsy (typically idiopathic and linked to reactivation of latent viruses such as herpes simplex), infection (acute otitis media, mastoiditis), trauma, inflammation and iatrogenic injury. Longitudinal temporal bone fractures more often involve the canal and middle ear, causing delayed or partial palsy; transverse fractures involve the otic capsule and cause immediate, severe paralysis. Iatrogenic injury most often occurs during mastoid or middle ear drilling. Regardless of cause, stapedius loss removes a protective mechanism and increases cochlear sound energy.
Внутреннее ухо воспринимает звук и обесп: The inner ear senses sound and supports balance and spatial orientation. It sits within the dense petrous temporal bone and occupies only a few cubic centimeters. It converts mechanical stimuli into neural signals for hearing, gaze stabilization, postural control and navigation: it detects acoustic vibrations at the nanometer scale and tracks angular and linear acceleration. Unlike most sensory systems, it performs mechanical detection, frequency analysis, neural encoding and vestibular integration within one compact bony structure.
Костный лабиринт — улитка, преддверие и: The bony labyrinth consists of the cochlea, vestibule and semicircular canals; it contains perilymph and is embedded in the otic capsule. The membranous labyrinth is suspended within the bony labyrinth, contains endolymph and houses the sensory organs. The cochlea contains the organ of Corti, the main hearing receptor. The vestibular system comprises the utricle, saccule and 3 semicircular ducts, which detect linear acceleration, gravity and angular head movement. The vestibulocochlear nerve (cranial nerve VIII) carries these signals to the CNS.
Слуховой путь: волосковые клетки → спира: Auditory route: hair cells → spiral ganglion → cochlear nerve → cochlear nuclei → superior olivary complex → lateral lemniscus → inferior colliculus → medial geniculate body → auditory cortex. Vestibular route: vestibular nerve → vestibular nuclei and cerebellum, where visual and proprioceptive input is integrated; the vestibulo-ocular reflex stabilizes gaze. Auditory pathways are bilateral early in the brainstem, so unilateral lesions above the cochlear nuclei rarely cause complete deafness; lesions of the cochlea, cochlear nerve or cochlear nucleus can cause profound ipsilateral hearing loss.
Кортиев орган и слуховая трансдукция: Organ of Corti and auditory transduction
Кортиев орган — сенсорный эпителий улитк: The organ of Corti is the cochlear sensory epithelium in the scala media; it rests on the basilar membrane and is associated with the acellular tectorial membrane, and it converts vibration into neural signals. The scala media contains endolymph, which is high in potassium and electrically positive; the electrochemical gradient between endolymph and hair cells drives transduction. Hair cells: 1 row of inner hair cells and 3 rows of outer hair cells along the cochlea. Supporting cells: pillar cells, Deiters cells, Hensen cells, Claudius cells and others; pillar cells form the Corti tunnel, which separates inner and outer hair cells.
Передача звука: колебания барабанной пер: Sound transmission: sound vibrates the tympanic membrane, which moves the malleus, incus and stapes; the stapes footplate at the oval window creates pressure waves in the scala vestibuli perilymph; these waves create a traveling wave along the basilar membrane and dissipate through the scala tympani and round window. Peak basilar membrane displacement depends on frequency, the basis of frequency discrimination. Transduction: basilar membrane motion creates shear between the tectorial membrane and stereocilia; deflection toward the tallest stereocilium stretches tip-link proteins and opens mechanically gated channels; potassium influx depolarizes the hair cell, and voltage-gated calcium channels at the cell base trigger glutamate release onto spiral ganglion afferents; action potentials travel along the cochlear nerve to the cochlear nuclei and onward to the auditory cortex.
Внутренние волосковые клетки — основные: Inner hair cells are the principal receptors: a minority of hair cells but providing about 90% to 95% of auditory nerve afferent input; their stereocilia are not firmly embedded in the tectorial membrane and are stimulated by fluid motion and local forces; injury causes significant hearing impairment and reduced speech discrimination. Outer hair cells function mainly as active mechanical amplifiers rather than primary receptors: they contain the motor protein prestin in their lateral membranes, which changes conformation with membrane potential — depolarization shortens the cell and hyperpolarization lengthens it; the resulting mechanical feedback amplifies basilar membrane vibration, improving sensitivity (credited with about 40 to 60 dB), frequency selectivity and speech discrimination in complex sound. Prestin is a voltage-sensitive membrane protein, not an ATP-driven motor.
Спиральный ганглий: тела нейронов — в ро: Spiral ganglion neurons have their cell bodies in the Rosenthal canal of the modiolus, with central processes forming the cochlear nerve. Type I (about 90% to 95% of afferents) innervate inner hair cells — each inner hair cell receives multiple afferent contacts, enabling precise encoding of intensity, frequency and timing; type II (a small minority) innervate multiple outer hair cells, and their role is incompletely understood. “Hidden hearing loss” (cochlear synaptopathy) describes impaired neural processing with normal pure-tone thresholds; patients often struggle with speech in noise; causes include noise, aging, ototoxic drugs and peripheral neuropathies.
Тонотопика: базальный виток узкий и жёст: Tonotopic organization: the basal turn is narrow and stiff, responding to high frequencies; the apical turn is wider and more compliant, responding to low frequencies; each frequency maximally activates a specific cochlear location, and this map continues through the ascending auditory pathway to the cortex. Efferent modulation: the olivocochlear system projects from the superior olivary complex back to the cochlea; medial efferents act mainly on outer hair cells to regulate amplification and support selective attention, protection against overstimulation and signal detection in noise. The cochlea is an active processor, not just a microphone: a normal audiogram does not guarantee normal hearing, and damage to only a few thousand hair cells can cause profound impairment, reflecting limited regenerative capacity in mammals.
Внутреннее ухо целиком развивается из по: The inner ear arises entirely from surface ectoderm and is the first sensory organ to begin development; development starts in the 3rd week and continues through fetal life. The otic placode is a paired ectodermal thickening lateral to the rhombencephalon; signals including FGFs, Wnts and sonic hedgehog drive induction and patterning. The placode invaginates into an otic pit in the 4th week, then detaches to form the otocyst (otic vesicle), which gives rise to the entire membranous labyrinth. Neuroblasts form the vestibulocochlear (statoacoustic) ganglion, which divides into vestibular and cochlear parts.
Дорсальная (утрикулярная) часть формируе: The dorsal (utricular) portion forms the utricle, semicircular ducts, endolymphatic duct and endolymphatic sac; the ventral (saccular) portion forms the saccule and cochlear duct. Semicircular canals form from outpouching and resorption of utricular tissue beginning in the 6th week and by about the 8th week have their orthogonal orientation. The cochlea develops from an elongating ventral diverticulum and begins spiraling around a mesenchymal core (future modiolus) in the 5th week; by 8 weeks the cochlear duct has about 2.5 turns. The surrounding cartilaginous otic capsule vacuolizes to form perilymphatic spaces (the scala vestibuli and scala tympani); the cochlear duct becomes the scala media, separated by Reissner membrane (above) and the basilar membrane (below). The organ of Corti arises from the prosensory domain of the cochlear duct, with differentiation proceeding from base to apex. The cartilaginous otic capsule ossifies between about 16 and 24 weeks of gestation.
Остановка развития даёт спектр от полной: Developmental arrest produces a spectrum from complete labyrinthine aplasia (Michel deformity) to cochlear hypoplasia, common cavity deformity, incomplete partition, enlarged vestibular aqueduct and isolated semicircular canal malformations; the radiologic classifications used in cochlear implantation are essentially embryologic classifications. ATOH1 and SOX2 are targets for hair-cell regeneration research.
Внутреннее ухо имеет высокую метаболичес: The inner ear has high metabolic demand and limited collateral circulation, so it is vulnerable to ischemia; even brief interruptions can cause irreversible dysfunction. The labyrinthine (internal auditory) artery usually arises from the AICA (in a minority of cases directly from the basilar artery), enters the internal auditory canal alongside the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves and typically divides into the common cochlear artery and the anterior vestibular artery. The anterior vestibular artery supplies the utricle, the superior part of the saccule and the ampullae of the superior and lateral semicircular canals; the common cochlear artery divides into the main cochlear and vestibulocochlear arteries, supplying the cochlea, the posterior semicircular canal and part of the saccule. Spiral vessels run along the modiolus and osseous spiral lamina and supply the organ of Corti, the spiral ganglion, the lateral wall and the stria vascularis.
Внутристриальный барьер «жидкость–кровь»: The intrastrial fluid-blood barrier maintains ion and solute homeostasis and keeps toxins out of the stria vascularis; its disruption is implicated in autoimmune inner ear disease, Ménière disease, drug- and noise-induced hearing loss, sudden deafness and some genetic hearing disorders. Venous drainage generally parallels arterial anatomy but is more variable: spiral modiolar and cochlear aqueduct veins drain the cochlea, and vestibular structures drain via vestibular aqueduct veins and labyrinthine venous channels, reaching the inferior petrosal, superior petrosal and sigmoid sinuses or adjacent dural venous systems.
Лимфатика: традиционно считалось, что у: Lymphatics: traditionally the inner ear was considered to lack a true lymphatic system; newer work shows lymphatic-like drainage and immune mechanisms associated with the endolymphatic sac, and conventional lymphatic vessels comparable to those elsewhere in the head and neck are absent from the cochlea and labyrinth. The endolymphatic sac is thought to regulate fluid balance, immune surveillance, antigen processing and endolymph volume; it lies in the petrous bone and a dural duplication near the cerebellum. Endolymphatic hydrops is distension from increased endolymph volume. The labyrinthine artery functions largely as an end artery: compromise can cause SNHL, acute vestibular syndromes or combined audiovestibular loss, and labyrinthine ischemia may be an early sign of vertebrobasilar insufficiency or AICA infarction.
Преддверно-улитковый нерв имеет улиткову: The vestibulocochlear nerve has cochlear and vestibular divisions and, together with the facial nerve, traverses the internal auditory canal. The cochlear nerve carries afferent auditory information from the organ of Corti; cell bodies lie in the spiral ganglion within the Rosenthal canal, peripheral processes innervate hair cells and central processes form the nerve; it exits the modiolus through the osseous spiral lamina, joins the vestibular nerve in the internal auditory canal and enters the brainstem at the cerebellopontine angle. The vestibular nerve conveys head position, linear acceleration and angular acceleration; receptors are in the utricle, saccule and semicircular canals, with cell bodies in the Scarpa (vestibular) ganglion; central fibers project to the vestibular nuclei and cerebellum. The superior vestibular nerve supplies the utricle, superior canal and lateral canal; the inferior vestibular nerve supplies the saccule and posterior canal.
Эфферентная иннервация: оливо-улитковая: Efferent innervation: the olivocochlear system originates mainly in the superior olivary complex; medial fibers mainly innervate outer hair cells and influence amplification, lateral fibers affect afferent signals near inner hair cells; efferents protect against acoustic damage, mediate attention and improve signal-to-noise ratio. Within the internal auditory canal, the facial nerve occupies the anterosuperior quadrant, the cochlear nerve the anteroinferior quadrant, and the superior and inferior vestibular nerves the posterior quadrants; this matters for schwannomas, temporal bone fractures and skull base surgery.
У внутреннего уха нет собственных скелет: The inner ear has no intrinsic skeletal muscles; two middle ear muscles, the stapedius and tensor tympani, influence hearing by modifying ossicular transmission and protecting the cochlea. The stapedius is the smallest skeletal muscle in the body; it originates from the pyramidal eminence of the posterior middle ear, its tendon inserts on the neck of the stapes, and it is innervated by the nerve to the stapedius, a branch of the facial nerve; contraction pulls the stapes posteriorly, reducing low-frequency energy transmission. The tensor tympani originates from the cartilaginous auditory tube, the greater wing of the sphenoid and adjacent temporal bone, its tendon wraps the cochleariform process and inserts on the malleus handle, and it is innervated by V3; its physiologic role in humans is considered less significant than the stapedius.
Акустический рефлекс — непроизвольная за: The acoustic reflex is an involuntary protective response to intense sound: afferents run through the cochlea, the vestibulocochlear nerve, the cochlear nuclei and the superior olivary complex; efferents through the facial nerve cause bilateral stapedius contraction, attenuating low-frequency energy. Hyperacusis in facial nerve paralysis localizes the lesion proximal to the origin of the nerve to the stapedius.
Грубая анатомия внутреннего уха у разных: The gross anatomy of the inner ear is consistent among individuals, but auditory and vestibular function varies considerably: normal hearing thresholds vary despite normal cochlear structure (basilar membrane mechanics, outer hair cell function, neural synchrony, central processing); age-related changes are most pronounced at high frequencies; speech recognition can vary even when pure-tone thresholds match; otoacoustic emission amplitudes vary among healthy people.
Вестибулярная вариация: чувствительность: Vestibular variation: canal sensitivity, otolith function and vestibulo-ocular reflex gain can vary among asymptomatic people; aging reduces vestibular hair cells, neurons and central processing; healthy people may show dominance of one vestibular system. Central compensation — adaptation of the brainstem, cerebellum and higher pathways after unilateral injury — is the physiologic basis of vestibular rehabilitation; vestibular symptom severity correlates more with the effectiveness of central compensation than with lesion size. The labyrinthine artery usually arises from the AICA but may arise from the basilar artery; branching and venous variants are common and usually do not affect function, but they matter in surgery and imaging interpretation.
Кохлеарная имплантация — стандартное леч: Cochlear implantation is the standard treatment for appropriately selected patients with severe-to-profound SNHL who get limited benefit from amplification; it requires atraumatic insertion of the electrode array into the scala tympani while preserving residual structures; soft-surgery principles (careful cochleostomy or round window insertion) minimize intracochlear trauma and preserve cochlear fluids, improving residual hearing preservation and expanding indications for hybrid electric-acoustic stimulation.
Лицевой нерв — одна из важнейших структу: The facial nerve is among the most important structures at risk: its close relation to the middle ear, mastoid, cochlea and internal auditory canal requires careful planning; variants such as fallopian canal dehiscence and aberrant courses increase complexity, and facial nerve monitoring is routine in cochlear implantation, vestibular schwannoma surgery and other lateral skull base procedures. Vascular structures: the petrous internal carotid artery and jugular bulb lie near the cochlea and middle ear; variants such as high-riding or dehiscent jugular bulbs and aberrant carotid arteries can alter surgical anatomy, high-resolution CT and, when indicated, MRI are essential preoperatively, and missed variants may cause catastrophic hemorrhage. The labyrinthine artery is effectively terminal: vascular injury can cause irreversible hearing loss even when surgery otherwise succeeds.
Хирургия латерального основания черепа —: Lateral skull base surgery addresses lesions of the internal auditory canal, cerebellopontine angle, petrous apex or labyrinth: vestibular schwannomas, meningiomas, epidermoid tumors, temporal bone malignancies; the approach (translabyrinthine, retrosigmoid or middle cranial fossa) depends on tumor characteristics, hearing, facial nerve function and surgeon experience. Complications: minor — transient vertigo, tinnitus, wound infection, taste disturbance and temporary facial weakness; major — cerebrospinal fluid leak, meningitis, permanent facial nerve injury, profound hearing loss, significant vestibular dysfunction, vascular injury and cochlear implant device failure.
Последствия болезней часто несоразмерны: Disease consequences are often out of proportion to lesion size, given the limited regenerative capacity of the cochlea and labyrinth: millimeter-scale damage can cause profound hearing loss, disabling vertigo or permanent imbalance. Sensorineural hearing loss: presbycusis, excessive noise, genetic disorders, autoimmune disease, infection and ototoxic medications (aminoglycosides, platinum chemotherapy, loop diuretics, certain antimalarials). Noise-induced loss primarily affects basal outer hair cells, then may progress to inner hair cells and spiral ganglion neurons. Sudden SNHL is an otologic emergency (loss over hours to days; proposed mechanisms include viral injury, vascular compromise, autoimmune processes and inflammation), and delayed treatment reduces recovery chances.
Вестибулярные нарушения проявляются голо: Vestibular disorders present with vertigo, imbalance, oscillopsia and gait instability; key causes include BPPV, vestibular neuritis, labyrinthitis, Ménière disease, vestibular migraine and vestibular schwannoma; central causes include ischemic stroke, demyelinating disease, neoplasms and neurodegenerative disorders, and distinguishing them is critical because symptoms overlap. Acute hearing loss or vertigo may be an early sign of vertebrobasilar ischemia or AICA compromise, and vascular causes should be considered in patients with cerebrovascular risk factors.
Вестибулярная шваннома — опухоль из шван: Vestibular schwannoma arises from Schwann cells of the vestibular division of the vestibulocochlear nerve and is the most common cerebellopontine angle tumor; typical features include progressive unilateral hearing loss, tinnitus, imbalance and asymmetric audiometric findings, and its close relation to the facial nerve explains its characteristic symptom complex; meningiomas, metastases, demyelinating disease and brainstem disorders can mimic it. Cochlear implantation relies on preserving cochlear architecture and stimulating surviving spiral ganglion neurons, since implants bypass damaged hair cells; understanding cochlear anatomy and tonotopy optimizes electrode placement and outcomes.

Нижняя треть: парные нижние боковые (кры: Lower third: paired lower lateral cartilages form the lateral, middle and medial crura of the alar cartilage; the medial crura form the columella, which adjoins the septal cartilage inferiorly and extends from the upper lip to the nasal tip.

Мышцы носа делят на поднимающие, опускаю: The nasal muscles are grouped as elevators, depressors, compressors and dilators; all are innervated by the facial nerve (CN VII).
Мышца гордецов (procerus), мышца, подним: The procerus, levator labii superioris alaeque nasi and anomalous nasi insert into the alar cartilages; they elevate and shorten the nose, dilating the nasal valves.
Носовая мышца (nasalis) лежит на средних: The nasalis (over the middle two-thirds of the nose) compresses and dilates the nares.
Мышца, опускающая перегородку носа, прик: The depressor septi inserts into the septum and posterior alae and depresses the nose.

Мышца гордецов начинается на носовой кос: The procerus originates on the nasal bone and upper lateral cartilage, inserts on the skin over the glabella and wrinkles the nasal bridge by pulling the medial brows down. The depressor septi originates on the maxilla above the central incisors, inserts on the anterior septum and draws the nose downward. The levator labii superioris alaeque nasi (LLSAN) originates on the frontal process of the maxilla, inserts on the alar cartilage and upper lip, and opens the nostril and elevates the upper lip.
Кровоснабжение наружного носа: Blood supply of the external nose
Нос богато васкуляризирован; много анаст: The nose is highly vascular, with multiple anastomoses and redundant supply.
Спинка носа сверху поверхностно снабжает: The dorsal nasal artery (from the ophthalmic artery) supplies the superior superficial aspect; the angular and superior labial arteries (from the facial artery) supply the lateral nose, ala and columella.
Венозный отток — в переднюю лицевую вену: Venous drainage is to the anterior facial vein, sphenopalatine vein and ethmoid veins. Lymph drains anteriorly via the upper lip lymphatics and posteriorly to the deep cervical and retropharyngeal lymph nodes.
Чувствительную иннервацию дают первая и: The trigeminal nerve (V1 and V2) provides sensation; the facial nerve (VII) innervates the nasal musculature; the olfactory nerve (I) is responsible for the sense of smell.
V1 (глазной нерв) делится на слёзный, ло: V1 (ophthalmic) has three branches: lacrimal, frontal and nasociliary. The infratrochlear nerve (from the nasociliary) supplies the superior external nose. The external nasal nerve (from the nasociliary) exits between the nasal bone border and the upper lateral cartilage and supplies the skin of the nasal tip, medial alae and nasal dorsum.
V2 (верхнечелюстной нерв) снабжает боков: V2 (maxillary) supplies the lateral dorsum and alae bilaterally. The infraorbital nerve gives only an external nasal branch (malar and lateral nose); the supratrochlear and infratrochlear nerves supply the nasal dorsum.
У верхних и нижних боковых хрящей есть ф: The upper and lower lateral cartilages have a fibrous attachment area (the “scroll” region) subject to anatomical variation. Nostril shape and nasal sidewall support vary widely, and both influence perception of nasal airflow.
С возрастом крыльные хрящи размягчаются,: With aging, the alar cartilages soften and soft-tissue connections weaken in the lower two-thirds of the nose (“aging nose syndrome”); possible effects are nasal tip ptosis, nasal valve collapse and nasal obstruction.
Форма носа, угол кончика и ширина перено: Nasal shape (nostril shape, tip angle, bridge width) varies among individuals and reflects genetic and environmental influences.
Толщина, прикрепления и состав мягких тк: Overlying soft tissue thickness, attachments and composition vary among ethnic groups and should inform surgical planning. Nasal septal deviation is common.
При резекции хрящевой перегородки нужно: During cartilaginous septal manipulation with resection, a 1 cm segment of caudal and dorsal cartilage should be kept for structural support. Inferior turbinate surgery should be conservative to preserve humidification; overly aggressive turbinate surgery can cause “empty nose syndrome” with pathological dryness and mucus stasis.
Попеременная заложенность носа может отр: Alternating nasal obstruction may reflect cyclical turbinate congestion. Both mechanical and dynamic factors can impair nasal breathing, and anatomic malalignment of the septum can cause airway obstruction.
Нарушение устойчивости клапана носа (опе: Disruption of nasal valve stability from surgery or trauma may alter airflow or cause airway collapse or obstruction; repair techniques include spreader grafts, butterfly grafts and alar batten grafts. Hypertrophy of the anterior inferior turbinates is a common cause of nasal airway obstruction and may coexist with septal deviation and/or nasal valve collapse.

Кровоснабжение и иннервация перегородки: Blood supply and innervation of the septum
Верхняя часть перегородки: передняя и за: Superior septum: anterior and posterior ethmoidal arteries and the sphenopalatine artery. Anterior septum and nasal floor: terminal branches of the superior labial artery. The greater palatine artery enters via the incisive canal and supplies the septum and floor.
Сплетение Киссельбаха (место Киссельбаха: Kiesselbach plexus (Little area) is a confluence of the superior labial, anterior ethmoidal, greater palatine and sphenopalatine arteries in the anterior septum; it is the most common site of epistaxis.
Чувствительная иннервация: передний решё: Sensory innervation: the anterior ethmoidal nerve (branch of the nasociliary) supplies the anterosuperior internal nose and anterior septal mucosa; the nasopalatine nerve runs along the septum into the incisive canal and supplies the posterior and inferior septum and the mucosa behind the incisors; the superior alveolar nerve supplies the anterior septum near the vestibule.

Боковую стенку образуют: решётчатая кост: The lateral wall is formed by the ethmoid bone, the perpendicular plate of the palatine bone, the medial pterygoid plate of the sphenoid, the medial surfaces of the lacrimal bone and maxilla, and the inferior concha.
Три раковины направлены внутрь и изогнут: There are three medially projecting, inferiorly curved conchae: the middle and superior (parts of the ethmoid) and the inferior (a separate bone); a normal variant is the supreme concha. When covered by mucosa the conchae are called turbinates; they enlarge the surface area for humidifying and warming air.
Раковины образуют четыре канала: три нос: The turbinates form four channels: three meatuses and the sphenoethmoidal recess.
Клиновидно-решётчатое углубление — над в: The sphenoethmoidal recess lies above the superior turbinate, below the roof; it drains the sphenoid sinus.
Верхний ход — между верхней и средней ра: The superior meatus lies between the superior and middle turbinates and drains the posterior ethmoid sinus.
Средний ход — между средней и нижней рак: The middle meatus lies between the middle and inferior turbinates and drains the frontal, anterior ethmoid and maxillary sinuses.
Нижний ход — между нижней раковиной и дн: The inferior meatus lies between the inferior turbinate and the floor; the nasolacrimal duct enters its anterior portion via the Hasner valve.
Предел носа (limen nasi) — слизистый вал: The limen nasi is a mucosal ridge marking the boundary between the vestibule and the nasal cavity proper. Agger nasi cells are the most anterior of the anterior ethmoid cells, lying anterior and superior to the basal lamella; they form the anterior boundary of the frontal recess.
Лобная бухта — между задней стенкой ячее: The frontal recess lies between the posterior wall of the agger nasi cells and the middle turbinate.
Крючковидный отросток — тонкая серповидн: The uncinate process is a thin, crescent-shaped ethmoid bone attached anteriorly to the lacrimal bone, inferiorly to the inferior turbinate and superiorly to the lamina papyracea; it shields the infundibulum sinuses from inhaled particles.
Бумажная пластинка (lamina papyracea) —: The lamina papyracea is the thin bone separating the orbit from the ethmoid air cells.
Решётчатая воронка — пирамидальный канал: The ethmoid infundibulum is a pyramid-shaped channel at the anterior semilunar hiatus; it drains the maxillary, anterior ethmoid and frontal sinuses. The semilunar hiatus lies between the uncinate process (anterior) and the ethmoid bulla (posterior) and empties the infundibulum. The ethmoid bulla lies just anterior to the semilunar hiatus and superior to the infundibulum; the middle ethmoid air cells open here.
Остиомеатальный комплекс лежит латеральн: The ostiomeatal complex (OMC) lies lateral to the middle turbinate and houses the ostia of the frontal, maxillary and anterior/middle ethmoid sinuses.
Клиновидно-нёбное отверстие связывает по: The sphenopalatine foramen links the nasal cavity to the pterygopalatine fossa, posterior to the middle turbinate in the superior meatus; its contents are the sphenopalatine artery, the nasopalatine branch of V2 and the posterior superior lateral nasal nerves of V2.
Крыша: слизистая с отверстиями, через ко: Roof: the mucosa contains perforations through which olfactory axons pass to the cribriform plate; anteriorly the nasal spine of the frontal bone and the nasal bone, posteriorly the cribriform plate of the ethmoid and the body of the sphenoid.
Дно шире крыши: впереди — нёбный отросто: The floor is broader than the roof: anteriorly the palatine process of the maxilla, posteriorly the horizontal plate of the palatine bone. The incisive canal lies in the floor, posterior to the central incisor and lateral to the septum; it transmits the nasopalatine nerve into the oral cavity and the greater palatine artery into the nasal cavity.
Хоаны — задние отверстия носа, открывающ: The choanae are the posterior nasal apertures opening into the nasopharynx. Boundaries: superior, the sphenoid body; inferior, the horizontal palatine plate; lateral, the medial pterygoid process; medial, the vomer.

The average adult cross-sectional area is about 0.73 cm². At its apex, the upper lateral cartilage and septum meet at a 10–15 degree angle. Кожа — самый большой орган тела и его гл: The skin is the body's largest and primary protective organ; it covers the entire external surface and acts as a “first-order physical barrier” against the environment.
Функции: терморегуляция и защита от ульт: Functions include temperature regulation and protection against ultraviolet light, trauma, pathogens, microorganisms and toxins; it also contributes to immunologic surveillance, sensory perception, control of insensible fluid loss and general homeostasis. Thickness and specialized functions vary by body site.

Эпидермис образует водонепроницаемый бар: The epidermis provides a waterproof barrier and contributes to skin tone. Thick skin (palms and soles) has 5 layers: stratum basale, stratum spinosum, stratum granulosum, stratum lucidum and stratum corneum; elsewhere it has 4 layers, lacking the stratum lucidum.
Клетки эпидермиса: кератиноциты; меланоц: Cell types of the epidermis: keratinocytes; melanocytes (pigment-producing); Langerhans cells (antigen-processing); Merkel cells (tactile receptors sensing pressure changes at the bottom of the epidermis).

It is attached to the epidermis by the basement membrane, and the two layers merge without a clear boundary: the papillary layer is thinner, loose connective tissue; the reticular layer is thicker, less cellular, dense connective tissue of collagen fiber bundles.
Гиподерма (подкожная клетчатка, поверхно: The hypodermis (subcutaneous tissue, also called subcutaneous fascia) is made of fat and connective tissue and contains adipose lobules, sensory neurons, blood vessels and sparse skin appendages such as hair follicles.

Чувствительность: боль, температура, при: Sensation of pain, temperature, touch and deep pressure; mobility, allowing smooth body movement.
Эндокринная функция: запускает биохимиче: Endocrine activity: initiates the biochemical processes of vitamin D production, needed for calcium absorption and bone metabolism.

Состояние кожи (пигментация, гладкость,: Pigmentation, smoothness, elasticity and turgor reflect overall health; skin assessment is a standard part of physical examination.

Thin skin: eyelids, axillae, genitals and exposed mucosal surfaces such as the oral mucosa and vaginal canal. Adult males generally have thicker skin than females, mainly due to androgens.

Skin begins thinning in the 5th decade, mainly from dermal changes: loss of epithelial appendages, elastic fibers and ground substance. Frequent outdoor sun and UV exposure causes premature aging sooner than indoor work.

Разрезы обычно делают по линиям расслабл: Incisions are usually made along relaxed skin tension lines (cleavage lines) to improve healing and reduce scarring, especially in cosmetic surgery; these lines closely match the alignment of collagen fiber bundles in the dermis (per the epidermis article, of collagen and elastic fibers in the reticular dermis).

UVB stimulates melanin secretion, providing built-in photoprotection. Melanin travels through long dendritic processes and is transferred to basal keratinocytes, which phagocytose the tips of the melanocyte processes (cytocrine secretion).

According to the article they derive from CD34-positive bone marrow stem cells and are part of the mononuclear phagocytic system; they contain Birbeck granules and tennis-racket-shaped organelles, express MHC I and MHC II, take up antigens in the skin and carry them to lymph nodes.

In the stratum granulosum, cells flatten into diamond shapes and accumulate keratohyalin granules among tonofibrils.

Cornified cells reach the surface and shed when desmosomes break down; lowered pH near the surface activates kallikrein-related serine peptidase. Hairless skin has more layers (with the added stratum lucidum), so keratinocytes pass through more layers before reaching the surface. The article gives no specific turnover time.
Эпидермальный водный барьер — нераствори: The epidermal water barrier is an insoluble protein layer on the inner plasma membrane formed by cross-linked small proline-rich proteins; cystatin, desmoplakin and filaggrin add mechanical strength. The lipid envelope is a hydrophobic layer on the outer plasma membrane: stratum spinosum keratinocytes make keratohyalin granules and lamellar bodies (glycosphingolipids, phospholipids, ceramides) in Golgi bodies, and the lamellar contents are exocytosed between the granulosum and corneum.
Иммунная защита: адаптивная — антигенпре: Immunological defense: adaptive, in which antigen-presenting cells activate T-cell responses, increasing helper T cells (TH1, TH2, TH17); innate, in which the skin produces antibacterial and antifungal peptides; skin-associated lymphoid tissue helps prevent infection, since even minor breaks can allow it.
Кератиноциты превращают 7-дегидрохолесте: Keratinocytes convert 7-dehydrocholesterol to vitamin D under UV light; they express the vitamin D receptor and activating enzymes, which support keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation. The skin regulates body temperature and water balance, controlling heat exchange (via blood vessels and sweat glands) and water evaporation and absorption.
Плоскоклеточный рак возникает из мутиров: Squamous cell carcinoma arises from mutated keratinocytes, usually from UV damage, in skin types I and II; it presents as scaly, flaky, thick red patches that may bleed (some resemble warts), can metastasize, and often arises from actinic keratoses (premalignant lesions with cutaneous horns).
Базальноклеточный рак — злокачественное: Basal cell carcinoma is a malignancy of the epidermal basal layers; it is much less likely to metastasize than SCC; it is common in sun-exposed areas, often as pearly facial papules with telangiectasias and a strong tendency to ulcerate.
Меланома — высокоинвазивная, потенциальн: Melanoma is a highly invasive, potentially fatal melanocytic tumor, rarer than SCC and BCC; its metastatic potential is largely driven by lesion depth; it can occur anywhere and is usually irregularly pigmented, but can be amelanotic.

Сплетения: The skin is highly vascularized: plexuses lie between the reticular and papillary dermal layers, and larger vessels and capillaries branch from the systemic circulation to supply the subcutaneous tissue and dermis; an extensive lymphatic network runs alongside many blood vessels, especially those at the venous end of capillary networks.

Иннервация включает соматические и вегет: Innervation includes somatic and autonomic nerves. Пилосебацейная единица (стержень волоса,: The pilosebaceous unit (hair shaft, follicle, sebaceous gland, arrector pili muscle) is found across nearly all skin except the lips and palmar/plantar surfaces; it is densest on the scalp.

Сегменты фолликула: воронка (от впячиван: Follicle segments: the infundibulum (from the epidermal invagination to the sebaceous duct opening); the isthmus (from the sebaceous duct opening to the arrector pili insertion); the bulge (between the sebaceous duct opening and arrector pili insertion), thought to contain stem cells; the inferior segment, the growing portion, ending in the bulb, which is indented by the vascularized dermal papilla that drives hair production.

Плечевой сустав по строению шаровидный,: The glenohumeral joint is structurally a ball-and-socket joint and functionally a diarthrodial, multiaxial joint. It is the main articulation of the shoulder girdle, joining the humeral head to the scapular glenoid cavity; the minor shoulder articulations are the sternoclavicular, acromioclavicular and scapulothoracic joints.
Это сустав с наибольшей подвижностью в т: It has the greatest mobility of any human joint; its stabilizers allow wide motion in multiple planes, which predisposes it to injury. The joint is inherently unstable and prone to dislocation, rotator cuff tears and osteoarthritis. Management ranges from conservative rehabilitation to surgery, such as arthroscopic repair for soft tissue injury and total shoulder arthroplasty for severe degeneration; surgery must balance stability with preserved range of motion.

Thickened bands called glenohumeral ligaments sit within the capsulolabral complex; first described in 1829, they become taut at varying degrees of abduction and humeral rotation, unlike typical ligaments. A synovial membrane lines the capsule and secretes fluid to reduce friction.

The subacromial and subscapular bursae are clinically significant because of their vulnerability to injury.

Основные функции — динамическая опора ма: Its main functions are dynamic support of body weight and transmission of force and load from the axial skeleton to the lower extremities, allowing mobility.
Движения происходят вокруг трёх взаимно: The hip moves in three mutually perpendicular axes, all centered at the femoral head: the transverse axis (flexion and extension), the longitudinal axis along the thigh (internal and external rotation) and the sagittal axis from front to back (abduction and adduction).
Факторы стабильности: глубокая вертлужна: Stability factors: a deep acetabulum that encloses almost the entire femoral head, and the acetabular labrum, a fibrocartilaginous collar that provides load transmission, maintains negative pressure (a “vacuum seal”) and regulates synovial fluid hydrodynamics.
Суставная капсула напряжена при разгибан: The joint capsule is tight in extension and more relaxed in flexion. На 4–6-й неделях беременности сустав нач: In weeks 4 to 6 of gestation the hip begins developing from mesoderm; in week 7 a cleft forms in the precartilage cells destined to become the femoral head and acetabulum; by week 11 the hip has largely formed, and the acetabular cartilage fully encircles the femoral head.

The foveal artery, a branch of the posterior division of the obturator artery, runs within the ligamentum teres and helps prevent avascular necrosis if the circumflex arteries are disrupted.

Переднелатеральный доступ используется р: Anterolateral (AL) approach: least commonly used because it violates the hip abductor mechanism; the interval is between tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius; it may cause a postoperative limp in exchange for a theoretically lower dislocation rate.

Mild cases may resolve spontaneously by two weeks; persistent subluxation beyond two weeks needs treatment. It presents with significant pain and inability to bear weight, and about 10% of cases have concurrent sciatic nerve damage. Acute treatment: emergent closed reduction within six hours of injury, with CT afterward to assess bony injury; incarcerated fragments are critical to identify, as they prevent full reduction and can cause intra-articular and chondral damage; irreducible dislocations, those with incarcerated fragments and delayed presentations require urgent open reduction; complex dislocations with acetabular or femoral fractures are treated with open reduction and internal fixation.

Pathogenesis: cartilage wear reduces joint space and bone spurs (osteophytes) form. Nonsurgical care: weight loss, activity modification, physical therapy, assistive devices and medications (NSAIDs, acetaminophen, corticosteroids). Surgical options for refractory pain: osteotomy, hip resurfacing and total hip replacement.

Вывих колена может затрагивать все три с: Knee dislocation can involve all three articulations; tibiofemoral dislocation is more severe and needs emergency care; it is usually caused by high force, and knee X-ray and MRI assess the extent.
