Диафрагмальный нерв — главным образом C3: The phrenic nerve is mainly C3, C4 and C5. It supplies the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm with motor and sensory fibers and carries sympathetic vasomotor fibers to regional vessels; it runs anterior to the subclavian artery and posterior to the subclavian vein. Direct segmental branches: rectus capitis anterior and lateralis (C1–C2); longus capitis (C1–C3, C4 or C5, depending on variation); sensory supply of the trapezius (C2 or C3 to C4).
Чувствительные (кожные) ветви выходят из: Sensory (cutaneous) branches emerge from a common point at the posterior SCM, called the Erb point in some sources and the punctum nervosum or nerve point in others; some sources reserve Erb point for the superior brachial plexus trunk (C5–C6). Lesser occipital (C2): skin of the posterior/superior scalp and neck near the auricle. Greater auricular (C2–C3): skin over the parotid, mastoid and adjacent area. Transverse cervical (C2–C3): anterior cervical skin. Supraclavicular (C3–C4): skin over the clavicle and shoulder.
Симпатический вклад: каждая из участвующ: Sympathetic contribution: each contributing ventral ramus receives gray rami communicantes from the superior cervical ganglion; these fibers regulate vasomotor, sudomotor and pilomotor function in the head, neck and upper thorax.
Образовано передними ветвями C5–C8 и T1;: Formed by the ventral rami of C5–C8 and T1; it passes anterior to the 1st rib and posterior to the clavicle before reaching the axilla. Structure: 5 roots → 3 trunks → 6 divisions → 3 cords → 5 terminal branches. Classification is based on anatomic origin, since many nerves carry both motor and sensory fibers. Roots: dorsal scapular (C4–C5) — rhomboids and levator scapulae; phrenic contribution from C5 (with C3 and C4); long thoracic (C5–C7) — serratus anterior. Upper trunk (C5–C6): nerve to subclavius and suprascapular nerve (supraspinatus and infraspinatus); its emergence at the upper cervical outlet is called Erb point by some sources.
Латеральный пучок (C5–C7): латеральный г: Lateral cord (C5–C7): lateral pectoral nerve (pectoralis major); musculocutaneous nerve (coracobrachialis, brachialis, biceps brachii, lateral forearm sensation); lateral root of the median nerve. Posterior cord (5 branches): upper and lower subscapular nerves (subscapularis; the lower also teres major); axillary nerve (deltoid, teres minor, lateral shoulder/arm sensation via the superior lateral cutaneous nerve); thoracodorsal nerve (C6–C8; latissimus dorsi); radial nerve (from all five roots; triceps, supinator, anconeus, brachioradialis, forearm extensors; sensation to the posterior arm, dorsal hand and first dorsal web space). Medial cord (C8–T1; 5 nerves): medial pectoral nerve (pectoralis minor and part of pectoralis major); medial root of the median nerve; medial cutaneous nerves of the arm and forearm (sensory only); ulnar nerve (flexor carpi ulnaris, medial flexor digitorum profundus, two medial lumbricals, interossei, hypothenar muscles; sensation to the 5th digit, hypothenar area and medial 4th digit). Terminal branches (5): musculocutaneous, axillary, radial, median, ulnar. See the Brachial plexus card for more.
Спинномозговые нервы формируются как сег: Spinal nerves form as segmental mixed nerves where the spinal cord meets paraxial mesoderm. Each segment produces a ventral (motor) root and a dorsal (sensory) root that unite into a short mixed nerve. Motor axons arise from ventral horn (basal plate) motor neurons and follow stereotyped pathways guided by conserved signaling molecules. Sensory neurons gather in the dorsal root ganglion, which derives largely from trunk neural crest cells.
Сомиты и производные склеротомов задают: Somites and their sclerotome derivatives set the segmental pattern: growth cones pass through the anterior (cranial) half of each sclerotome, while the posterior (caudal) half has inhibitory cues, which ensures proper nerve spacing relative to the vertebrae. Boundary cap cells (neural crest-derived) sit at motor exit and sensory entry zones, regulating axon passage and CNS integrity; semaphorin-mediated repulsion between boundary cap cells and immature motor neurons keeps cell bodies from migrating out of the CNS. Fetal dissection studies suggest that plexus branching patterns and common variants are established in utero.
Радикулярные артерии сопровождают корешк: Radicular arteries accompany the roots through the cervical intervertebral foramina. The first six usually arise from the vertebral arteries or the ascending cervical branch of the thyrocervical trunk; these two sources anastomose, maintaining flow if one is blocked. The 7th and 8th segments consistently arise from the costocervical trunk.
Лимфатические сосуды в эпиневрии идут вд: Lymphatic vessels in the epineurium run alongside the vasa nervorum, supporting fluid balance and immune cell movement within the nerve. Proximally, spinal meningeal lymphatic channels in the epidural and foraminal regions surround the spinal ganglia and roots; they interface with CSF exchange and drain toward the cervical lymph nodes.
Нормальные анатомические различия шейных: Normal anatomic differences are common in the cervical nerves and plexuses; variant root contributions and interneuronal connections can shift motor and sensory territories. Dermatome charts are approximate, and levels should be confirmed with imaging and electrodiagnostics when treatment depends on the specific segment. A C1 dorsal root ganglion is present in 13.3% of cadaveric specimens; the C1 dorsal root is absent in 53.4% of individuals and, when present, often joins the spinal accessory nerve (CN XI) rather than entering the cord directly. Intradural links between adjacent dorsal rootlets are common and can confound dermatomal localization, most frequently between C5–C6 (25%) and C6–C7 (20%). Nonsegmental sensory pathways can let nociceptive signals bypass the expected level, potentially causing false localization of radiculopathy.
Варианты происхождения плечевого сплетен: Plexus origin variation (3,055 upper limbs): regular root arrangement forming trunks 84%; prefixed plexus (extra C4 contribution) 11%; postfixed plexus (extra T2 contribution) 1%.
Хирургически значимая патология шейных н: Surgically relevant cervical nerve pathology is usually compressive radiculopathy from disc herniation or spondylosis. Most patients first receive a trial of nonoperative care; surgery is indicated for persistent arm pain or numbness despite conservative treatment, or for an objective neurologic deficit. Preoperative planning requires precise level identification: dermatomal and myotomal findings should be correlated with MRI, and electrodiagnostics are used when imaging shows multilevel involvement or symptoms are atypical.
Выбор операции зависит от компрессирующе: Procedure selection depends on compressive anatomy, spinal alignment and whether motion preservation is needed: anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) is a durable option with broad applicability; cervical disc arthroplasty is a motion-preserving option for selected patients with suitable anatomy; posterior cervical foraminotomy is for foraminal stenosis in patients suited to a posterior approach.
Паралич C5 — признанное, нередко отсроче: C5 palsy is a recognized, often delayed complication of cervical decompression. The most reproducible prognostic factor is preoperative foraminal stenosis at C4–C5. In a systematic review and multivariate meta-analysis, the odds of C5 palsy roughly tripled for each millimeter decrease in preoperative C4–C5 foraminal diameter, with a stronger association for posterior procedures. The proposed mechanism is traction vulnerability of the C5 root during decompression, given its short and relatively fixed course.
Дегенеративная радикулопатия — самая час: Degenerative radiculopathy is the most common clinical problem, with neck pain, unilateral arm pain, sensory change and occasional focal weakness. Level-specific patterns: C5 — deltoid and biceps weakness, diminished biceps reflex; C6 — wrist extension weakness, sensory change over the radial forearm or thumb; C7 — triceps weakness, sensory symptoms extending into the middle finger; C8 — weak finger flexion and intrinsic hand function, sensory change along the ulnar hand. Pattern recognition helps direct imaging and referral for progressive deficits.
Дифференциальный диагноз: плексопатия пл: Differential diagnosis: brachial plexopathy and distal entrapment neuropathies; root lesions are more often linked to neck pain and reflex asymmetry, and paraspinal denervation on EMG supports a radicular cause. Phrenic nerve: the diaphragm receives its motor supply mainly from C3–C5; iatrogenic phrenic dysfunction can occur during cervical and shoulder procedures, and regional anesthesia near the scalene level can temporarily impair diaphragmatic movement through local anesthetic spread. Cervical dorsal rami contribute to axial neck pain and cervicogenic headache through facet joint innervation; consensus guidance supports diagnosing with medial branch blocks before radiofrequency ablation.
Перикард — плотный двухслойный фиброзный: The pericardium is a tough, two-layered fibrous sac that encloses the heart and great vessels. It holds the heart steady in the mediastinum, allows cardiac movement and separates the heart from the lungs and other mediastinal structures; it also contributes to normal cardiac physiology. Knowing its anatomy helps clinicians recognize and manage pericarditis, pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade and constrictive pericarditis. Procedures such as pericardial incisions and pericardiocentesis require precise anatomical knowledge to avoid injuring the heart, great vessels, phrenic nerves and nearby structures. Knowledge of pericardial reflections, sinuses and attachments guides catheter-based procedures, imaging interpretation and management of postsurgical complications.
Перикард состоит из фиброзного и серозно: The pericardium has a fibrous layer and a serous layer. The fibrous pericardium is a conical sac whose apex is fused to the roots of the great vessels at the heart's base; its broad base fuses with the central fibrous area of the diaphragm. Weak sternopericardial ligaments connect its anterior surface to the sternum.
Серозный перикард: париетальная пластинк: Serous pericardium: the parietal layer lines the fibrous pericardium; the visceral layer reflects around the great vessel roots and covers the heart. A potential space between the parietal and visceral layers may hold a small amount of fluid. The visceral layer over the heart, excluding the great vessels, is the epicardium.
Пазухи: отражения серозного перикарда об: Sinuses: serous reflections form the transverse and oblique sinuses. The oblique sinus is a superior cul-de-sac extending from the inferior vena cava; it lies between the two left and two right pulmonary veins, its anterior wall is the posterior wall of the left atrium between the four pulmonary veins, and it provides expansion space for the left atrium. The transverse sinus is open at both ends; it is formed where the visceral layer reflects from the posterior aorta and pulmonary trunk to the anterior atrium, and a finger can pass behind the aorta and pulmonary trunk, in front of the right superior vena cava and beside the left atrial appendage.
Функции: удерживает сердце в средостении: Functions: positions the heart in the mediastinum and limits excessive motion; provides a lubricated surface for cardiac contraction and lung movement; prevents excessive cardiac dilatation and, in disease, limits overfilling; modulates pressure-volume relationships of the chambers by confining the heart; equalizes hydrostatic, inertial and gravitational forces to maintain left ventricular geometry; acts as a mechanical barrier to infection.
Фиброзный перикард развивается из попере: The fibrous pericardium develops from the septum transversum, a thick mass of cranial mesenchyme that forms on day 22. During craniocaudal folding it moves to a position caudal to the developing heart. The diaphragm and pericardium, among other structures, both arise from it.
Артериальное кровоснабжение — перикардио: Arterial supply: pericardiophrenic branches of the internal thoracic arteries. Visceral pericardium: lymph drains into the tracheal and bronchial lymphatic chains. Parietal pericardium: lymphatic drainage resembles that of the sternum and diaphragm; lymphatics from the ventral parietal pericardium ascend along the phrenic nerves, and lymphatic channels connect with those of the reflected mediastinal pleura on the lateral and posterior surfaces.
Фиброзный перикард и париетальная серозн: The fibrous pericardium and parietal serous layer are innervated by the phrenic nerve. The visceral pericardium has autonomic innervation from the cardiac plexus — sympathetic fibers from spinal levels T1 to T4 and parasympathetic fibers from the vagus nerve — and, unlike the parietal layer, it is insensitive to pain.
Врождённое отсутствие перикарда редко; о: Congenital absence is rare and typically involves part or all of the left parietal pericardium. Pericardial cysts are uncommon, benign remnants of abnormal embryologic development; their clinical importance lies in distinguishing them from neoplasms.
Операции на сердце требуют разреза перик: Cardiac surgery requires an incision through the pericardium. Handling the pericardium during surgery can cause inflammation and thickening, which may cause adhesion to the posterior sternum at the incision and complicate reoperation. Pericardiocentesis: the needle is inserted just below and to the left of the xiphoid process, aimed toward the left shoulder; it passes above the diaphragm into the pericardial space next to the right ventricle. This allows drainage of effusions and access for epicardial catheter procedures, including arrhythmia ablation.
Перикардит — воспаление перикарда. Причи: Pericarditis is inflammation of the pericardium. Causes include infectious, immunologic, metabolic, neoplastic, traumatic and idiopathic origins. Myocardial infarction can cause localized pericarditis over the infarcted area; postinfectious fibrinous pericarditis develops 1 to 3 days after infarction, and Dressler syndrome arises weeks to months after. Typical features are fever, pleuritic chest pain radiating to the back and a pericardial friction rub; pain worsens when lying flat and eases when sitting up. The ECG typically shows diffuse ST-segment elevation and PR-segment depression. It is usually self-limited and treated with NSAIDs and colchicine (NSAIDs inhibit cyclooxygenase; colchicine interferes with mitotic division in metaphase).
Выпот в полость перикарда: в норме там л: Pericardial effusion: normally only a few milliliters of fluid are present, acting as a lubricant; pericarditis and other conditions can produce hundreds of milliliters of exudative or transudative fluid. It is identified readily by echocardiography, and a chest radiograph may show an enlarged, bag-like cardiac silhouette when significant.
Тампонада сердца: жидкость или кровь (на: Cardiac tamponade: fluid or blood (for example, from injury) in the pericardial space reduces room for cardiac expansion; impaired venous return markedly lowers cardiac output; it is a life-threatening emergency often requiring urgent intervention. The clinical triad is hypotension, muffled heart sounds and jugular venous distension. Pulsus paradoxus: systolic pressure drops by more than 10 mm Hg during inspiration. Echocardiography is the first-line diagnostic tool. Management options are needle drainage, a pericardial catheter for continuous drainage or a surgical pericardial–pleural window.
Констриктивный перикардит: хроническое в: Constrictive pericarditis: chronic pericardial inflammation causes thickening, fibrosis and often calcification, restricting ventricular diastolic filling. It may follow acute pericarditis, particularly neoplastic, bacterial or radiation-induced cases, and is also associated with tuberculosis and recent cardiac surgery. Signs of fluid overload are jugular venous distension, hepatomegaly and peripheral edema. Kussmaul sign is a paradoxical rise in jugular venous pressure during inspiration; the pericardial knock is an extra heart sound immediately after S1.
Знание анатомии молочной железы необходи: Understanding breast anatomy is needed to understand breast disorders and plan breast surgery. Most breasts show some degree of asymmetry; other deformities include kyphosis, scoliosis and pectus deformities. The breast is mostly glandular (milk-producing) and fatty tissue, and the ratio varies between individuals and with age, post-menopausal status, postpartum status and pregnancy. Estrogen strongly influences the breast: as menopause approaches, falling estrogen reduces glandular tissue and fatty tissue increases.
Основанием молочной железы служит больша: The pectoralis major forms the base of the breast; it extends from the 2nd to the 6th rib early in life and the breast may extend below the 6th rib as it matures and sags. Cooper ligaments anchor the breast to the pectoralis major fascia; they are flexible, allowing breast movement, but stretch with time and age, leading to a ptotic (sagging) breast. Because of gravity, the lower pole of the breast is fuller than the upper pole. The tail of Spence extends into the axilla at the lateral edges of the breast. The nipple is usually just superior to the inframammary crease.
The nipple is important in breastfeeding. The minimum nipple length for successful breastfeeding is about 7 mm. Nipple topography varies (flat, short or inverted), which can hinder breastfeeding.
Развитие молочной железы (маммогенез) на: Breast development (mastogenesis) begins around the 6th week of gestation. The milk line, a linear elevation, appears around the 7th week. By the end of the 8th week a rudimentary breast forms from a thickened white line and later becomes the mature breast. Basal cells proliferate throughout embryogenesis. Around 30 weeks, occlusion of the papillary bag forms the nipple-areolar complex; the final nipple appears at about 38 to 40 weeks.
Артерии. Кожа получает кровь из подкожно: Arterial supply: the skin receives blood from the subdermal plexus, which connects with deeper arterioles supplying breast tissue. Sources are the thoracoacromial artery; internal mammary perforators (2nd to 5th); the lateral thoracic artery; the thoracodorsal artery; and terminal branches of intercostal perforators (3rd to 8th). At least 60% of the blood supply comes from superomedial perforators of the internal mammary artery.
Вены. Поверхностные вены лежат вдоль пер: Venous drainage: superficial veins lie along the anterior fascia and form the venous plexus of Haller under the nipple-areolar complex; deep veins drain into chest wall veins. Lymphatic drainage: superficial lymphatics include the areolar and subareolar plexus, the latter also receiving lymph from glandular tissue; superficial lymphatics travel posteriorly and medially to reach the axillary lymph nodes.
Чувствительная иннервация осуществляется: Sensory innervation comes mainly from intercostal nerve branches T3 to T5; the lower cervical plexus also provides sensory innervation. Nipple sensation comes from the lateral cutaneous branch of T4.
Основание железы лежит на передней зубча: The base of the breast lies over the serratus anterior (lateral chest wall) and external oblique (anterolateral chest wall). The pectoralis major is a broad, fan-shaped muscle originating from the lateral sternum and clavicle and inserting at the humeral head; it receives most of its blood from the internal mammary and thoracoacromial arteries. The breast lies over it and the upper rectus abdominis, between the 2nd and 6th ribs. Cooper ligaments run from the skin dermis to the pectoralis fascia; they are not taut, which preserves breast mobility, and loss of ligament tension with age causes breast ptosis. The muscle is often used in plastic reconstruction to cover breast implants.
Передняя зубчатая мышца — веерообразная: The serratus anterior is a fan-shaped muscle along the lateral chest wall, supplied by the thoracodorsal and lateral thoracic arteries and innervated by the long thoracic nerve; damage to the long thoracic nerve during axillary dissection can cause scapular winging. The rectus abdominis marks the inferior border of the breast, is supplied by the inferior and superior epigastric vessels, and the TRAM flap, based on the superior epigastric vessels, is sometimes used after breast cancer surgery. The external oblique is a fan-shaped muscle on the anterolateral thoracic wall, with segmental blood supply from the inferior intercostal vessels, bordering the inferolateral breast. Nipple position in young women: just superior to the inframammary crease, at the 4th rib.
Добавочный сосок встречается у 1–4 % нас: Accessory nipple occurs in 1% to 4% of the population, equally in males and females; it is usually found in the inframammary area, is prone to the same disorders as a typical nipple and may be excised if it causes anxiety, poor cosmesis, discomfort or limits arm movement. Athelia is congenital absence of the nipple-areolar complex, seen in Poland syndrome, often with an underdeveloped breast. Amastia is complete absence of breast tissue except the nipple-areolar complex. Inverted nipple is common: the nipple retracts into the breast rather than protruding, sometimes protruding and retracting intermittently; it occurs in men and women and makes breastfeeding difficult.
Операции при раке молочной железы включа: Breast cancer surgeries include lumpectomy and modified mastectomy. Total or radical mastectomy is now performed less often. Studies show that skin-sparing or modified radical mastectomy is effective, though there is a small recurrence risk.
Косметические операции могут увеличивать: Cosmetic surgery can augment or reduce breast size. Breast lifts and augmentation are cosmetic; reduction is often done for medical reasons such as back or neck pain. Reconstruction may be done for asymmetry or after cancer surgery. Breast augmentation, when done properly, does not prevent breastfeeding. Breast reduction can damage nipple-areolar nerves, reducing sensation, and may limit breastfeeding due to removal of glandular tissue. Breast implants can interfere with mammography.
Доброкачественные и злокачественные забо: Benign and malignant disorders include puerperal mastitis, mastalgia, fibrocystic changes, fat necrosis, breast abscess and galactorrhea. Breast cancer is described as a leading cause of death in women and one of the most common malignancies in women worldwide; recommended measures for women over 45 include regular mammograms, healthy diet, exercise and not smoking.
Мужская молочная железа развивается из т: Male breasts develop from the same embryological cells as female breasts. Males produce less estrogen and more androgen, and an estrogen-testosterone imbalance can enlarge the breasts. About two-thirds of boys have temporary gynecomastia, which resolves within 24 months. Medications such as digoxin and spironolactone can cause gynecomastia.
Тазовое дно — мышечно-фасциальный компле: The pelvic floor is a musculofascial complex forming the pelvis's inferior boundary. Its main components are the levator ani (pubococcygeus, puborectalis, iliococcygeus) and coccygeus, supported by endopelvic fascia and the perineal membrane. It encloses urinary, genital and anorectal compartments. Blood supply is mainly from the internal pudendal vessels; innervation is by the pudendal nerve, with contributions from the sacral plexus. Functions: it supports pelvic viscera, maintains continence, aids defecation and micturition, and contributes to respiration and lumbopelvic stability. It varies with age, sex and body habitus. Dysfunction presents as urinary and fecal incontinence, organ prolapse, constipation and chronic pelvic pain.
Границы: сверху — воображаемая линия от: Boundaries: superiorly, an imaginary line from the pubis to the sacral promontory; inferiorly, a line between the ischial tuberosities and the coccyx apex, separating pelvis from perineum. Compartments: anterior (urinary) — bladder, bladder neck, urethra; middle (genital) — vagina and uterus in females, prostate in males; posterior — anus, anal canal, sigmoid colon and rectum.
Компоненты: диафрагма таза — копчиковая: Components: the pelvic diaphragm — ischiococcygeus and levator ani, reinforced superiorly by endopelvic fascia; the urogenital diaphragm (triangular ligament, fascia of Carcassonne) — between the ischium and pubic symphysis, traversed by the urethra and, in females, the vagina; the perineum (perineal membrane) — links the deep pelvic floor muscles with the coccyx and anal sphincter complex.
Дыхание: в покое тазовое дно куполообраз: Respiration: at rest the floor is cupuliform, resembling the respiratory diaphragm. Contraction moves it anterosuperiorly toward the pubis and relaxation moves it posteroinferiorly toward the sacrum and ischium; overall excursion is about 3 cm and the coccyx moves in parallel. Inspiratory diaphragm descent is accompanied by caudal pelvic diaphragm displacement, and the reverse occurs on expiration. Reference lines assessed by pelvic MRI: the pubococcygeal line (pubic symphysis to coccyx) and the anorectal angle (between the posterior rectal wall and the anal canal axis). In healthy individuals the bladder base, upper third of the vagina and peritoneal cavity lie at or near the pubococcygeal line, and the anorectal angle is cranial or adjacent to it. Contraction elevates viscera and makes the anorectal angle more acute; the floor modulates pressure for continence, evacuation and sexual function.
Поза: тазовое дно стабилизирует грудопоя: Posture: the floor stabilizes the thoracolumbar and lumbosacral columns in coordination with the diaphragm and abdominal muscles (transversus abdominis, obliques). Associated muscles are the obturator internus, piriformis, adductors and gluteus maximus. It enables trunk rotation, sit-to-stand transitions, orthostasis, cough and sneeze. Fascial connections: the diaphragm links anteriorly via the transversalis fascia and posteriorly via the thoracolumbar fascia; rectus abdominis fascia merges with the adductors at the pubic symphysis. Gluteus maximus continuity contributes to load transfer during gait and standing, and hip rotator activity is influenced by pelvic floor tone.
Мышечный компонент таза и ранние тазовые: The pelvic muscular component and early pelvic organs arise from two groups. The pubocaudal muscles give rise to the ischiococcygeus and levator ani; in males they form the pubosacral or pubourethral–bladder–rectosacral ligaments, in females the pubourethral–bladder–uterus–rectosacral ligaments. The Gegenbauer muscles, near the cloacal region, form the pelvic floor musculature after the genitourinary septum descends; the septum separates the rectum from the bladder and urethra in males, and from the bladder, urethra and vagina in females. Gegenbauer derivatives are the anal and urethral sphincters, bulbocavernosus, ischiocavernosus, and the superficial and deep transverse perineal muscles. In the fetus these structures form a functional unit with coordinated activity.
Артерии: внутренняя половая артерия (от: Arterial: the internal pudendal artery (from the internal iliac) divides into the inferior rectal and perineal arteries; anterior branches are the urethral artery, penile arteries (males) and vestibular and clitoral arteries (females). Venous: internal pudendal veins drain into the internal iliac vein; external pudendal veins drain into the femoral vein. Lymphatics: deep drainage to the internal iliac lymph nodes; external genitalia drain to the superficial inguinal lymph nodes.
Innervation involves both the autonomic and somatic systems. Key components are the superior hypogastric plexus with hypogastric nerves, pelvic splanchnic nerves, the inferior hypogastric (pelvic) plexus and the pudendal nerve. Parasympathetic fibers synapse with the myenteric plexus of the rectum and anal canal. Voluntary contraction occurs during intentional activity such as physiotherapy; involuntary activation occurs with coordinated limb, trunk, breathing and coughing patterns, and its neural basis is incompletely understood. Cortical representation is the medial precentral gyrus; premotor activation precedes contraction and is modulated by higher centers. In the brainstem, the retroambiguus nucleus of the medulla is implicated in respiration-associated involuntary activity. Coordination occurs among the respiratory diaphragm, abdominal wall and tongue; the mechanisms are not fully elucidated.
The pelvic diaphragm was first described in 1861. The levator ani complex comprises the coccygeus (ischiococcygeus), iliococcygeus, pubococcygeus and puborectalis. The iliococcygeus and pubococcygeus originate from the pectineal line of the pubis and the fascia of the obturator internus and insert toward the coccyx, ischial spine, sacrum and triangular ligament; the puborectalis originates from the inferior pubic ramus. The pubococcygeus and related parts are termed pubovisceral muscles; they form pubourethral, pubovaginal, puboperineal and puboanal functional units with the urethra, vagina, perineal body and anal canal. Fiber composition is about 2/3 type I (slow-twitch, oxidative) and the rest type II (fast-twitch, glycolytic). The muscles act as an integrated unit with limited structural separation, and fiber orientation is multidirectional.
Мочеполовая диафрагма образована промежн: The urogenital diaphragm is formed by the perineal membrane/fascia, including the deep transverse perineal muscle, and connects the pelvic diaphragm to the perineum. Its anterior portion, traversed by urinary and genital tracts, lies between the ischiopubic rami and its apex points toward the pubic symphysis. The pre-urethral region (transverse perineal ligament) continues with the ischiopubic rami and obturator fascia. The retro-urethral region has superior and inferior layers with the Guthrie muscle (deep transverse perineal) between them; the deeper lamina merges with Denonvilliers fascia, which covers the prostate and seminal vesicles.
Промежность — задняя часть продолжения м: The perineum is the posterior continuation of the urogenital diaphragm and the inferior continuation of the levator ani; its boundaries are hard to define. It has muscular continuity with the urethra, vagina or prostate, and rectum, and reaches the coccyx via the anococcygeal raphe. Structures are embedded in connective tissue, consistent with a biotensegrity model in which tension transmits through fascia. Fascia is described as developing before contractile muscle units.
Эндотазовая фасция лежит под брюшиной и: The endopelvic fascia lies below the peritoneum and covers the superior pelvic floor, extending to the obturator internus, piriformis and levator ani. A transverse band merges with the pubic periosteum; posterior integration with the pubosacral ligament forms a cup enveloping the pelvic floor, urogenital diaphragm and perineum. Fascial sheaths are the hypogastric sheath (pubis to sacrum), the umbilical-prevesical sheath (retropubic space) and the vesicorectal sheath (with vesicular-deferential vessels). Denonvilliers fascia contributes to posterior compartmentalization and envelops the middle rectal vessels. Gluteus maximus and levator ani are linked in the ischioanal region via the gluteoperineal muscle and connective tissue bundles.
У женщин с возрастом снижается мышечный: Women with advancing age: reduced muscle tone and widened genital hiatus, more caudal orientation of iliococcygeus fiber vectors, and reduced thickness of the posterior puborectalis. Excess body weight in women: increased rectal distension and caudal displacement of the perineum, cervix and bladder neck. Men: body weight has a greater influence on morphology and function; with aging and excess weight, tissue distension, perineal elongation, reduced strength and thinning of the ischiocavernosus and puborectalis are described.
Дисфункция может возникать после акушерс: Dysfunction may follow obstetric, urologic or colorectal surgery through disruption of support or neural pathways. Vaginal delivery stretches the pelvic outlet and imposes mechanical stress on the levator ani, perineal body and pudendal nerve; risks include avulsion, perineal trauma and pudendal neuropraxia (transient conduction block from stretch or compression). Cesarean section avoids direct pelvic floor strain during delivery. Radical prostatectomy may affect continence by disrupting the external urethral sphincter complex, endopelvic fascia or associated innervation. Colorectal cancer surgery may compromise continence and defecation through injury to the anorectal sphincter complex or pelvic autonomic plexus, or by altering the anorectal angle.
Сниженный тонус или электрическая дисфун: Reduced pelvic floor tone or electrical dysfunction is linked to visceral prolapse, urinary incontinence and fecal constipation. Contributing factors are birth injury, advanced age, obesity, chronic conditions raising intra-abdominal pressure and prior pelvic surgery. Compartment-specific disorders: anterior — dysuria, urinary frequency, cystocele, urinary incontinence; central — vaginal or uterine prolapse; posterior — pelvic or anal pain, constipation, rectal prolapse, fecal incontinence.
Стрессовое недержание мочи — самая часта: Stress urinary incontinence (SUI) is the most common urinary incontinence; it occurs when intra-abdominal pressure (cough, sneeze) exceeds muscular control and affects about 26% of women aged 30–59, peaking at 40–49. It involves the levator ani and its interaction with adjacent muscles and joints; the article notes pelvic floor activity may act in opposition to the respiratory diaphragm. Findings: decreased or altered EMG activity; lumbar hypolordosis alters pelvic alignment, increasing vertical loading and repetitive fiber strain, potentially causing progressive levator weakening. SUI in men is commonly associated with prior prostatectomy.

Nonrelaxing pelvic floor dysfunction is poorly understood and often misdiagnosed; superficial EMG and video urodynamics may aid diagnosis.
Пролапс и запор: пролапс тазовых органов: Prolapse and constipation: pelvic organ prolapse affects about 30%–50% of women and may cause urinary, rectal and sexual dysfunction; male rectal prolapse data are limited. Constipation affects about 27% of the population, more often women; contributors include paradoxical contraction, generalized weakness and incomplete relaxation after contraction. Pain: conditions with shared painful muscle dysfunction (spasm, trigger points, hypotonia) are interstitial cystitis, chronic prostatitis, provoked vestibulodynia and chronic vulvar pain. Myofascial pelvic pain affects about 14%–23% of women; prevalence in men is less reliable. Trigger points may form from trauma, scarring, postural change, metabolic or nutritional problems and stress, and persistent ischemia is described. Central sensitization may cause allodynia and hyperalgesia. Pudendal nerve syndrome (Alcock canal syndrome) is entrapment of the pudendal nerve (S2–S4) between the sacrospinous and sacrotuberous ligaments near the ischial spine, causing unilateral genital, anal and pelvic pain; it is often linked to muscular hypertonia.
Обследование: анамнез и осмотр позы, орт: Evaluation begins with history and visual inspection of posture, orthostatism, gait and lower-limb and lumbar movement; manual exam assesses contraction, strength and trigger points externally and via intravaginal or rectal palpation; the Q-tip test identifies painful areas, pain is rated 0–10 and strength graded 0–5; coccygeal palpation during sitting and lateral decubitus assesses contraction. Diagnostic tools: intravaginal manometry (mm Hg) and dynamometry (N); the active straight leg raise test (SIJ pain, lumbar and hip differentiation); intravaginal cones; ultrasound (intravaginal, transrectal, suprapubic, perineal; 2D or 3D); EMG (surface or intramuscular; activity is lower supine with flexed legs than sitting or standing); MRI is the preferred modality (in healthy individuals the relaxed floor descends about 3 cm below the pubococcygeal line); CT allows dynamic assessment but is secondary to MRI because of radiation.

Показаны эпифиз и третий желудочек (Body: The model shows the pineal body and the third ventricle (BodyParts3D 4.0); the white matter of the brain is shown translucent. Blood supply, the pineal stalk and the commissures are not highlighted in the model.
Эпифиз (epiphysis cerebri) — небольшая н: The pineal gland (epiphysis cerebri) is a small, unpaired central structure, essentially an appendage of the brain. Its weight in humans is 100–150 mg. The mammalian pineal is secretory; in fish and amphibians it is directly photoreceptive (the third eye), and in reptiles and birds it has mixed photoreceptor and secretory function. Pinealocytes retain elements of their photoreceptive evolutionary history in both structure and function. Melatonin is synthesized within pinealocytes, from tryptophan. The gland is richly vascularized.
Главная иннервация симпатическая, от вер: The principal innervation is sympathetic, arising from the superior cervical ganglion. There is good evidence for parasympathetic, commissural and peptidergic innervation, but major functional importance has been shown only for sympathetic innervation. Sympathetic denervation in mammals abolishes rhythmic melatonin synthesis and its light-dark control. Norepinephrine is the major transmitter, acting via beta-1-adrenoceptors with potentiation by alpha-1 stimulation; the role of neural serotonin is probably not negligible. Norepinephrine peaks at night, about 180 degrees out of phase with the pineal serotonin rhythm. cAMP is a second messenger that stimulates AA-NAT activity. Neuropeptides modulate melatonin synthesis in vitro, but their physiological importance is unclear.
Основная синтетическая активность приход: Most synthetic activity occurs in the dark phase, with a 7–150-fold increase in AA-NAT (serotonin-N-acetyltransferase) activity. AA-NAT is usually rate-limiting; serotonin availability may also play a role. cDNAs for AA-NAT and the O-methylating enzyme HIOMT have been cloned. Regulation differs by species: in humans and ovines AA-NAT is regulated mainly post-transcriptionally, whereas in rodents cAMP-dependent phosphorylation of a transcription factor is key. The rapid decline in AA-NAT activity with nighttime light depends on proteasomal proteolysis. AA-NAT is expressed mainly in the pineal, retina and, to a lesser extent, other brain areas, pituitary and testis; apart from the pineal these contribute little to circulating levels. Melatonin may be synthesized elsewhere, including the gastrointestinal tract, where it may affect gut function.
У человека и грызунов мелатонин метаболи: In humans and rodents, melatonin is metabolized mainly in the liver to 6-sulphatoxymelatonin (aMT6s), via 6-hydroxylation followed by sulfate conjugation. Exogenous melatonin has a metabolic half-life of about 20–60 minutes, a large hepatic first-pass effect and biphasic elimination.
Ритм мелатонина эндогенный и порождается: The melatonin rhythm is endogenous and generated by clock-gene networks in the suprachiasmatic nuclei (SCN), the main mammalian clock; in some lower vertebrates the pineal is itself a self-sustaining clock. The main feedback loop: CLOCK/BMAL1 complexes activate Per1, Per2, Per3, Cry1, Cry2 and Reverbα; PER and CRY accumulate into the night and repress CLOCK/BMAL1, and their decline in early morning restarts the cycle. PER stability is controlled by casein kinases (CK1δ/ε) and CRY stability by the F-box protein FBXL3. The SCN synchronizes peripheral clocks. Light-dark cycles entrain the SCN via the retina and the retinohypothalamic projection. A separate central clock, independent of the SCN, is entrained by food availability and timing. Other entrainment factors (zeitgebers) include activity/rest, social and feeding cues, temperature, knowledge of clock time, certain drugs and melatonin itself.
Свет подавляет мелатонин: у человека для: Light suppresses melatonin: human suppression needs about 2500 lux of full-spectrum light (domestic light is about 100–500 lux). Blue light (~480 nm) is most effective, and melanopsin is named as a key opsin in this non-image-forming system. In photoperiodic mammals, melatonin duration encodes daylength — long melatonin duration equals short days — and in sheep melatonin can time the seasonal reproductive cycle. In mammals, melatonin is modulatory for circadian organization; pinealectomy in constant light disrupts rodent circadian activity.
Секреция мелатонина у человека (взрослые: Human melatonin secretion (temperate adults): onset about 21:00–22:00 h, peak 02:00–04:00 h, offset 07:00–09:00 h. The plasma peak is about 60–70 pg/ml, saliva is roughly one third of plasma, and minima are usually below 5 pg/ml. The melatonin peak coincides with the core temperature nadir and maximum sleepiness. The lifetime peak is at about 3–5 years of age; levels decline in puberty and are low in old age.
У человека и некоторых других видов эпиф: In humans and some other species, the gland usually shows some calcification after puberty; it may begin earlier. Calcification may not reduce metabolic activity, except that activity declines with aging in general.
Опухоли у детей часто связаны с нарушени: Tumours in children are often linked to abnormal pubertal development; precocity is mainly due to beta-hCG from germ cell tumours, and delayed puberty has also been reported. Types: germ cell (teratomas, germinomas, choriocarcinomas, endodermal sinus tumours, mixed germ cell tumours), parenchymal (pineoblastoma and pineocytoma) and stromal (gliomas). All are rare (<1% of intracranial space-occupying lesions); most occur under age 20, except parenchymal tumours, which occur equally in adults and children. Germinomas respond well to radiation, and primary surgery is usually preferred for other types. CSF tumour markers (alpha-fetoprotein, beta-hCG), CSF cytology and CT or MRI aid diagnosis.
Частые симптомы связаны с гидроцефалией: Common symptoms are from hydrocephalus (headache, vomiting, drowsiness); the classic triad is visual problems, diabetes insipidus and reproductive abnormalities. Germinomas and teratomas occur mainly in males, and precocious puberty is more often linked to teratoma. In a review of 37 patients (Drummond and Rosenfeld), 5-year survival was 62% for germinomas and 14% for other malignant tumours. Mixed pineocytoma-pineoblastoma types exist, and a new histology-based classification relates closely to survival. Pineal papillary tumour, described in 2003, resembles subcommissural organ ependymal cells. Melatonin is absent or very low in treated or untreated germinomas; the consequences are undefined.
Посмертные находки, по данным источника:: Post-mortem links named in the source: hypoplasia with retinal disease, heavier pineals in breast cancer or melanoma, very large pineals (~1 g) in a rare insulin-resistance syndrome, and small pineals with decreased melatonin in SIDS.
Показаны левые латеральная и медиальная: The model shows the left cephalic and basilic veins, the subclavian vein and the brachiocephalic vein. The deep veins of the forearm and arm (venae comitantes), the dorsal venous arch and the median cubital vein are not highlighted in this set.
Большой круг кровообращения включает арт: The systemic circulation has an arterial supply and a venous drainage, linked by capillary beds. The venous system returns deoxygenated blood to the heart, which pumps it to the pulmonary circulation for gas exchange. Veins drain most blood against gravity, and one-way valves prevent backflow. The venous system divides into superficial and deep systems, which share many connections. Superficial veins drain skin and superficial fascia; deep veins drain deeper fascia, muscles and bones. Adjacent arteries and muscle contraction help propel venous blood.
Вены верхней конечности по строению сход: Upper limb veins resemble arteries in structure; the main difference is that veins contain valves in the lumen. Veins have less muscle in their walls, so they can expand and act as a blood reservoir with a large holding capacity. Venous drainage starts at the digits and flows toward the heart.
Поверхностная система: тыльная венозная: Superficial system: the dorsal venous arch on the hand drains into the cephalic vein (radial side) and basilic vein (medial side). The median cubital vein connects them at the cubital fossa (median cephalic and median basilic connections). The cephalic vein penetrates the deep fascia at the axilla and drains into the subclavian vein; the basilic vein drains into the brachial or axillary vein.
Глубокая система: глубокие вены сопровож: Deep system: deep veins follow the arteries. The deep and superficial palmar arches drain into the ulnar and radial veins, and the deep veins travel in pairs with the arteries (venae comitantes) in the forearm. The ulnar and radial veins merge at the cubital fossa to form the brachial vein, which becomes the axillary vein at the axilla. The axillary vein becomes the subclavian vein, which merges with the internal jugular vein to form the brachiocephalic vein. The brachiocephalic veins merge into the superior vena cava, which drains into the right atrium. Common pathway: perforating veins connect the superficial and deep systems and ultimately drain into the deep veins.
Вены развиваются из мезенхимы, происходя: Veins develop from mesenchymal tissue, which originates from the mesodermal germ layer. Upper limb veins elongate as the limbs develop.
Вены верхней конечности отводят дезоксиг: Upper limb veins carry deoxygenated blood away from the limb; they do not supply blood to it. Lymphatics follow the veins and drain toward the heart. Superficial lymphatics: radial-side vessels follow the cephalic vein and drain into the infraclavicular lymph nodes; medial-side vessels follow the basilic vein and drain into the supratrochlear lymph nodes (above the medial epicondyle of the humerus), which then drain into the axillary nodes. Deep lymphatics follow the deep veins and drain into the axillary nodes. Lymph returns to the central circulation via the right lymphatic duct (right upper limb) or the thoracic duct (left upper limb).
Основные нервы верхней конечности отходя: The primary upper limb nerves arise from the brachial plexus: axillary, musculocutaneous, radial, ulnar and median; they branch further to innervate skin and muscles, and deoxygenated blood from these tissues drains via nearby veins. Sympathetic control increases venous lumen diameter through vasoconstriction, or by withdrawal of vasoconstrictor stimulus, acting through epinephrine and norepinephrine on alpha and beta receptors. Parasympathetic control indirectly dilates veins: acetylcholine triggers nitric oxide production, which relaxes the smooth muscle lining the veins.
Мышцы кисти (червеобразные, тыльные и ла: Hand muscles (lumbricals, dorsal and palmar interossei, adductor pollicis, thenar and hypothenar muscles, palmaris brevis) drain into the dorsal venous arch and the superficial and deep palmar arches. The 19 forearm muscles drain toward the radial and ulnar veins; those with tendons inserting into the hand also drain into the hand arches. Arm muscles (coracobrachialis, biceps brachii, brachialis, triceps brachii) drain into the brachial, axillary and subclavian veins; those attaching in the forearm also drain into the ulnar and radial veins. Drainage overlaps because of muscle origins and insertions, and perforating veins between the superficial and deep systems add collateral pathways.
Венозная система верхней конечности очен: The upper limb venous system is highly variable, with interconnections at many different sites. The only consistent feature is that upper limb veins drain into the superior vena cava via the subclavian veins. Vein size varies: the basilic vein is usually the larger superficial arm vein, but sometimes the cephalic vein is larger. The basilic vein may drain directly into the brachial or axillary vein.
Вены руки используют для диализа: хирург: Arm veins are used in dialysis: surgeons may create an arteriovenous shunt or fistula, which joins a vein directly to an artery so that blood flow bypasses the capillary beds; dialysis is common in patients with kidney disease. Varicosities are engorged, enlarged veins caused by venous insufficiency, and varicose veins may be removed for cosmetic reasons.
Анатомия вен необходима для вмешательств: Vein anatomy is essential for procedures that puncture veins, from venous blood sampling to intravenous catheterization. The median cubital vein is a common site for blood sampling, and the biceps aponeurosis protects it and helps prevent hematoma formation. Vein appearance can be a clinical clue: rarely, upper limb veins may dilate unilaterally or bilaterally due to venous insufficiency or obstruction of the subclavian vein, brachiocephalic vein or superior vena cava.
Глубокий венозный тромбоз (ТГВ) возможен: Upper and lower limb veins can both develop deep vein thrombosis (DVT), causing pain and swelling. Embolization of a DVT can occlude the pulmonary arteries, leading to right heart failure, hypoxia, pulmonary hypertension and pulseless electrical activity; pulmonary embolism is a feared outcome, potentially fatal. Inflammation and infection of upper limb veins cause thrombophlebitis; recurrence in different locations is called migratory thrombophlebitis, associated mainly with pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
Подкожный (сафенный) нерв, артерия и вен: The saphenous nerve, artery and vein form a neurovascular bundle that runs through the thigh and leg. The saphenous nerve is strictly sensory, with no motor function, and innervates the anteromedial leg. The saphenous artery is a distant branch of the femoral artery, arising from the descending genicular artery, and is the main blood supply to the surfaces of the knee. The greater and lesser saphenous veins drain the superficial surfaces of the leg and empty into the femoral veins proximally.
При гаструляции формируются три зародыше: Gastrulation forms three germ layers: ectoderm, endoderm and mesoderm. The ectoderm has two parts, surface ectoderm and neuroectoderm. Neural crest cells, derived from neuroectoderm, give rise to the peripheral nervous system, including the saphenous nerve. The vessels that form the saphenous artery and vein derive from mesoderm. Despite different germ layer origins, the vasculature corresponds with the neuronal network. Schwann cells that myelinate peripheral nerves release VEGF, which stimulates growth of the associated blood vessels.
Подкожная артерия обычно отходит от нисх: The saphenous artery typically branches from the descending genicular artery, which arises from the medial wall of the femoral artery in the adductor canal. It travels with the saphenous nerve under the sartorius muscle. Just proximal to the knee joint there can be up to three cutaneous branches supplying the anterior and medial knee surfaces; distal to the knee, cutaneous branches supply the anterior skin of the proximal third of the leg. The saphenous artery has a muscular branch that supplies the sartorius.
Большая подкожная вена — подкожная, пове: The great saphenous vein is a subcutaneous vein and the superficial vein of the leg. It originates from the dorsal venous arch of the foot, runs anterior to the medial malleolus, up the medial leg and past the medial femoral epicondyle, enters the saphenous opening and drains into the femoral vein.
Подкожный нерв — крупнейшая кожная ветвь: The saphenous nerve is the largest cutaneous branch of the femoral nerve and derives from L3 and L4 of the lumbar plexus. It has two major divisions, the sartorial and infrapatellar branches; together they supply sensation to the medial, anteromedial and posteromedial aspects of the distal thigh, down to the medial malleolus. In the proximal thigh it arises as a posterior division of the femoral nerve and lies lateral to the femoral artery; in the adductor canal it lies medial to the femoral artery. It divides at the level of the medial femoral condyle, on exiting the adductor canal.
Подколенниковая (инфрапателлярная) ветвь: The infrapatellar branch runs anteriorly and innervates the anteroinferior and medial knee. The sartorial branch runs along the medial knee, behind the sartorius, and passes superficially through the fascia between the gracilis and sartorius tendons, providing sensation to the medial leg and ankle.
Обычно подкожная артерия — ветвь нисходя: Normally the saphenous artery is a branch of the descending genicular artery, which arises from the femoral artery. Some anatomical studies report absence of the descending genicular artery, in which case the saphenous artery arises directly from the femoral artery. The saphenous vein has many variants, typically classified into 5 types depending on whether the vein splits and/or lies within the saphenous compartment at the thigh level.
Подкожная вена — шунт для аортокоронарно: The saphenous vein is a conduit for coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), especially when medical therapy or percutaneous intervention is ineffective or not feasible. Both arterial and venous grafts are used; the saphenous vein is the most common venous conduit, but arterial grafts are more widely used and preferred for longer patency. Reported 10-year patency is 61% for saphenous vein grafts and 85% for arterial grafts such as the internal mammary artery, and some saphenous vein grafts have remained patent for over 30 years. Graft patency can be affected by disruption of the vasa vasorum and by tissue handling during anastomosis; a compliance mismatch between the vein and the coronary artery at the anastomosis can cause hemodynamic imbalance and reduce patency.
При заборе подкожный нерв нужно отличать: During harvest the saphenous nerve must be distinguished from the vein; in the inferior third of the leg the nerve and vein are joined by a common fascia, so saphenous neuralgia is common in the lower third of the leg, causing either hyperesthesia or diminished sensation. Iatrogenic nerve injury: saphenous neuropathy after trauma accounts for less than 1% of adult patients presenting with lower extremity pain. A 2017 study of hamstring autograft harvest for ACL reconstruction found sensory disturbances persisting at or beyond 6 months in most patients: 28 of 36 (77%) with vertical incisions and 19 of 42 (45%) with oblique incisions. Sensory disturbances after arthroscopic knee surgery range from 0.06% to 77% depending on technique, and saphenous nerve injury in meniscal repairs ranges from 1% to 20%. The original belief was that the sartorial branch becomes superficial only at the medial joint line; anatomical variation means it can become superficial above or below the joint line, making it vulnerable during medial meniscus repair.
Подкожная артерия обеспечивает фасциокож: The saphenous artery supports a fasciocutaneous flap from the upper medial third of the leg and knee; reconstructive surgeons use it to cover upper extremity defects and exposed tibiae after burns.
Так как подкожный нерв чисто чувствитель: Because the saphenous nerve is purely sensory, regional nerve blocks are useful for procedures distal to the knee. Blocks around the medial malleolus can provide effective pain control for ankle manipulation, and blocks are also beneficial for meniscectomies, given the nerve's course and innervation of the medial knee.
Подкожная вена часто вовлечена в варикоз: The saphenous vein is commonly involved in varicose veins and chronic venous disease. Wall changes include intimal thickening and increased connective tissue, leading to weakness and dilation; dilation promotes reflux, and reversed flow increases venous hypertension, creating a cycle of structural damage. Because the vein is relatively superficial, it is often the most visibly distended and problematic for patients.
Рука (плечо) лежит между плечевым и локт: The arm lies between the shoulder and elbow joints. Its nerves are terminal branches of the brachial plexus; they supply the upper limb muscles and carry sensory information to the brain's higher processing centers. Injury usually results from external trauma or iatrogenic (treatment-related) damage and can cause motor and sensory deficits in the muscles and dermatomes the nerves supply.
Пять конечных ветвей — подмышечный, мыше: The five terminal branches are the axillary, musculocutaneous, radial, ulnar and median nerves; each has specific motor and sensory roles. The axillary nerve arises from the posterior cord with fibers from C5 and C6; it travels inferior and posterior to the shoulder joint capsule with the posterior circumflex humeral artery, passing through the quadrangular space, and splits into superficial and deep branches; the superior lateral cutaneous branch supplies sensation to the lateral proximal arm.
Мышечно-кожный нерв отходит от латеральн: The musculocutaneous nerve arises from the lateral cord with fibers from C5 to C7; it pierces the coracobrachialis and runs between the biceps and brachialis, ending as the lateral cutaneous nerve of the forearm, which supplies the lateral forearm. The radial nerve arises from the posterior cord with fibers from C5 to T1; it starts medial to the humerus, then crosses posteriorly within the spiral groove alongside the deep brachial artery and bone, pierces the lateral intermuscular septum to enter the anterior arm compartment, and in the forearm divides into a deep motor branch (posterior interosseous nerve) and a superficial sensory branch. Cutaneous territories: posterior arm — posterior cutaneous nerve of the arm; lateral arm — inferior lateral cutaneous nerve of the arm; posterior forearm — posterior cutaneous nerve of the forearm; dorsal lateral 3.5 digits — superficial digital branches.
Локтевой нерв отходит от медиального пуч: The ulnar nerve arises from the medial cord with fibers from C8 to T1; it descends the medial arm, passes posterior to the medial epicondyle through the cubital tunnel, and runs between the two heads of the flexor carpi ulnaris. At the wrist it runs superficial to the flexor retinaculum and passes through the Guyon canal into the hand. Before the Guyon canal it gives off the dorsal cutaneous branch (dorsal 1.5 digits) and the palmar cutaneous branch (palmar proximal hand); it terminates as the superficial branch (sensation to palmar 1.5 digits) and the deep branch (motor innervation).
Срединный нерв отходит от латерального и: The median nerve arises from the lateral and medial cords with fibers from C5 to T1; it runs medial to the biceps and brachialis and lateral to the brachial artery, enters the forearm beneath the bicipital aponeurosis and through the two heads of the pronator teres, gives off the anterior interosseous nerve in the forearm, then continues through the carpal tunnel. Cutaneous territories: palm — palmar cutaneous nerve, which branches before the carpal tunnel; volar lateral 3.5 digits — superficial digital branches.
Нервы руки относятся к периферической не: Arm nerves belong to the peripheral nervous system and derive mainly from neural crest cells. The upper limb bud begins forming around 26 days after fertilization. Motor axons enter the limb bud first, during the fifth week, with sensory axons following shortly after. Primordial Schwann cells, derived from neural crest cells, surround each nerve and eventually form the myelin sheath. As the limb buds elongate and rotate, they carry their nerves with them, producing the dermatomal pattern seen in adults.
Исследования кровоснабжения нервов расши: Research on nerve blood supply expanded after the free vascularized nerve graft was introduced in 1976. The angiosome theory proposes that each 3D tissue block is supplied by a source artery, and nerves within that block receive branches from the adjacent source artery; supporting evidence is that transplanted nerves induce angiogenesis in nearby arteries. One study described two supply methods: an epineurial longitudinal arterial system accompanying each nerve and, in nerves lacking this vessel, small branches from adjacent muscles. Angiosome sources by nerve: axillary — brachial and posterior circumflex humeral; musculocutaneous — brachial only; radial — brachial, profunda brachii and radial; ulnar — brachial and ulnar; median — brachial, ulnar and radial. Lymphatic supply to these nerves is not well described.
Нервы руки обеспечивают двигательную инн: The arm nerves provide motor innervation to all upper extremity muscles. Axillary nerve: deltoid, teres minor. Musculocutaneous nerve: biceps brachii, coracobrachialis, medial brachialis. Radial nerve: direct branches — triceps brachii, lateral brachialis, anconeus, brachioradialis, extensor carpi radialis longus; deep branch — extensor carpi radialis brevis, supinator; posterior interosseous nerve — extensor digitorum, extensor digiti minimi, extensor carpi ulnaris, abductor pollicis longus, extensor pollicis brevis, extensor pollicis longus, extensor indicis.
Локтевой нерв: на плече мышц нет; на пре: Ulnar nerve: arm — no muscles; forearm — flexor carpi ulnaris, medial half of flexor digitorum profundus; hand (deep branch) — hypothenar muscles, medial 2 lumbricals, interossei, adductor pollicis, deep head of flexor pollicis brevis; palmaris brevis (superficial branch). Median nerve: arm — no muscles; forearm — pronator teres, flexor carpi radialis, palmaris longus, flexor digitorum superficialis; anterior interosseous nerve — flexor pollicis longus, pronator quadratus, lateral half of flexor digitorum profundus; hand — thenar muscles, lateral 2 lumbricals.
Анатомы давно описывают вариации плечево: Anatomists have long described variations in the brachial plexus and its distal branches. In cadaveric specimens, the long head of the triceps was sometimes innervated by an axillary nerve branch rather than the radial nerve. The musculocutaneous and median nerves may share fibers for a distance before separating, and connecting branches between them have been observed. In a study of 167 cadaveric arms, the musculocutaneous nerve did not pierce the coracobrachialis in 1.8% of cases and was absent in one case; variations in the ulnar, radial and axillary nerves were also noted, most often involving nerves that were thinner than normal.
Ортопедические операции на плече — в осн: Orthopedic arm surgery mainly involves open reduction and internal fixation of humerus fractures; the radial nerve, which lies close to the bone, is the main structure at risk in each approach. The anterior approach gives broad exposure of the humeral shaft: the radial nerve lies in the spiral groove on the posterior middle third of the humerus, so hardware placed in an anteroposterior direction risks over-penetrating the posterior cortex; the nerve can also be injured in the distal third, where it lies between the brachioradialis and brachialis after crossing the intermuscular septum; the axillary nerve, along the undersurface of the deltoid, is at risk if the muscle is over-retracted.
Задний доступ даёт сходный обзор диафиза: The posterior approach gives similar humeral shaft exposure and is preferred when the radial nerve is known to be damaged or transected, since the nerve is directly visible; with an intact radial nerve the nerve is at risk in the spiral groove, the posterior cutaneous nerve can be identified and traced proximally to locate the radial nerve, and when plating the nerve must not become trapped between the plate and bone. The distal humerus approach is performed through local anterolateral or medial incisions: the anterolateral is useful for distal humerus fractures and exploration of the distal radial nerve (the radial nerve must be identified before cutting through the brachialis, since it runs between the brachialis and brachioradialis); the medial is suited to isolated medial column fractures of the distal humerus and ulnar collateral ligament repair (preserve the posterior branch of the medial cutaneous nerve of the forearm; the ulnar nerve runs behind the medial epicondyle).

Нервы таза и нижней конечности включают: Pelvic and lower limb nerves come from sympathetic, parasympathetic and somatic components. Sympathetic fibers arise from roots T12 to L2, reach the pelvis via the superior hypogastric plexus and are called sacral splanchnic nerves. Parasympathetic fibers arise from roots S2 to S4 and are called pelvic splanchnic nerves. Pelvic somatic innervation arises from S2 to S4 and has motor and sensory parts; afferent fibers carry sensory information and efferent fibers carry motor. Lower limb nerves arise from L2 to L4 and L4 to S3, supplying all motor and some sensory information. A nerve carrying motor fibers supplies all muscles in a given compartment (e.g., the tibial nerve supplies the posterior leg compartment). Cutaneous sensation follows a dermatomal pattern.

Парасимпатическ: Autonomic nerves of the pelvis: parasympathetic nerves control sphincters, bladder emptying, sexual function (including erection) and bowel motility; the distal one-third of the transverse colon receives parasympathetic innervation from the pelvic splanchnic nerves; parasympathetic fibers also transmit pain sensation. Sacral splanchnic nerves supply efferent fibers to pelvic vessels and organs; their origin lies outside the pelvis, so they are reached via the hypogastric plexuses.
Соматические нервы таза бывают чисто дви: Pelvic somatic nerves are purely motor, purely sensory or mixed. The superior and inferior gluteal nerves supply motor fibers to the gluteal muscles and tensor fasciae latae. The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve gives sensation to the anterior and lateral thigh (anterior and posterior branches). The femoral nerve gives motor fibers to the anterior compartment and a few medial compartment muscles and cutaneous sensation to the anterior and medial thigh, and continues as the saphenous nerve. The obturator nerve gives motor fibers to the medial thigh compartment (anterior and posterior branches). The genitofemoral nerve has two branches: the genital branch runs in the spermatic cord and is motor to the cremaster in the scrotum, and the femoral branch gives cutaneous sensation to the inner upper thigh. The ilioinguinal nerve passes through the inguinal canal outside the spermatic cord, with sensation to the scrotum, labia and upper anterior-medial thigh.
Седалищный нерв — крупнейший нерв тела,: The sciatic nerve is the largest nerve in the body, arising from L4 to S3; it is motor to all posterior thigh muscles and, via the tibial nerve, the leg, and bifurcates into the tibial and common fibular nerves. The common fibular nerve divides into superficial and deep fibular nerves: the superficial fibular nerve is motor to the lateral leg compartment with sensation to the dorsal foot; the deep fibular nerve is motor to the anterior compartment with sensation to the skin between the first and second metatarsals. The tibial nerve is motor to all posterior leg compartment muscles and gives off the sural nerve, which provides sensation to the posterolateral leg.
Нервы таза и нижней конечности развивают: Pelvic and lower limb nerves develop with the rest of the nervous system, beginning around week 4. Neural crest cells lie dorsal to the neural tube, migrate through the embryo and form peripheral nerve cells.

Таз трудно доступен: костные структуры о: The pelvis is difficult to access: bony structures limit access, and it contains extensive vasculature, nerve plexuses and reproductive organs. The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve is frequently injured in hip replacement; the anterior approach carries the highest risk, and patients may have numbness of the anterolateral thigh. After casting or splinting the lower limb, patients may develop foot drop and loss of dorsal foot sensation; a tight cast or postoperative swelling can trap the fibular nerve between the cast and the fibular head, impairing nerve conduction.
Синдром грушевидной мышцы: ущемление сед: Piriformis syndrome: sciatic nerve entrapment beneath the piriformis muscle causes shooting pain, numbness and weakness; it is common in people who sit for long periods (e.g., students, truck drivers, secretaries). Superior gluteal nerve injury can occur iatrogenically during sciatic nerve blockade; it causes gluteus medius and minimus paralysis, so the hip drops on the side opposite the injury. Lead poisoning causes peripheral neuropathy; the deep fibular nerve is especially susceptible to lead-induced axonal degeneration, so foot drop is common in severe cases.
